Wei Zikai was the eldest son of Emperor Yi of the Yin Dynasty and the half-brother of King Zhou.
After Shang Zhou came to the throne, his rule was dark, he did not care about the affairs of the country, he was licentious and extravagant, and his followers repeatedly came to the throne, but King Zhou did not listen.
When Zuyi destroyed Xu due to Zhou Xibochang's virtuous governance, Weizi was worried that disaster would befall the Yin Dynasty, so he repeatedly advised King Zhou.
But King Zhou said: Wasn't it my destiny to be in Gastrodia when I was born?
Who can do anything to me?
Wei Zi then expected that King Zhou would not listen to his advice until his death, and planned to die or leave King Zhou. But he could not make a decision, so he went to ask the Taishi and Shaoshi, saying: The Yin Dynasty no longer has clear politics and cannot govern the four directions well.
Our ancestors created great achievements in the previous life, but King Zhou indulges in wine and banquets today, only obeying the words of women, disrupting and corrupting King Tang's good governance.
Everyone in the Yin Dynasty, big and small, was keen on thefts and rebellions in the grasslands. The ministers also imitated each other and violated laws and disciplines. Almost all of them were guilty, so their honors and titles could not continue. Since the imperial court was in chaos, the people began to rise up in all directions and became enemies of each other, and the world lost harmony.
Now, the Yin Dynasty has lost its national code, just like crossing a river by boat and not being able to find a ferry.
The demise of the Yin Dynasty is just around the corner.
Wei Zi continued: Master, Master, where will I go?
Can our Yin Dynasty be saved? You have no intention of warning me. What should I do if I fall into injustice?
The Grand Master followed suit and said: Prince, the Emperor of Heaven has brought disaster and destroyed the Yin Dynasty, but King Zhou is not afraid of the punishment of Heaven, nor does he listen to the advice of his elders.
Now, the subjects of the Yin Dynasty actually violated and falsely accused the gods of their will.
Now, if the Yin Dynasty can really be saved and the country is well managed, even if he dies, there will be no resentment left.
I'm afraid that even if you die for the country, the country still can't be governed, so it's better to go far away.
So Wei Zi left the Yin Dynasty.
Jizi is a relative of King Zhou.
When King Zhou first made ivory chopsticks, Jizi lamented: If he makes ivory chopsticks now, he will definitely make jade cups in the future; if he makes jade cups, he will definitely want to take possession of rare treasures from far away.
The luxury of carriages, horses and palaces will definitely start from here, and the country will definitely not be able to revitalize.
Because of King Zhou's excessive sexual behavior, Jizi came to remonstrate with him, but King Zhou still refused to listen.
Someone said: You can leave now.
Jizi said: When a minister remonstrates with the monarch, the monarch ignores him and then leaves him. This is to publicize the monarch's evil deeds and to flatter the people by grandstanding. I cannot bear to do this.
So Jizi disheveled his hair, pretended to be crazy and became a slave.
He lived in seclusion and masturbated by playing the piano, so people praised his song as "Ji Zi Cao".
Prince Bigan was also a relative of King Zhou. When he saw that Jizi was admonishing, but the monarch did not listen and became a slave, he said: "The monarch has sins, and if he cannot persuade him directly with death, the people will suffer, and what crime do the people have?"
So, he bluntly remonstrated with King Zhou.
King Zhou was furious and said: I heard that the saint's heart has seven orifices. Is this true?
So King Zhou killed Bigan and dug out his heart to verify.
Wei Zi said: Father and son are connected by flesh and blood, while ministers and ministers are connected by morality.
Therefore, if a father is at fault and his son refuses to listen to his advice over and over again, he should cry accordingly; if a minister refuses to listen to his advice after repeated advice, then morally speaking, the minister can leave the king.
So, the Grand Master and the Young Master advised Wei Zi to leave, and Wei Zi left.
King Wu of Zhou attacked King Zhou and defeated the Yin Dynasty. Weizi came to King Wu's military gate with his sacrificial weapon in hand. He exposed his right arm and tied his hands behind his back. He had someone on the left holding the sheep and someone on the right holding a straw. He knelt on the ground and went forward to beg King Wu.
So King Wu released Wei Zi and restored his original title.
King Wu made Wu Geng, the son of Shang Zhou, his father and asked him to inherit the sacrifices of the Yin Dynasty. He also sent Uncle Guan and Uncle Cai to assist him.
After King Wu destroyed the Yin Dynasty, he went to visit Jizi.
King Wu said: Alas!
God silently stabilizes the people so that they can live and work in peace and contentment, but I don't know the common order of God's order for the people.
Jizi replied: Once upon a time, Gun blocked the flood and disturbed the laws of the Five Elements of Heaven, so God was angry and did not give him the nine great laws of heaven to govern the country.
Gun was killed, and Yu succeeded him.
God then gave Yu Tianda nine kinds of great laws, and the ethical laws were thus ordered.
Of these nine great laws, one is called the Five Elements, the second is called the Five Matters, the third is called the Eight Political Rules, the fourth is called the Five Disciplines, the fifth is called Emperor Ji, the sixth is called Three Virtues, the seventh is called suspicion, the eighth is called Concubine Zheng, the ninth is called Appointment and Five Blessings, and people are afraid of using the Six Extremes.
The five elements are: water, fire, wood, metal, and earth.
The natural tendency of water is to moisten all things and flow down. The natural tendency of fire is to rise due to strong heat. Wood can be bent and straightened. Gold can be melted and deformed. Earth can be cultivated and harvested.
The brine produced by moistening the next thing has a salty taste; the burning object produced by rising fire has a bitter taste; the wood becomes straight and sour; the melted and deformed gold pins have a pungent taste; and the harvesting of hundreds of grains from the land has a sweet taste.
Five things: first, appearance, second, speech, third, observation, fourth, listening, and fifth, thinking.
The appearance should be solemn and respectful, the speech should be convincing, the observation should be discerning, the listening should distinguish right from wrong, and the thinking should be clear and thorough.
If your appearance is respectful, the people will be serious; if your words are convincing, the country will be able to govern; if you can observe clearly, you will not be deceived; if you listen to wisdom, your subjects will follow their plans; if you think clearly, things will be successful.
Eight political affairs: the first is food, the second is financial loans, the third is sacrifice, the fourth is construction, the fifth is enlightenment, the sixth is elimination of evil, the seventh is praise, and the eighth is military.
Five Epochs: The first is the year, the second is the month, the third is the day, the fourth is the stars, and the fifth is the calendar.
Supreme principles: The monarch should establish supreme principles, collect the five blessings, and give them to his subjects. The subjects will support the principles established by the emperor, and the emperor can also require his subjects to abide by these principles.
No subject is allowed to form parties for personal gain. If people do not form private parties, they will regard the principles established by the emperor as supreme.
All subjects must think for the Emperor, do things for the Emperor, and must abide by the principles set by the Emperor.
You have to think about it this way. Although the actions of your subjects are sometimes inconsistent with your principles, as long as they do not reach the level of crime, the emperor will tolerate them.
If someone humbly says: I like your principles, you will give him happiness.
In this way, people will fully adhere to your principles.
Do not mistreat those who are helpless, but fear the noble and distinguished.
You should be good at using people who have the ability and achievements, and the country will prosper.
Those who are appointed should be given titles and salaries.
If you cannot make officials contribute to the country, these people will turn to crime.
Even if you grant happiness to those who do not like the principles you have established, it will do no good to your country.
You should not be biased or unfair, and should act according to the laws of the former king.
Don't have personal likes and dislikes, just follow the path of the previous kings.
You should not do evil, but follow the right path of the late king.
Don't be partial or make cronies, then the path of the Holy King will be broad.
Without cliques or partiality, the path of the Holy King will be clear and discernible.
Don't violate the king's way and don't offend the principles. The path of the Holy King will be upright.
You must gather those who act according to principles, and then your subjects will all return to your principles.
Therefore, the supreme principles announced by the Emperor should always be observed, and even the Emperor’s teachings must be in line with the will of God. All subjects should regard the laws proclaimed by the Emperor as supreme. If they act in accordance with this principle, they will be close to the Emperor. Therefore, the emperor should be the king of the people in the world just as he is the parent of the people.
The three virtues are: first, correcting one's merits, second, being strong enough to win, and third, being soft, being able to win.
If you want to make the world peaceful, you must correct people's integrity. To deal with those who are tough and unfriendly, use a hard attitude to defeat them;
Only the monarch can bestow titles and rewards, only the monarch can preside over punishments, and only the monarch can enjoy delicious food. Ministers have no right to confer titles or salaries, to preside over punishments, or to enjoy delicious food.
If your ministers can confer titles and salaries, preside over punishments, and enjoy delicious food, they will bring harm to your royal family and disaster to your country. As a result, people will behave unnaturally, and the common people will cause chaos.
The way to solve the problem is to choose people who are good at divination and let them use tortoise shell or yarrow to divine.
They were ordered to perform divination. Some of the divination signs were like rain, some were like the beginning of sunshine after rain, some were like continuous clouds, some were like mist, and some were intertwined. Some were clear and some were obscure. There were seven types of hexagrams.
The first five uses tortoise shells for divination, and the latter two use yarrow to deduce and study complex and changeable hexagrams.
Let these divination people be used. If there are three divination people, then the words of two people will be trusted.
If you encounter a major problem, you should first think it over on your own, then discuss it with your ministers, discuss it with the people, and finally use divination to make a decision.
If you yourself agree, the tortoise agrees, the fortune tellers agree, the ministers agree, and the people agree, this is called Datong. Then you will be healthy and strong, and your descendants will have good fortune.
If you agree with yourself, if the turtle divination agrees, if the fortune teller agrees, if the ministers disagree, and if the common people disagree, then this is good luck.
The ministers agree, the turtle divination agrees, the divination agrees, but you disagree, the ministers disagree, this is also auspicious.
The people agree, the tortoise agrees, the fortune teller agrees, but you don't agree, and the ministers don't agree, this is still auspicious.
If you agree, the tortoise agrees, the fortune teller disagrees, the ministers disagree, and the people disagree, doing things within the country will be auspicious, and doing things abroad will be dangerous.
Turtle divination and grass divination are contrary to people's opinions. If you stay still, you will be lucky, but if you take action, you will be in danger.
Various signs: whether it is rain, sunshine, warmth, cold, or wind, these five natural phenomena should occur on time.
If all five natural phenomena are present and appear according to certain rules, crops will flourish.
If too much of one phenomenon occurs, the harvest will fail.
If a phenomenon is lacking, the harvest will also fail.
Regarding good omens: if the emperor is humble, it will rain on time; if the emperor is clear in government affairs, the sun will be abundant; if the emperor is wise, warmth will come on time; if the emperor is foresighted, cold will come on time; if the emperor is wise, the wind will blow on time.
There are all kinds of evil signs: if the emperor is arrogant, there will be too much rain; if the emperor is presumptuous, the sky will be dry; if the emperor is greedy for pleasure, the weather will be too hot; if the emperor is violent and impatient, the sky will be too cold; if the emperor is dim and unclear, the wind will blow continuously; if the emperor makes mistakes in his decision-making, it will affect the whole year; if the emperor's management is wrong, it will affect the whole month; if the officials are wrong in doing things, it will affect the whole day.
If there are no abnormalities in the year, month, and day, all kinds of crops will grow luxuriantly, politics will be clear, worthy people will be promoted, and the country will be safe and stable.
On the contrary, if there are abnormalities in the year, month, and day, the crops will not grow well, the politics will be gloomy, the capable people will be suppressed, and the country will be in turmoil. The people are like stars, and some stars like wind and some like rain.
The sun and the moon move according to rules, resulting in winter and summer.
If the moon obeys the stars, it will be windy sometimes and rainy sometimes.
Five blessings: first, longevity, second, wealth, third, peace, fourth, virtue, and fifth, a good death.
Six disasters: one is premature death, the other is illness, the third is sadness, the fourth is poverty, the fifth is ugliness, and the sixth is cowardice.
After hearing Jizi's statement, King Wu granted North Korea to Jizi and no longer regarded him as a subject.
Later, Jizi paid homage to the King of Zhou and passed by his old capital Yinxu. He was saddened by the ruins of the palace and the overgrown crops. Jizi was very sad and wanted to cry loudly, but he couldn't. He wanted to cry quietly, but he also felt that he was close to a woman's character, so he recited "Mai Xiu" in response to the scene. The poem said: The wheat awns are sharp and the grass seedlings are green.
That boy is not friendly to me!
The so-called boy is King Zhou.
When the people of Yin saw this poem, they all cried for it.
After King Wu died and King Cheng was still young, Zhou Gongdan took charge of the state power as an acting administrator.
Uncle Guan and Uncle Cai suspected Zhou Gongdan, so they started a rebellion with Wu Geng and wanted to attack King Cheng and Duke Zhou.
Zhou Gong borrowed the order from King Cheng to kill Wu Geng and Guan Shu, and banished Cai Shu. He also asked Wei Zikai to take charge of Yin in Wu Geng's place to continue the sacrifice of Yin's ancestors. He also warned him with the "Wei Zi's Order" and sealed Wei Zi in the Song Dynasty.
Weizi was originally benevolent, righteous and capable. After replacing Wu Geng, the people in the old land of the Yin Dynasty loved him very much.
After Wei Zikai died, he made his younger brother Yan the king of the country. This is Wei Zhong.
After Weizhong's death, his son Song Gongji came to the throne.
After the death of Song Gongji, his son Ding Gongshen came to the throne.
After the death of Ding Gongshen, his son Min Gong came to the throne.
After Min Gong died, his younger brother Yang Gongxi came to the throne.
After Duke Yang ascended the throne, Min Gong's son Yusi killed Duke Yang and seized the throne, and announced: "I should ascend the throne." This is Duke Li.
After Li Gong died, his son Li Gongju came to the throne.
In the seventeenth year of Ligong's reign, King Li of Zhou fled to pig.
In the twenty-eighth year, after Duke Li died, his son Hui Gong came to the throne.
In the fourth year of Duke Hui, King Xuan of Zhou came to the throne.
In the thirtieth year, Duke Hui passed away and Duke Ai came to the throne.
Ai Gong died in the first year, and his son Dai Gong came to the throne.
In the twenty-ninth year of Dai Gong, King You of Zhou was killed by Quan Rong, and Qin began to be classified as a vassal state.
In the thirty-fourth year, Duke Dai died, and his son Wu Gong came to the throne empty.
Duke Wu gave birth to a daughter, who later became the wife of Duke Hui of Lu and gave birth to Duke Huan of Lu.
In the eighteenth year, Duke Wu died and his son Xuan Gongli came to the throne.
Xuan Gong's prince's name is Yi.
In the 19th year, Duke Xuan fell ill and gave up the throne to his younger brother He, saying: "When the father dies, the son succeeds to the throne; when the elder brother dies, the younger brother succeeds to the throne. This is the universal morality in the world." I want to establish He as the king of the country.
He gave in many times before finally accepting.
After the death of Duke Xuan, his younger brother He ascended the throne and became Duke Mu.
In the ninth year, Duke Mu fell seriously ill. He summoned Grand Sima Kongfu and said, "The late king, Duke Xuan, abandoned the crown prince and the barbarians and passed the throne to me. I will never forget it."
After I die, I must support Yu Yi as the king.
Father Confucius said: All the ministers want to establish Prince Feng.
Duke Mu said: "Don't support Feng. I can't let Duke Xuan down."
So Duke Mu ordered his son Feng to go and live in the state of Zheng.
On Gengchen Day in August, Duke Mu died, and his brother Xuangong's son Yi succeeded him as Duke Shang.
When the gentlemen heard about this, they said: Song Xuan Gong knew people well and fulfilled his morality by passing the throne to his younger brother. However, in the end it was his son who got the throne.
In the first year of Shang Dynasty, Duke Zhouxu of Wei killed his own king Wan and established himself as king. Wanting to get the support of the princes, he sent someone to tell the king of Song: "Young Master Feng is in Zheng, and he will be a trouble in the future. You can work with me to attack him."
The king of Song State agreed, and he and Wei State jointly attacked Zheng State. The army returned after reaching the east gate of Zheng State.
The next year, Zheng Guo attacked the Song State and avenged the hatred of the Dongmen soldiers.
After that, the princes came to invade the Song Dynasty many times.
One day in the ninth year, the beautiful wife of the Grand Sima Kong Fujia went out and met Dazai Hua Du on the road. Hua Du took a fancy to Zhongjia's wife and looked at her intently.
Governor Hua coveted Confucius' father's wife, so he made people threaten him in the Song Dynasty: "In the ten years since Duke Shang came to the throne, he has fought eleven major battles, and the people have suffered terribly. This is all the fault of Confucius. I will kill Confucius to stabilize the people."
In this year, the people of Lu killed their own king Yin Gong.
Ten years later, Governor Hua killed Kong's father and took away his wife.
Duke Shang was very angry, so Governor Hua killed Duke Shang, and brought Feng Mu's son back from Zheng and made him king. This is Duke Zhuang.
In the first year of Zhuang Gong, Governor Hua became prime minister.
In the ninth year, he arrested Zheng Zhong's Ji Zhong and threatened him to become the king of Zheng.
Ji Zhong agreed and finally made Tu Tu the king.
In the 19th year, Duke Zhuang passed away and his son Min Gongjie came to the throne.
In the seventh year of Duke Min, Duke Huan of Qi came to the throne.
In the ninth year of the Song Dynasty, a flood occurred in the Song Dynasty. The Lu State sent Zang Wenzhong to express condolences to the Song Dynasty. Duke Min blamed himself and said: Because I did not serve the ghosts and gods well and the politics were unclear, the flood occurred.
Zang Wenzhong thinks this is right.
These words were actually taught by Master Ziyu to Duke Min.
In the summer of ten years, the Song State attacked the Lu State and fought in Chengqiu. The Lu State captured Nangong Wan of the Song State alive.
The people of the Song Dynasty asked the State of Lu to release Wan, and Nangong Wan returned to the State of Song.
In the autumn of the eleventh year, Min Gong and Nangong Wan were playing games while they were hunting. Nangong Wan argued with Min Gong. Min Gong was very angry and insulted Nangong Wan, saying: "I respected you at first, but now you are just a prisoner of Lu."
Nangong Wan was brave and powerful and hated Duke Min for saying this, so he grabbed the chessboard and killed Duke Min in Mengze.
When the doctor Qiu Mu heard about this, he came to the public gate with weapons.
Nangong Wan attacked Qiu Mu, but Qiu Mu hit his teeth on the door leaf and died.
Nangong Wanyou killed Dazai Huadu and supported Gongzi You as the king.
The young masters all fled to Xiaoyi, and the prince Yu said that they should run away to Bo.
Nangong Wan's younger brother Nangong Niu led the army to surround Bo.
In the winter, Dr. Xiao Yi and the princes who had fled from the Song Dynasty jointly killed Nangong Niu and killed the newly appointed king, Gongzi You. They replaced him with Min Gong's younger brother Yu said that this was Huan Gong.
Nangong Wan fled to Chen State.
Song State sent people to bribe Chen State.
Chen Guoren cleverly used a beauty trap to make Nangong Wan drunk with alcohol, wrapped him in leather and sent him back to the Song Dynasty.
The people of the Song Dynasty punished Nangong Wan with a grave.
In the second year of Duke Huan, the princes attacked the Song Dynasty and withdrew their troops when they reached the outskirts of the Song capital.
In three years, Duke Huan of Qi began to dominate.
In the twenty-third year, the people of Wei State welcomed back Wei Gongzi Rui from Qi State and made him their king, who was called Wei Wen Gong.
Duke Wen of Wei's sister was Duke Huan's wife.
This year, Duke Mu of Qin succeeded to the throne.
Thirty years ago, Duke Huan of Song Dynasty was critically ill, and Prince Zifu asked his concubine brother Mu Yi to inherit the throne.
Although Song Huan Gong believed that the prince's idea was very moral, he did not agree in the end.
In the spring of the thirty-first year, Duke Huan of the Song Dynasty passed away, and Prince Zifu succeeded him as Duke Xiang.
Duke Xiang made his concubine brother Mu Yi the prime minister.
Before Duke Huan was buried, Duke Huan of Qi met with the princes of various countries in Kuiqiu. Duke Xiang had no choice but to go to Kuiqiu to attend the meeting.
In the seventh year of Duke Xiang, meteorites fell like rain in Song Dynasty. They fell together with the rain, and the six birds flew backward because the wind was too strong.
In the eighth year, Duke Huan of Qi passed away, and Duke Xianggang of Song wanted to form an alliance with the princes.
In the spring of the twelfth year, Song Xianggong wanted to convene the princes for an alliance at Lushang. Song Xianggong asked the Chu State to come forward to invite other princes to come, and the Chu State agreed to his request.
Prince Mu Yi came to remonstrate with Duke Xiang of the Song Dynasty, saying: If a small country competes to be the leader of an alliance, it will lead to disaster.
Duke Xiang couldn't listen to Mu Yi's advice.
In autumn, all the princes gathered with Song Gong in Yu to form an alliance.
Muyi said: Will disaster happen here?
The king's desires are too much. How can a big country stand him?
Sure enough, Chu State arrested Song Xianggong and sent troops to attack Song State.
In winter, the princes met again at Haodi, and the Chu State released Song Xianggong.
Ziyu said: The disaster is not over yet.
In the summer of the thirteenth year, Song State attacked Zheng State.
Ziyu said: The disaster is here.
In autumn, Chu State attacked Song State in order to rescue Zheng State.
Song Xianggong is going to war. Ziyu came to remonstrate and said: God has abandoned Shang for a long time, so we must not fight again.
In winter, in November, Duke Xianggang of the Song Dynasty fought against King Cheng of Chu in Hongshui.
Before the Chu army had finished crossing the river, Mu Yi persuaded them: "The enemy is outnumbered and we are outnumbered, so we must attack them while they are crossing the river."
Duke Xiang did not listen to Mu Yi's opinion.
When the Chu army finished crossing the river and had not yet formed a formation, Mu Yi suggested again: It's time to attack.
But Duke Xiang said: Wait until they are ready to fight before fighting.
The Chu army was ready before the Song army went into battle.
As a result, the Song army was defeated and Xianggong was injured in his thigh.
Everyone in the Song Dynasty hated Duke Xiang.
Duke Xiang defended himself and said: A gentleman cannot take advantage of others' danger and cannot attack an army that is not in good formation.
Ziyu said: Winning the war is credit, what's the use of talking about empty truths!
If you really do what Duke Xiang said, then you can just become a slave for the Chu State. Why bother to fight with the Chu State?
King Cheng of Chu rescued Zheng Guo, who warmly entertained him. When King Cheng left, he married Zheng Jun's two daughters and returned to Chu.
Shu Zhan said: King Cheng of Chu does not understand etiquette, how can he die in peace?
There is no difference between internal and external etiquette. From here, we know that he will never achieve hegemony.
This year, Jin Gongzi Chong'er passed by the Song Dynasty. Because he was injured by the Chu Kingdom, Xianggong wanted to get help from the Jin Kingdom, so he gave Chong'er a generous gift and gave him eighty horses.
In the summer of the fourteenth year, Duke Xiang finally died of his leg injury during the Battle of Hongshui, and his son Chenggong Wangchen came to the throne.
In the first year of Chengdu, Duke Wen of Jin came to the throne.
Three years ago, the Song State broke its alliance with the Chu State and moved closer to the Jin State, because Song Xianggong had been kind to Jin Wengong.
In the fourth year, King Cheng of Chu attacked the Song Dynasty, and the Song Dynasty asked Jin for help.
In the fifth year of Jin Dynasty, Duke Wen of Jin came to the rescue of Song State, and the Chu army withdrew.
In the ninth year, Duke Wen of Jin passed away.
In the eleventh year, Prince Shang Chen of Chu killed his father and became king and ascended the throne.
In the sixteenth year, Duke Mu of Qin passed away.
In the seventeenth year, Duke Cheng died.
Chenggong's younger brother Yu killed the prince and Grand Sima Gongsun Gu, and established himself as king.
The people of Song Dynasty killed the king Yu and supported Chujiu, the youngest son of Duke Cheng. This was Duke Zhao.
In the fourth year of Zhaogong, the Song Dynasty defeated Changzhai Yuansi in Changqiu.
In the seventh year, King Zhuang of Chu came to the throne.
In the ninth year, Duke Zhao was ignorant and immoral, and the people did not rely on him.
Duke Zhao's younger brother Bao Ge was very virtuous and courteous to the corporal.
Once upon a time, Mrs. Xianggong wanted to have an affair with her son Bao, but failed, so she helped Bao do favors to the people. With the help of doctor Hua Yuan, he was elected as the right master.
When Zhaogong went hunting, his wife Wang Ji asked Wei Bo to kill Zhaogong Chujiu. Zhaogong's younger brother Bao Ge came to the throne. This was Duke Wen.
In the first year of Emperor Wen's reign, the Jin State led its princes to attack the Song State and condemned the Song State for killing its king Chujiu.
But when he heard that Duke Wen had been appointed king, he withdrew his troops.
In the second year, Zhao Gong's son launched a rebellion with the support of Wen Gong's half-brother Xu and the descendants of Wu Gong, Mu Gong, Dai Gong, Zhuang Gong and Huan Gong. Wen Gong killed them and expelled the descendants of Wu Gong and Mu Gong from Chu.
In the spring of the fourth year, Chu State asked Zheng State to attack Song State.
Song State sent Hua Yuan as its commander-in-chief. Zheng State defeated Song State and imprisoned Hua Yuan.
Hua Yuan killed a sheep to reward the soldiers before fighting the Zheng army. The man who drove him was very resentful because he did not eat the yokan, so he drove his car to the Zheng army. Therefore, the Song army failed and Hua Yuan was imprisoned.
The State of Song used 100 chariots and 400 horses with beautiful coats to redeem Hua Yuan.
Before these things were completely delivered to Chu State, Hua Yuan fled back.
In the fourteenth year, King Zhuang of Chu besieged the state of Zheng.
Zheng Bo surrendered to the Chu State, and the Chu State rescued the siege.
In the 16th year, an envoy from the Chu State passed by the Song State. The Song State arrested the Chu State envoy because of old grudges.
In September, King Zhuang of Chu surrounded the capital of Song.
In the seventeenth year, the Chu State besieged the capital of Song Dynasty for five months. The city was in dire straits and there was no food to eat, so Hua Yuan secretly met with the Chu generals one night to rebel.
Zifan told King Zhuang.
King Zhuang asked: How is it in the city?
Zifan replied: The people in the city split human bones to make firewood and exchanged their young sons for food.
King Zhuang said: This is true!
We only have enough food to feed the army for two days.
The State of Chu withdrew its troops because of its loyalty.
In the twenty-second year, Duke Wen passed away, and his son Gong Gongxia was made king.
The Song Dynasty implemented rich burials for the first time.
The gentleman laughed at Hua Yuan for not fulfilling his duties as a minister.
In the tenth year of his reign, Hua Yuan had a good relationship with the Chu general Zizhong, and also had a close relationship with the Jin general Luan Shu, so he formed allies with both Jin and Chu.
In the thirteenth year, the public passed away.
Hua Yuan became the right master, and Yu Shi became the left master.
Sima Tangshan killed Prince Fei, and then planned to kill Hua Yuan. Hua Yuan wanted to flee to Jin, but was stopped by Yushi on the way. When he reached the Yellow River, he turned back and killed Sima Tangshan.
So, he supported the young son of Gong Gong, who became Ping Gong.
In the third year of Ping Gong's reign, the King of the Communist Party of Chu captured Pengcheng of the Song Dynasty and granted Pengcheng to Yushi, Zuo Shi of the Song Dynasty.
In four years, the princes united to kill Yushi and returned Pengcheng to the Song Dynasty.
In the thirty-fifth year, the prince of Chu besieged the king who killed him and ascended the throne. This was King Ling of Chu.
In the forty-fourth year, Duke Ping died, and his son Yuan Gongzuo came to the throne.
In the third year of Duke Yuan, Chu Gongzi abandoned his illness and killed the king and ascended the throne, becoming King Ping.
In eight years, a fire broke out in Song Dynasty.
In the past ten years, Duke Yuan was dishonest and used deceptive means to kill all the princes.
The officials Hua and Xiang raised armies one after another to cause chaos.
Prince Jian of King Ping of Chu fled to the State of Song. Seeing Hua and others attacking each other, he left the State of Song and ran to the State of Zheng.
In the fifteenth year, because Lu Zhaogong was living abroad to avoid the Ji family, Yuan Gong prayed for Lu Zhaogong to return to Lu. As a result, he died on the way, and his son Jinggong Touman came to the throne.
In the 16th year of Jinggong, Yang Hu of the state of Lu fled to the state of Song, and soon left again.
In the twenty-fifth year, Confucius passed by the Song Dynasty. Sima Huanxi of the Song Dynasty hated Confucius and wanted to kill him. Confucius put on civilian clothes and escaped from the Song Dynasty.
Thirty years later, Cao State broke its alliance with Song State and then broke its alliance with Jin State. Song State then attacked Cao State, but Jin State did not come to rescue, so Song State destroyed Cao State and occupied Cao State's territory.
In the thirty-sixth year, Qi State official Tian Chang killed the monarch Jian Gong.
In the thirty-seventh year, King Hui of Chu lost the Kingdom of Chen, and Mars invaded the Antares star region.
Xinsu District is the territory of the Song Dynasty, and Jinggong is very worried about it.
Ziwei, who is in charge of the stars, said: The disaster can be transferred to the prime minister.
Jinggong said: "No, the Prime Minister is like my brothers and feet."
Ziwei added: "It can be passed on to the people."
Jinggong said: "No, the king relies on the people."
Ziwei said again: It can be transferred to annual achievements.
Jinggong said: "Not to mention, the harvest will fail and the people will be poor. Whose king should I be then?"
Ziwei said: Although the sky is high, you can still hear the subtle sounds of the lower world. You have said the three words that a king should say, and the Mars should have moved.
So I observed Mars carefully and found that Mars indeed moved three degrees.
In the sixty-fourth year, Jinggong passed away.
Song Gongzi killed the prince and ascended the throne. This was Zhao Gong.
Duke Zhao is the great-grandson of Duke Yuan.
Zhao Gong's father was Gongsun Jiu, Jiu's father was Gongzi Chu Qin, and Chu Qin was the youngest son of Duke Yuan.
Duke Jinggong killed Duke Zhao's father, Gongsun Jiu, so Duke Zhao resented the prince, so he killed him and took the throne himself.
Duke Zhao died in his forty-seventh year, and his son mourned him and made you the king.
After reigning for eight years, Duke Du passed away, and his son Xiu Gongtian came to the throne.
Xiu Gongtian died in the 23rd year of his reign, and his son came to the throne.
Pi Gong died after three years in office, and his son Ticheng came to the throne.
During the forty-one year of Ticheng's reign, Ticheng's younger brother Yan attacked Ticheng. Ticheng failed and fled to Qi, where Yan established himself as the king of Song.
In the eleventh year, Yan himself was crowned king.
He defeated the State of Qi to the east and captured five cities; he defeated the State of Chu to the south and occupied more than 300 miles of Chu land; he defeated the State of Wei to the west and became enemies with Qi and Wei.
Jun Yan used a cowhide bag to hold the blood, hung it up and shot it with arrows, which was called "shooting the sky".
Jun Yan indulged in wine and sex all day long.
All ministers who gave advice and advice were shot to death by him with arrows.
So the princes all called him Jie Song. Song Junyan followed in the footsteps of King Zhou and did whatever he wanted, so he had to kill him.
The princes asked Qi to attack Song.
When King Yan of the Song Dynasty came to the throne forty-seven years, King Min of Qi joined forces with Wei and Chu to attack the Song State, killed Yan, destroyed the Song State, and divided the Song State's territory.
Tai Shigong said: Confucius said: Weizi left, Jizi became a slave, Bigan was killed when he came to remonstrate, and there were three benevolent people in the Yin Dynasty.
"Spring and Autumn" ridiculed that the turmoil in the Song Dynasty began when Duke Xuan deposed the prince and allowed his younger brother to take the throne. The country was unstable for ten generations.
When Duke Xiang was in power, he practiced benevolence and righteousness and wanted to be the leader of the alliance.
In order to praise him, his doctor Zheng Kaofu traced the reasons for the prosperity of the Yin Dynasty in the Qi, Tang and Gaozong periods and wrote "Ode to Shang".
Song Xianggong was defeated at Hongshui, but some gentlemen still thought he was worthy of praise. This was because the gentlemen lamented that the countries in the Central Plains region lacked etiquette at that time, so they commended him because Song Xianggong had a spirit of courtesy.
summary:
Wei Zikai, eldest son of Emperor Yi of Yin and half-brother of King Zhou, repeatedly advised King Zhou against his dark, licentious rule but was ignored. Fearing Yin's downfall, Wei Zi consulted the Grand Master and Junior Master, who advised him to leave when the kingdom became irredeemable. He then departed. Jizi, a relative of King Zhou, lamented King Zhou's extravagance with ivory chopsticks, foreseeing ruin. After King Zhou ignored his remonstrations, Jizi feigned madness and became a slave rather than publicize the king's evil. Prince Bigan, another relative, bluntly admonished King Zhou, who killed him and ripped out his heart to check for seven orifices. Wei Zi concluded that ministers may leave a king who refuses repeated advice.

King Wu of Zhou defeated Yin, and Wei Zi surrendered, bearing sacrificial vessels. King Wu restored Wei Zi's title and appointed Wu Geng, son of Shang Zhou, to continue Yin sacrifices, with Guan Shu and Cai Shu as assistants. King Wu visited Jizi, who explained the nine great laws of heaven: the Five Elements, Five Matters, Eight Political Rules, Five Epochs, Imperial Principles, Three Virtues, Divination, Various Signs, and Five Blessings with Six Extremes. King Wu granted Jizi Korea, no longer treating him as a subject. Jizi later composed a poem mourning Yin's ruins.

After King Wu's death, Zhou Gongdan, acting as regent, suppressed a rebellion by Guan Shu, Cai Shu, and Wu Geng. He killed Wu Geng, exiled Cai Shu, and appointed Wei Zikai to rule Yin, later enfeoffing him in Song. Wei Zi's benevolent rule endeared him to the people. His successors included Wei Zhong, Song Gongji, Ding Gongshen, Min Gong, Yang Gongxi, Li Gong, Li Gongju, Hui Gong, Ai Gong, Dai Gong, Wu Gong, Xuan Gongli, and Mu Gong. Mu Gong, honoring his brother Xuan Gong's wish, passed the throne to Xuan Gong's son Yi (Duke Shang) instead of his own son.

Duke Shang's reign saw turmoil: Hua Du killed Kong's father and Duke Shang, installing Duke Zhuang. Subsequent rulers included Min Gong, Huan Gong, Xiang Gong, Cheng Gong, Zhao Gong, Wen Gong, Gong Gong, Ping Gong, Yuan Gong, Jing Gong, Zhao Gong, Duke Du, Xiu Gongtian, Pi Gong, Ticheng, and Yan. Yan, known as "Jie Song," indulged in cruelty and debauchery, shooting advisors. The princes allied with Qi to attack Song, killing Yan and dividing its territory in his forty-seventh year.

Tai Shigong concluded that Confucius recognized three benevolent men of Yin: Wei Zi, Jizi, and Bigan. The "Spring and Autumn" noted Song's instability began when Duke Xuan deposed the prince for his brother. Duke Xiang's benevolent attempts at leadership were praised, though he was defeated at Hongshui; gentlemen commended his adherence to ritual propriety amidst the era's lack of etiquette.

translation:
Tang Shuyu of Jin State was the son of King Zhou Wu and the younger brother of King Zhou Cheng.
At first, when King Wu of Zhou was with Shu Yu's mother, Shu Yu's mother dreamed that God said to King Wu of Zhou: I will give you a son named Yu, and I will give him the land of Tang.
When Mrs. Wu Wang gave birth to the baby, she saw that the word "Yu" was written on the palm of her hand, so she named her son Yu.
After the death of King Zhou Wu, King Zhou Cheng succeeded to the throne, civil strife broke out in Tang Dynasty, and Duke Zhou destroyed Tang Dynasty.
One day, King Cheng of Zhou and Shu Yu were playing together. King Cheng cut a tung tree leaf into the shape of a jade and gave it to Shu Yu, saying: Use this to entrust you.
Shi Yi then asked to choose an auspicious day to make Shu Yu a prince.
King Zhou Cheng said: I was joking with him!
Shi Yi said: The emperor has no jokes.
As long as it is said, the historian must record it truthfully, complete it according to etiquette, and play music to praise it.
So King Cheng of Zhou granted the land of Tang to Shu Yu.
Tang Dynasty is located east of the Yellow River and Fen River, with a radius of hundreds of miles, so Shuyu is also called Tang Shuyu. His surname is Ji and his courtesy name is Ziyu.
Uncle Tang's son Xie was the Marquis of Jin.
The son of the Marquis of Jin, Ning, was the Marquis of Wu.
The son of Marquis Wu was the Marquis of Cheng.
Chenghou's son Fu was Lihou.
Lihou's son Yijiu was Jinghou.
After Jinghou, the age of Jin can be calculated.
From Tang Shuyu to Jinghou in the Five Dynasties, there is no record of the number of years they reigned.
In the 17th year of Jinghou, King Li of Zhou was brutal and violent, and the people of the country were in turmoil. King Li fled to the pigs, and the ministers presided over government affairs, so it was called "Republic".
In the eighteenth year, Jinghou passed away and his son Lihou Situ succeeded to the throne.
In the fourteenth year of Lihou, King Xuan of Zhou had just ascended the throne.
In the eighteenth year, Marquis Li died, and his son Xianhou came to the throne.
Xianhou died in the eleventh year, and his son Muhou, King Fei, came to the throne.
In the fourth year after Mu Hou ascended the throne, he married Qi's daughter Jiang as his wife.
In the seventh year, Muhou conquered the territory.
The lady gave birth to the prince and was angry.
In ten years, he conquered thousands of acres and made great achievements.
Mu Hou also had a younger son, named Chengshi.
The teacher from Jin Dynasty said: "What a strange name the king gave to his child!"
The prince's name is Qiu, and Qiu means hatred.
The younger son is called Chengshi. Chengshi is a big name and means success.
The name is given by itself, but things have their own rules.
Now, the names of the eldest son and the concubine are exactly the same. Will Jin be able to avoid chaos in the future?
In the twenty-seventh year, Hou Mu died, and his younger brother Uncle Shang established himself as king, and Prince Qiu was forced to flee.
In the third year of Uncle Shang's reign, King Xuan of Zhou passed away.
In the fourth year, Muhou's prince Qiu led his followers to attack Uncle Shang and established himself as the king of the country. This was Wenhou.
In the tenth year of Marquis Wen, King You of Zhou was ignorant and immoral. Dogs and soldiers killed King You of Zhou, and the royal family of Zhou moved eastward.
Qin Xianggong began to be classified as a prince. In the thirty-fifth year, Wenhou Qiu died, and his son Zhaohou Bo came to the throne. In the first year of the reign of Emperor Zhaohou, Marquis Wen conferred the title of Quwo to his younger brother.
Quwo City is larger than Yicheng.
Yicheng was the capital of Jinjun.
When he became a master, he was granted the title of Uncle Huan in Quwo.
Jinghou's concubine Luan Bin assisted Uncle Huan.
At that time, Uncle Huan was already old and respected virtue, so the people of Jin State all attached themselves to him.
The gentleman said: The turmoil in Jin State is in Quwo.
It is bigger than its roots and has won the hearts of the people. If there is no chaos, what are you waiting for!
In the seventh year of Zhaohou, Pan's father, the minister of Jin, killed the king Zhaohou and was going to meet Uncle Huan Quwo.
Uncle Huan also wanted to go to the Jin capital, but the Jin people sent troops to attack Uncle Huan.
Uncle Huan was defeated and returned to Quwo.
The people of Jin jointly established Ping, the son of Zhaohou, as the king of the country. This is Xiaohou.
Xiaohou killed Pan's father.
In the eighth year of Xiaohou's reign, Uncle Huan of Quwo passed away, and his son Huan inherited Uncle Huan's title. He became Uncle Zhuang of Quwo.
In the fifteenth year of Xiaohou's reign, Quwo Zhuangbo killed the king of Jin Xiaohou in Yicheng.
The Jin people attacked Quwo Zhuangbo, and Zhuangbo returned to Quwo again.
The people of Jin also made Xiaohou's son Qie their king, and he became the Marquis of E.
In the second year of Ehou's reign, Duke Yin of Lu had just ascended the throne.
Ehou passed away in the sixth year of his reign.
When Quwo Zhuangbo heard that the Marquis of E of Jin had passed away, he raised troops to attack the capital of Jin.
King Ping of Zhou sent Duke Guo to lead an army to attack Zhuangbo in Quwo, but Zhuangbo fled back to Quwo to defend himself.
The people of Jin jointly established Guang, the son of Ehou, as the king of the country. This is Aihou.
In the second year of Aihou's reign, Uncle Zhuang of Quwo passed away, and his son succeeded him to the throne. This was Duke Wu of Quwo.
In the sixth year of Aihou's reign, the people of Lu killed their own king, Duke Yin of Lu.
In the eighth year of Aihou's reign, the Jin State invaded Xingting.
Xingting and Quwo Wu Gong planned together. In the ninth year, they arrived at the Fen River to attack Jin and captured Jin Aihou.
So the Jin people made Aihou's son Xiaozi their king, and he became Xiaozihou.
In the first year of Xiaozi's reign, Duke Wu of Quwo ordered Han Wan to kill the captured Jin Aihou.
Quwo became more and more powerful, and Jin had nothing to do with it.
In the fourth year of Jin Xiaozi's reign, Quwo Wu Gong deceived Jin Xiaozi and killed him.
King Huan of Zhou sent Guo Zhong to attack Duke Wu of Quwo. Duke Wu fled back to Quwo, and Marquis Ai of Jin's younger brother Min was made Marquis of Jin.
In the fourth year of Jin Houmin's reign, the Song Dynasty arrested Zheng Zhong's Ji Zhong and forced him to establish Tu as the king of Zheng.
In the 19th year of the Marquis of Jin, the Qi people Guan Zhifu killed his own monarch Qi Xianggong.
In the twenty-eighth year of the Marquis of Jin, Duke Huan of Qi began to dominate.
Duke Wu of Quwo attacked Jin Hou Min, destroyed Jin, and dedicated all the treasures of Jin to King Zhouli. King Li appointed Duke Wu of Quwo as the king of Jin and listed him as a prince, so Duke Wu annexed the entire land of Jin and made it his own.
Duke Wu of Quwo had been on the throne for thirty-seven years before he changed his title to Duke Wu of Jin.
Duke Wugong of Jin began to move to the capital of Jin State, including the previous accession to the throne in Quwo, for a total of thirty-eight years.
Duke Wu claimed to be the great-grandson of the late king Muhou of Jin and the grandson of Uncle Huan Quwo.
Uncle Huan was the first to be granted the title of Quwo.
Duke Wu is the son of Uncle Zhuang.
It was a total of sixty-seven years from the time when Uncle Huan was first granted the title of Quwo to the time when Duke Wu destroyed the state of Jin. Duke Wu finally replaced the state of Jin and became a vassal.
Duke Wu died in the second year after he replaced the king of Jin. Including his reign in Quwo, he died in a total of thirty-nine years.
His son Xian Gong Gui Zhu came to the throne. In the first year of Xian AD, King Hui of Zhou's brother Tuan attacked King Hui. King Hui fled and lived in Liyi of Zheng State.
In the fifth year, Duke Xian of Jin attacked Li Rong and obtained Li Ji and Li Ji's sister, whom he loved very much. In the eighth year of the Jin Dynasty, many princes from Jin State had fled to Guo State. Therefore, Guo Gong once again attacked Jin State, but failed to win.
In the tenth year of Xiangong's reign, Jin wanted to attack Guo, but Shi Jiang said: Let's wait until it has its own civil strife!
In the twelfth year, Li Ji gave birth to Xi Qi.
Duke Xian planned to depose the prince, so he said: Quwo is the place where the ancestral temple of our ancestors is located, while Pu is close to Qin and Qu is close to Zhai. If the princes are not allowed to guard those places, I will be worried.
So Duke Xian asked Prince Shen Sheng to garrison Quwo, Prince Chong'er to garrison Pu, and Prince Yiwu to garrison Qu.
Xi Qi, the son of Duke Xian and Li Ji, lived in Jiang, the capital of the country.
Therefore, the people of Jin knew that the prince would not be able to ascend the throne.
Prince Shen Sheng's mother was Qi Huangong's daughter, named Qi Jiang, who had died long ago.
Shen Sheng's half-sister is Mrs. Mu Gong of Qin.
Chong'er's mother was a woman of the Hu family in Zhai.
Yiwu's mother is the sister of Chong'er's mother.
Duke Xian had eight sons in total. Prince Shen Sheng, Chong'er, and Yi Wu were all virtuous and of high moral character.
After Duke Xiang had Li Ji, he alienated his three sons.
In the 16th year, Duke Xiang of Jin established two armies.
Xian Gong commanded the upper army, Prince Shen Sheng commanded the lower army, Zhao Su drove the chariot, and Bi Wan served as the right guard. They successively conquered and destroyed Huo, Wei, and Geng.
After the whole army returned to Jin, Xian Gong helped the prince build a city in Quwo, gave the land of Geng to Zhao Su, and gave the land of Wei to Bi Wan, making them officials.
Shilai said: Prince, you can no longer be established as king.
Duke Xian gave you all the capital of the late monarch and granted you the title of minister. He raised your salary to the extreme in advance. How could he make you the king again?
The prince might as well run away to avoid disaster.
Isn’t it okay for the prince to imitate Taibo Wu? In this way, you can still get a good reputation.
The prince did not listen.
Guo Yan, the doctor who conducted divination, said: Bi Wan's descendants must have great development.
Ten thousand means a full number; Wei means vast.
The reward of Wei was given to Bi Wan because God was blessing Bi Wan.
The emperor has tens of thousands of people, and the princes have tens of thousands of people. Now that Biwan is enfeoffed in the vast land of Wei, to match the full number in his name, he will definitely get many subjects.
At first, Bi Wan was divining his own official fortune in the Jin Kingdom, and encountered the "Tuen Gua" and evolved it into the "Bi Gua".
Xin Liao's divination said: This is auspicious. The "Tun" hexagram predicts solidity and depth. Nothing is more auspicious than this.
His descendants will surely prosper.
In the seventeenth year, the Marquis of Jin asked Prince Shen Sheng to attack the Gaoluo clan in Dongshan.
Rick came to admonish Duke Xian and said: The prince is the one who offers sacrifices to the ancestral temple and the country, and checks the king's meals in the morning and evening, so he is called Zhongzi.
When the monarch wants to travel, the prince should stay behind. If someone stays behind on his behalf, the prince should follow. Following the monarch when going out is called Fujun, and staying behind in the capital is called supervising the country. This is an ancient system.
The commander-in-chief of the army must concentrate on planning; issuing orders to the army is the sole responsibility of the monarch and his ministers, not the prince's business.
The command of the army lies in obeying the general's orders. If the prince has to ask the king for instructions when everything happens, there is no dignity; if he acts arbitrarily, it is unfilial. Therefore, the king's legitimate son cannot command the army.
It is wrong for the king to appoint the prince as the commander of the army. Commanding the army will make the prince lose his majesty. How can he be reused in the future?
Duke Xiang said: I have several sons, but I have not yet decided who will be the crown prince.
Rick withdrew without answering and went to see the prince.
The prince asked: Am I going to be deposed?
Rick said: "Prince, please work hard. I will let you command the army. What I am afraid of is that I will not be able to complete the task. Why should I abolish you?"
Moreover, as a son of man, you should be afraid that you will not be able to fulfill your filial piety, and you should not be afraid that you will not be able to be established as a king.
If you pay attention to your own moral cultivation and do not blame others, you can avoid disasters.
The prince commanded the army, and Duke Xian asked him to wear separate clothes of different colors on the left and right, and wear a golden jue.
Rick said he was sick and did not follow the prince.
The prince then went to attack Dongshan.
In the 19th year, Duke Xian said: When our ancestors Zhuang Bo and Wu Ping quelled the turmoil in Jin, Guo often helped Jin to attack us, and also hid the escaped princes of Jin. If they really rebelled and did not attack us, they would leave future troubles for their descendants.
Therefore, Duke Xiang asked Xun Xi to drive Qu Chan's four-horse horse to borrow a road from the state of Yu.
The state of Yu agreed to borrow the road, and Jin went to attack the state of Guo, captured Xiayang and returned home.
Duke Xian said to Li Ji privately: I want to depose the crown prince and let Xi Qi take his place.
After hearing this, Li Ji cried and said: The prince has been appointed, the princes have already known it, and the prince has commanded the army many times, and the people have all joined him. How can you abolish the eldest son and establish a concubine just because of me? If you must do this, I can only commit suicide.
Li Ji pretended to praise the prince, but secretly slandered the prince and wanted to make her son the prince.
In the twenty-first year, Li Ji said to the prince: The king once dreamed of Qi Jiang. Prince, you should go to Quwo immediately to sacrifice your mother, and when you come back, offer the meat to the king.
So the prince rushed to Quwo to sacrifice his mother. After returning to the capital of Jin, he presented the gizzard meat to Duke Xian.
Duke Xian went out hunting at that time, so the prince put the meat in the palace.
Li Ji sent people to put poison on the flesh.
Two days later, Duke Xian returned to the palace from hunting. The chef offered the pork belly to Duke Xian. Duke Xian wanted to enjoy it, but Li Ji stopped him and said, "The pork belly comes from a far away place. You should try it."
The cook poured the pork belly on the ground, and the ground protruded; the chef threw the pork belly to the dog, and the dog died immediately after eating it; the cook gave the pork belly to the eunuch, and the eunuch also died.
Li Ji cried and said: Why is the prince so cruel!
Even his own father wanted to kill him to take his place, let alone others?
Besides, you are already old and you only have a few more days left to live. The prince can’t wait to kill you!
Li Ji then said to Duke Xian: The prince did this only because of Xi Qi and me.
We, mother and son, would rather hide in another country or commit suicide early than let my mother and son be killed by the prince in vain.
When you wanted to get rid of him, I opposed you; but today, I realize that I was totally wrong.
After the prince heard about this, he fled to the new city. Duke Xiang was very angry and killed the prince's teacher Du Yuanqian.
Someone said to the prince: "It was Li Ji who put the poison in the flesh. Why doesn't the prince explain it clearly himself?"
The prince said: My father is old. Without Li Ji, he will have trouble sleeping and eating tasteless.
If I tell the truth, my father will definitely be very angry with Li Ji. This won't work.
Someone said to the prince again: Then you should flee to other countries as soon as possible.
The prince said: Who can accept me if I run away with this crime?
I had no choice but to commit suicide.
On Wushen Day in December, Shen Sheng committed suicide in Xincheng.
At this time, Chong'er and Yiwu came to see the king.
Someone told Li Ji: These two young masters hate you for framing and killing the prince.
Li Ji was very frightened, so she spread a rumor to Xiang Gong, saying: Shen Sheng put poison into the flesh of the brachium, and the two young masters knew about it in advance.
Chong'er and Yiwu were also frightened when they heard Li Ji's rumors, so Chong'er ran to Pu and Yiwu ran to Qu and personally protected their cities with tight security.
当初，献公让士蒍给两位公子修筑蒲、屈城墙，现在还未修筑成功。

Yi Wu reported this to Duke Xian, who was very angry with Shi Lai.
Shilai apologized and said: There are few bandits in the border city, why do we need to build the city wall?
After Shilai retreated, he sang: The fur of the fox fur coat is scattered. There are three masters in a country. Who will I obey?
Shilai finally repaired the city.
After Shen Sheng died, the two young masters went back to defend their own cities.
In the twenty-second year, Duke Xian was very dissatisfied with the two young masters leaving without saying goodbye. He thought they really had a conspiracy, so he sent troops to attack Pucheng.
There was an eunuch named Bo Di in Pucheng who asked Chong'er to commit suicide immediately.
Chong'er climbed up the wall and escaped. Bo Di chased him and cut off Chong'er's sleeves.
Chong'er was able to escape and reached Zhai.
Duke Xian sent people to attack Qu again, but the people of Qucheng defended with all their strength and were not captured.
This year, the Jin State borrowed a road from Yu to attack Guo.
Gong Zhiqi, the official of the Yu State, advised Yu Jun: "You cannot lend the road to the Jin State, otherwise the Jin State will destroy the Yu State."
Yu Jun said: Jin has the same surname as me, so it should not attack my country.
Gong Zhiqi said: Tai Bo and Yu Zhong were both sons of the King Tai. Tai Bo fled and therefore failed to inherit the throne.
Guo Zhong and Guo Shu were both sons of Wang Ji and ministers of King Wen. Their achievements were recorded in the royal family and kept in the hands of the officials in charge of the alliance.
If you are determined to destroy the Guo State, how can you cherish the Yu State?
Besides, can Jin be closer to the Yu State than to the Uncle Huan and Uncle Zhuang families?
Uncle Huan and Uncle Zhuang's family had no sins, but Jin Jun actually killed them all.
The relationship between Yu State and Guo State is like the relationship between lips and teeth. When the lips are dead and the teeth are cold,
Jun Yu refused to listen to Gong Zhiqi's advice and agreed to the Jin State.
Gong Zhiqi left the Yu Kingdom with his entire family.
In the winter of this year, the Jin State destroyed the Guo State, and Guo Gongchou fled to Zhou Jing.
When the Jin army returned, they attacked and destroyed the State of Yu. They captured the Duke of Yu and his senior officials Jing Bo and Baili Xi as dowries for the Duke's daughter Qin Muji, and sent people to handle the sacrifices of the State of Yu.
Xun Xi gave Xiangong the famous horse that he had given to Yu Jun in the past, and he dedicated it to Xiangong. Xiangong smiled and said: "The horse is still my horse, but it is also old!"
In the twenty-third year, Duke Xian sent Jia Hua and others to attack Qucheng, and all the people in Qucheng fled.
Yi Wu planned to flee to Zhai.
Ji Rui said, "No, Chong'er is already there. If you go today, Jin will definitely mobilize troops to attack Zhai. Zhai is afraid of Jin, and disaster will endanger you."

Jie Zitui said: I hate those people, and if I imitate their behavior, the sin will be even greater.
Besides, I have already expressed my complaint and will never eat his salary.
Mother said: How about letting Mr. Wen know about your situation?
Jie Zitui replied: Words are flower decorations on everyone's body. The body wants to be hidden, so why use flower decorations anymore?
Putting on floral decorations is about showing yourself off.
Jie Zitui's mother said, "Can I do what you said?"
Then I'll hide with you.
Mother and son never showed up again until their deaths.
Jie Zitui's followers felt pity for him, so they hung a sign at the entrance of the palace, which read: If a dragon wants to go to heaven, it needs the help of five snakes.
The dragon has gone deep into the clouds, and the four snakes have each entered their own palaces. Only one snake is sad and resentful alone, and ultimately cannot find its own place.
When Duke Wen came out of the palace, he saw these words and said: This is Jie Zitui.
I was worried about the royal family and had not yet been able to consider his merits.
So Duke Wen sent someone to call Jie Zitui, but Jie Zitui had already escaped.
Duke Wen asked about Jie Zitui's residence and heard that he had entered Mianshang Mountain. So, Duke Wen sealed the entire Mianshang Mountain to Jie Zitui, and called it Jie Tui Field as his fief, and named it Jieshan, in order to record my sins and commend talented people.
Uncle Hu, an incompetent man who fled with Duke Wen, said: Your Majesty, you have rewarded the meritorious officials three times but it has not been my turn. May I ask what I am guilty of?
Duke Wen reported back: Teach me with benevolence and righteousness, advise me with morality and kindness, and you should be highly rewarded.
Assisting me with actions finally brought me success, which deserves a lesser reward.
He took on the danger of bows and arrows and made great contributions to me, which should be rewarded again.
If you only use your labor to serve me without making up for my mistakes, you should be rewarded again.
After these three rewards are over, it will be your turn.
The people of Jin were very happy when they heard Duke Wen's words.
In the spring of the second year, the Qin army was stationed by the Yellow River and was about to escort the King of Zhou back to Beijing.
Zhao Shui said: If you want to become the overlord, it is better to escort the King of Zhou back to the capital and respect the King of Zhou.
Zhou and Jin have the same surname. If Jin does not escort King Zhou back to the capital first and falls behind Qin, it will not be able to issue orders in the world.
Today, respecting the king of Zhou is the capital of Jin's dominance.
On the first day of the third month, Jin sent troops to Yangfan, surrounded Wen, and escorted King Xiang of Zhou to the capital of Zhou.
In April, Jin killed Wang Zidai, the younger brother of King Xiang.
King Zhou Xiang gave the land of Hanoi and Yangfan to the State of Jin.
In four years, King Chu Cheng and other princes surrounded Song State. Gongsun Gu of Song State rushed to Jin State to ask for help.
Xian Zhen said: To repay Song Xianggong's kindness of gifting horses and make Jin dominate the princes, this is the battle today.
Hu Yan said: Chu State has just occupied Cao State, and has married Wei State for the first time. If we attack Cao State and Wei State, Chu State will definitely rescue us, and Song State will be saved from disaster.
So the Jin State organized three armies. Zhao Shuai recommended Que Gu to command the middle army, and Que Zhen assisted him; Hu Yan was sent to command the upper army, and Hu Mao assisted him, and Zhao Shuai was appointed minister; Luan Zhi commanded the lower army, and Xian Zhen assisted him;
In December of winter, the Jin army first captured the east of Taihang Mountain and granted the original city to Zhao Shuai.
In the spring of the fifth year, Duke Wen of Jin wanted to attack the state of Cao and asked the state of Wei to borrow a road, but the people of the state of Wei refused.
The Jin army had no choice but to cross the Yellow River from the south to attack Cao State and crusade against Wei State.
In the first month of the first month, the Jin army captured Wulu.
In February, the Marquis of Jin and the Marquis of Qi formed an alliance in Lianmen.
Marquis Wei requested an alliance with Jin, but the Jin people refused.
The Marquis of Wei wanted to form an alliance with the Chu State, but the people of the country opposed it. As a result, the Marquis of Wei was kicked out to please the Jin State.
The Marquis of Wei lived in Xiangniu, and the young master bought Wei to defend the country. The Chu State rescued the Wei State, but failed to win.
The Marquis of Jin surrounded the State of Cao.
On Bingwu in the third month, the Jin army invaded the capital of Cao and listed the crimes of Cao Jun because Cao Jun did not listen to Li Weiji's words, but instead used 300 beauties in a gorgeous car.
Duke Wen ordered the army not to enter the home of Lifuji's clan in order to repay his kindness.
Chu surrounded Song, and Song asked Jin for help.
If Duke Wen wanted to rescue Song, he should attack Chu. Because Chu had been kind to Duke Wen, Duke Wen did not want to attack Chu. He wanted to give up the rescue of Song, but Song had been kind to Jin, so Duke Wen was hesitant about this move.
Xian Zhen persuaded: Seize Cao Bo and distribute the lands of Cao and Wei to the Song State. Chu must be anxious about this, and the Chu State will inevitably give up the Song State.
So Wen Gong listened to Xian Zhen's opinion, and King Chu Cheng really led his army to leave the Song Dynasty.
Ziyu, the general of Chu State, said to King Cheng of Chu: Your Majesty, you have been too kind to Jin State. Now that Duke Wen knows that Chu State has close relations with Cao State and Wei State, he deliberately attacks them. This is contempt for the king.
King Cheng said: The Marquis of Jin has been on the run for nineteen years. He has been trapped for too long and finally returned to Jin. Because he has experienced all kinds of hardships and dangers, he is able to treat his people well. God bless him and he is unstoppable.
Ziyu still asked for troops and said: "I don't dare to make any achievements, I just want to stop the slanderous remarks."
The king of Chu was very angry and gave him only a small army.
So Ziyu asked Wanchun to tell the state of Jin: Please restore the status of Weihou and save the state of Cao. I will also lift the siege of the state of Song.
The offender said: "Ziyu is too rude. My king only gets one share, but their ministers get two. I cannot agree to this condition."
Xian Zhen said: Being able to make people's hearts calm is called courtesy.
A word from Chu State can bring stability to three countries, but a word from you can bring about the destruction of these three countries. We are being rude.
Not agreeing to the Chu State means giving up the Song State.
It is better to privately agree to restore Cao and Wei in order to seduce Chu, detain Wanchun to anger Chu, and make plans based on the outcome of the war.
The Marquis of Jin imprisoned Wanchun in Weiguo, and privately promised to restore Caoguo and Weiguo.
Cao and Wei sent envoys to notify them of breaking off diplomatic relations with Chu.
Ziyu of Chu State was very angry and attacked the Jin army. The Jin army continued to retreat. The army officials asked: "Why are you retreating?"
Duke Wen said: When we were in Chu State, we made a covenant to stay away from each other during war. Can we break it?
The Chu army also wanted to retreat, but the ministers disagreed.
On Wuchen Day in April, Duke Song, General Qi, General Qin and Marquis of Jin were stationed in Chengpu.
On the day of Jisi, they fought with the Chu army. The Chu army was defeated, and the defeated ministers fled with the remaining soldiers.
On Jiawu Day, the Jin army returned to Hengyong and built a palace for King Zhou Xiang in Jiantu.
At first, Zheng Guo had aided Chu State, but now that Chu State had failed, Zheng Guo State was very frightened and sent people to request an alliance with the Marquis of Jin.
Therefore, the Marquis of Jin formed an alliance with Zheng Bo.
On the last day of the fifth month, Duke Wen of Jin dedicated the captives of Chu to the king of Zhou. There were a hundred armored four-horse chariots and more than a thousand infantry.
King Zhou Xiang asked Prince Hu to declare the Marquis of Jin as the overlord, and rewarded the Marquis of Jin with a gold-decorated cart, a pair of red bows, a hundred red arrows, ten pairs of black bows, a thousand black arrows, a bottle of fragrant wine, a jade spoon and three hundred warriors.
The Marquis of Jin thanked him many times before finally bowing and accepting.
King Zhou wrote "The Order of the Marquis of Jin Wen": The king said: You use morality and justice to make the princes harmonious and show the achievements of King Wen and King Wu. King Wen and King Wu were able to carefully cultivate beautiful virtues, which moved heaven and spread among the people.
Therefore, God bestowed the emperor's career on King Wen and King Wu, and the favor was passed down to future generations.
My elders care about me and allow me to inherit the legacy of my ancestors and preserve the throne forever. So Jin Wengong became the hegemon, and on the day of Guihai, Prince Hu formed an alliance with the princes in the palace.
The Jin State burned the Chu army's positions, and the raging fire did not go out for several days. Duke Wen sighed.
The ministers on the left and right said: After defeating Chu, you are still worried. Why?

Besides, Ziyu is still here, how can I be happy?
Ziyu returned in defeat. King Chu Cheng complained that he did not listen to him and only focused on fighting Jin, so he blamed Ziyu and Ziyu committed suicide.
Duke Wen of Jin said: I attacked Chu from the outside, and Chu killed the generals from the inside, and the internal and external response was echoed.
Only then did Duke Wen look happy.
In June, the Jin people resumed their status as Weihou.
On Renwu day, the Marquis of Jin crossed the Yellow River and returned to the north.
Jin Wengong discussed meritorious deeds and rewarded them, and Hu Yan was the top meritorious one.
Some people say: The war in Chengpu was Xian Zhen's strategy.
Duke Wen said: During the war in Chengpu, Hu Yan advised me not to lose my credibility.
Xian Zhen said: The most important thing in fighting is victory. I won after listening to Xian Zhen's words.
However, this is only a temporary statement. Hu Yan is talking about the merits of thousands of generations. How can the benefits of a moment exceed the merits of thousands of generations?
Therefore, Hu Yan deserves the first credit.
In winter, the Marquis of Jin met with the princes in Wendi and wanted to lead the princes to meet King Zhou Xiang.
The Marquis of Jin was worried that he was not strong enough and that there might be traitors among the princes, so he sent someone to tell King Zhou Xiang to go hunting in Heyang.
On the day of Renshen, the Marquis of Jin led the princes to pay homage to King Xiang in Jiantu.
Confucius read history and saw this record about Duke Wen, saying: The princes have no right to summon the king of Zhou. The reason why I wrote this incident in the "Spring and Autumn Annals" as "The Emperor of Zhou was hunting in Heyang" is to keep it secret.
On Ding Chou day, the princes surrounded Xu.
Someone among Cao Bo's ministers advised the Marquis of Jin: "Qi Huan's alliance with the vassal states was to support the countries of the opposite sex. Now, the monarch, you are allying with the vassals to destroy the countries with the same surname."
The descendants of Shu Zhenduo of Cao State, and the descendants of Uncle Tang of Jin State.
He united the vassal states but destroyed Shi Di's state. Unbecoming etiquette.
The Marquis of Jin was happy and restored Cao Bo's status.
So the Jin State began to establish a three-marching military system.
Xun Lin's father led the middle march, Xian Gu commanded the right march, and Xian Mi commanded the left march.
In the seventh year, Duke Wen of Jin and Duke Mu of Qin besieged Zheng State together. The reason was that Zheng State was rude to Wen Gong when he passed by Zheng State when he was fleeing, and Zheng State aided Chu State in the Battle of Chengpu.
Jin State surrounded Zheng State and wanted to capture Shuzhan.
Shuzhan committed suicide after hearing about it.
The people of Zheng took Uncle Zhan's body and told the king of Jin.
But Jin Jun said: I will only be willing to get Zheng Jun.
The State of Zheng was afraid, so he secretly sent an envoy to Duke Mu of Qin, saying: "Destroy the State of Zheng and strengthen the State of Jin. Jin will gain something, but Qin will not gain much."
Why don't you give up the state of Zheng and become friendly with Zheng?
Uncle Qin agreed and withdrew his army, and Jin also withdrew its army subsequently.
In the winter of the ninth year, Duke Wen of Jin passed away, and his son Duke Xiang Huan came to the throne.
Uncle Zheng also passed away that year.
Someone in the state of Zheng betrayed his country to the state of Qin. Duke Mu of Qin led his army to attack the state of Zheng.
In December, the Qin army passed by the suburbs of the Jin capital.
In the spring of the first year of Xiang AD, the Qin army passed by the capital of Zhou and was very rude. Wang Sunman ridiculed Qin for not knowing etiquette.
When the Qin army arrived in the Hua Kingdom, Xian Gao, a great businessman from the Zheng state, was about to go to Zhou Jing to do business. He met the Qin army on the way and rewarded the Qin army with twelve cows.
The Qin army was shocked, thinking that Zheng Guo already knew about the sneak attack, so they hurried back to their country, and only after destroying Hua Guo by the way did they return.
Xian Zhen of the Jin State said: Uncle Qin did not listen to Uncle Jian's plan and violated the people's will. We can attack it at this time.
Luan Zhi said: It is impossible to attack Qin before repaying its kindness to the late emperor.
Xian Zhen said: The Qin State bullied me, who had just lost his father, and attacked the country with the same surname as ours. What kind of favor should we repay?
So Jin State attacked Qin State.
Duke Xiang wore black mourning uniform and entered the army.
In April, the Jin army defeated the Qin army in Confucius and captured the three Qin generals Meng Mingshi, Xiqiji, and Bai Yibing before returning to the Jin state.
So Duke Xianggang of Jin buried Duke Wen in black mourning clothes.
Duke Wen's wife was a woman from the state of Qin. She told Duke Xiang: "The state of Qin wants to get these three generals and kill them."
Duke Xiang agreed and sent back the three generals.
After Xian Zhen heard about it, he said to Duke Xiang: "A disaster is about to happen."
Xian Zhen went to chase the three generals.
The three generals crossed the Yellow River and got on the boat. When they saw Xian Zhen, they kowtowed and thanked him, and finally left without returning.
Three years later, the State of Qin sent Meng Ming to attack the State of Jin. In order to avenge the defeat in Confucius, he captured the territory of the State of Jin and then withdrew his troops.
In the fourth year, Duke Mu of Qin sent a large army to attack the state of Jin, crossed the Yellow River, captured the royal officials, and built the tombs of the fallen soldiers in Miao Mountain before leaving.
The Jin State was very panicked and did not dare to come out again, so they had to hold on to the city.
In five years, the Jin State attacked the Qin State and captured the new city, avenging the failure of the king's official position.
In the sixth year, Zhao Shuichengzi, Luan Zhenzi, Jiu Ji, Zifu and Huo Bo all died.
Zhao Dun replaced Zhao Shui in charge of government affairs.
In August of the seventh year, Duke Xiang passed away.
Prince Yigao is still young.
Because the people of Jin were in trouble many times, they chose an older king.

Yong Wen was kind and old, and the late emperor liked him. Moreover, he was close to Qin, which was originally a friendly neighboring country.
If you establish good people, the country will be stable; if you serve the elders, the country will be successful; if you serve the people your ancestors like, you will be filial; if you keep friends with old friends, the country will be stable.
Jia Ji said: Yong is not as happy as his brother.
Chen Ying is favored by the two monarchs. If she has a son, the people will feel at ease.
Zhao Dun said: Chen Ying is humble and his status is lower than the nine concubines. What prestige can his son have?
Besides, she is loved by two kings, which is chaos.
As the son of the late emperor, Le could not seek refuge in a big country but live in a small country. This would be isolation.
The mother is in chaos, the son is isolated and has no dignity; Chen is small and far away from Jin, and cannot get help. How can he be a king?
So Jin sent a scholar to Qin to meet Prince Yong.
Jia Ji also sent people to the state of Chen to recall Gongzi Le.
Zhao Dun deposed Jia Ji because Jia Ji killed Yang Chufu.
In the tenth month, the Jin State buried Duke Xiang.
In November, Jia Ji fled to Zhai.
That year, Duke Mu of Qin also passed away.
In April of the first year of the Ling Dynasty, Duke Kang of Qin said: When Duke Wen just returned to the Jin State, the Jin State had no guards to protect him, so the disasters of Lu Sheng and Qi Rui happened.
So, Qin sent many guards to Prince Yong.
Miao Ying, the mother of Prince Yigao, carried the prince to the court day and night, howling and crying, saying: "What is the crime of the late king?"
What sin do his heirs have?
You abandon your legitimate son and look for the monarch outside. Where do you plan to put the prince?
After Miao Ying left the court, he ran to Zhao Dun's residence with the prince in his arms, kowtowed and said: "The late king entrusted this child to you. He once said that this child will be successful. I just accepted your gift. If he is not, I will resent you."
Now that the late king has passed away, the words are still ringing in my ears, and now you want to abandon the prince, how can you do that?
Zhao Dun and other ministers were afraid of Miao Ying and were afraid of being persecuted, so they turned their backs on Yong who greeted him and established the crown prince Yigao, who was Duke Ling.
At the same time, troops were sent to resist the army of Qin escorting Gongzi Yong.
Zhao Dun became a general and led his army to attack Qin, and defeated the Qin army at Linghu.
He was disdainful first and then fled to Qin.
In the autumn, the kings of Qi, Song, Wei, Zheng, Cao, and Xu all visited Zhao Dun and made an alliance at Hu. This was because Duke Linggong had just ascended the throne.
In four years, Jin attacked Qin and captured Shaoliang, and Qin also captured Jin's Concubine.
In the sixth year, Duke Kang of Qin attacked Jin and captured Jima.

Qin sent Suihui to Wei, so he captured Suihui and brought him back to Jin.

This year, King Zhuang of Chu just ascended the throne.
In ten years, the people of Qi killed their own king Yigong.
In the fourteenth year, Duke Ling grew up and became very extravagant. He plundered people's wealth and used color paintings to decorate the palace walls.
Shooting people from a high platform and having fun watching people avoid the projectiles.

Suihui went to persuade him first, but Duke Ling didn't listen.
Duke Linggong was very worried and asked Chu Qi to assassinate Zhao Dun.

After saying that, he hit his head against a tree and died.
At the beginning, Zhao Dun often hunted in Shoushan and once saw a very hungry man under a mulberry tree.
This person's name is Shi Miming.
Zhao Dun gave him some food, but he only ate half of it.

Zhao Dun thought he was very filial and gave him some rice and meat.

He wanted Zhao Dun to leave before he could and avoid suffering.
