The ancestors of the Chu State came from Gaoyang, Emperor Zhuanxu.
Gao Yang is the grandson of Huangdi and the son of Changyi.
Gao Yang gave birth to Cheng, Cheng gave birth to Juan Zhang, and Juan Zhang gave birth to Chong Li.
Chongli became the Huozheng of Emperor Ku's Gaoxin family. He was very meritorious and could illuminate the world. Emperor Ku gave him the title of Zhu Rong.
The Gonggong clan launched a civil strife, and Emperor Ku asked Chong Li to kill the rebels, but he did not kill them all.
Emperor Ku killed Chongli on the day of Gengyin, and asked his younger brother Wu Hui to succeed Chongli and also take up the post of Huozheng, still called Zhurong.
Wu Hui gave birth to Lu Zhong.
Lu Zhong had six sons, all born by caesarean section.
The eldest son is called Kunwu, the second son is called Shenhu, the third son is called Pengzu, the fourth son is called Huiren, the fifth son is named Cao, the sixth son is named Jilian, and Jilian's surname is Mi. He is the ancestor of the Chu king's family.
Kunwu once served as Hou Bo during the Xia and Shang Dynasties, but was destroyed by Tang during the Jie Dynasty.
Peng Zu once served as Hou Bo during the Yin Dynasty. At the end of the Yin Dynasty, Peng Zu was destroyed.
Ji Lian gave birth to Fuju, and Fuju gave birth to Cave Bear.
His descendants declined midway. Some were in the Central Plains, and some were in barbarians, and history books failed to record their lineages.
During the reign of King Wen of Zhou Dynasty, there was a descendant of Ji Lian called Wan Xiong.
Wu Xiong served King Wen like a son and died young.
His son's name is Xiong Li.
Xiong Li gave birth to Xiong Kuang, and Xiong Kuang gave birth to Xiong Yi.
Xiong Yi was in the era of King Cheng of Zhou Dynasty. King Cheng wanted to use the descendants of the heroes of King Wen and King Wu, so he granted Xiong Yi the title of baron in Chu Man. His surname was Mi and he lived in Danyang.
Xiong Yi, the son of Chu, served the king together with Bo Qin, the Duke of Lu, Zi Mou, the uncle of Wei Kang, Xie, the Marquis of Jin, and Lu Ji, the prince of Qi.
Xiong Yi gave birth to Xiong Ai, Xiong Ai gave birth to Xiong Ai, and Xiong Ai gave birth to Xiong Sheng.
Xiong Sheng made his younger brother Xiong Yang his successor.
Xiong Yang gave birth to Xiong Qu.
Xiong Qu has three sons.
During the reign of King Zhou Yi, the Zhou royal family declined. Some princes refused to pay homage to the emperor, and the princes attacked each other.
Xiong Qu won the support of the people along the Yangtze River and Han River, so he sent troops to attack Yong and Yang Yue, all the way to Hubei.
Xiong Qu said: I am located in a barbarian land, so I don’t have to have the same names and posthumous titles as those of other countries in the Central Plains.
So he named his eldest son Xiong Kang King of Judan, his second son Xiong Hong as King of E, and his youngest son Xiong Zhizhen as King of Yue Zhang, all in the Chuman area along the Yangtze River.
When King Li of Zhou came to power, Xiong Qu was worried that King Li would attack Chu due to his violent temper, so he removed his title as king.
Xiong Qu's successor was his eldest son Xiong Wukang, who died early.
After Xiong Qu's death, his second son Xiong Zhihong came to the throne.
Zhihong's younger brother killed him and took the throne himself. This was Xiong Yan.
Xiong Yan gave birth to Xiong Yong.
In the sixth year of Xiong Yong's reign, the Zhou people provoked civil strife and attacked King Li, who was forced to flee to Pig.
Xiong Yong reigned for ten years, passed away, and his younger brother Xiong Yan succeeded to the throne.
Xiong Yan reigned for ten years and passed away.
Xiong Yan has four sons, the eldest son is called Bo Shuang, the second son is called Zhong Xue, the second son is called Shu Kan, and the younger son is called Ji Liu.
Xiong Yan passed away. The eldest son Bo Shuang came to the throne, this is Xiong Shuang.
In the first year of Xiong Shuang, King Xuan of Zhou just ascended the throne.
Xiong Shuang died after six years of reign, and his three younger brothers competed with each other for the throne.
Zhongxue died, Shukan fled to Pu, and his youngest brother Ji Liu came to the throne, this is Xiong Liu.
In the sixteenth year of Xiong's reign, Duke Huan of Zheng had just been granted a title to Zheng.
In the 22nd year, Xiong You passed away and his son Xiong Ji came to the throne.
Xiong Jie passed away in the ninth year of his reign, and his son Xiong Yi came to the throne. This is Ruao.
In the 20th year of Ruao Ao, King You of Zhou was killed by Quan Rong, the capital of Zhou moved eastward, and Duke Xiang of Qin began to become a vassal.
In the twenty-seventh year, Ruo Ao died and his son Xiong Kan came to the throne. This was Xiao Ao.
Xiao Ao died in the sixth year of his reign, and his son Xiong Zhen came to the throne. This is Fimao.
In the thirteenth year of Fu Mao's reign, the state of Jin began to be in turmoil because of Quwo.
Fu Mao died in the seventeenth year of his reign.
Fu Mao's younger brother Xiong Tong killed Fu Mao's son and ascended the throne. This was King Wu of Chu.
In the seventeenth year of King Wu's reign, Prince Quwo of Jin State killed Jin Xiaohou, the king of the suzerain state.
In the nineteenth year, Zheng Bo's younger brother Duan provoked civil strife.
In the twenty-first year, Zheng Guo invaded the emperor's fields.
In the twenty-third year, the people of Wei killed their king Huan Gong.
In the twenty-ninth year, the people of Lu killed their king Yin Gong.
In the thirty-first year of the Song Dynasty, Hua Du, the governor of the Song Dynasty, killed his own monarch Shang Gong.
In the thirty-fifth year, the Chu State attacked Sui State.
Sui Guojun said: I have no sin.
The King of Chu said: I am in a barbarian area.
Today, all the princes have betrayed the royal family, invaded and killed each other.
I have an army and want to use it to participate in the political affairs of the Central Plains. I request the Zhou royal family to respect my name.
The people of Sui went to the Zhou royal family to ask for a title on his behalf, but the Zhou royal family refused, so the people of Sui came back and reported to Chu.
In the thirty-seventh year, Chu Xiongtong said angrily: My ancestor Wu Xiong was the teacher of King Wen, but it was a pity that he died early.
King Zhou Cheng promoted my late grandfather, but only gave him the land with the title of baron and let him live in the Chu region. Now the barbarian tribes are submissive, but King Zhou still does not grant him a title, so I have no choice but to claim my title!
So he called himself King Wu and made an alliance with the people of Sui before withdrawing his troops.
From then on, he began to cultivate Pu land and occupy it.
In the fifty-first year, the king of Zhou summoned Sui Hou and scolded him for supporting the king of Chu to become king.
King Wu of Chu was very angry and thought that Sui Hou had betrayed him, so he attacked Sui.
King Wu died of illness on the march, and Chu State stopped its march.
King Wu's son King Wen Xiong Yu came to the throne, and the Chu State began to move its capital to Ying.
In the second year of King Wen's reign, the state of Chu attacked the state of Shen and passed by Deng. Deng's people said: It is easy to capture the king of Chu at this moment.
Deng Hou did not agree. In the sixth year, the Chu State attacked the Cai State, captured Cai Aihou, returned to the country, and soon released him.
The State of Chu became powerful and bullied the small countries in the Yangtze and Han River basins. The small countries were all afraid of the State of Chu.
In the eleventh year, Duke Huan of Qi began to dominate, and the state of Chu also began to become powerful.
In the twelfth year, the Chu State attacked the Deng State and destroyed the Deng State.
In the thirteenth year, King Wen passed away and his son Xiong Jin came to the throne. This is Zhuang Ao.
In the fifth year of Zhuang Ao's reign, he wanted to kill his younger brother Xiong Yun. Xiong Yun fled to Sui, attacked and killed Zhuang Ao with his followers, and became king.
In the first year of the reign of King Cheng Yun, as soon as he came to the throne, he extended kindness and morality to the people and restored the old friendly relations among the princes.
He sent people to pay tribute to the emperor, and the emperor rewarded him with meat. Said: Take good care of the turmoil in the Yiyue region in your south, and do not invade the Central Plains.
So the Chu State expanded to a thousand miles in radius.
In the 16th year, Duke Huan of Qi sent troops to invade the state of Chu, all the way to Xingshan.
King Cheng of Chu asked General Qu Wan to lead his army to resist, and made an alliance with Duke Huan of Qi.
Duke Huan scolded King Chu Cheng for not paying tribute to the Zhou royal family. King Chu Cheng agreed and he withdrew his troops from Chu.
In the eighteenth year, King Cheng led his army to attack the state of Xu in the north. The king of Xu State took off his shirt and exposed his arms to plead guilty, and King Cheng of Chu released him.
In the twenty-second year, Chu State attacked Huang State.
In the twenty-sixth year, Chu State destroyed Britain.
In the thirty-third year, Duke Xianggong of the Song Dynasty wanted to form an alliance with the princes and summoned King Cheng of Chu to attend.
The King of Chu said angrily: "How dare you summon me? I will go with a friendly attitude, and then take the opportunity to attack and insult him."
So the King of Chu sent troops to Yu, arrested and humiliated Song Xianggong, and soon let him return to his country.
In the thirty-fourth year, Zheng Wengong went south to pay homage to the King of Chu.
King Chu Cheng went north to attack the Song Dynasty, defeated the Song army at Hongshui, and shot and wounded Song Xianggong. Xianggong died of the arrow wound soon after.
In the thirty-fifth year of the Jin Dynasty, Chong'er, the prince of Jin Dynasty, passed through the state of Chu. King Cheng entertained Chong'er according to the etiquette of entertaining guests from princes, gave Chong'er many gifts, and escorted him to the state of Qin.
In the 39th year, Duke Xi of Lu asked Chu State to send troops to attack Qi State. Chu State sent Marquis Shen to lead an army to attack Qi State, captured the valley, and settled Qi Huangong's son Yong in the valley.
The seven sons of Duke Huan of Qi all fled to the State of Chu, and all of them in the State of Chu worshiped them as senior officials.
The Chu State destroyed Kui because Kui did not sacrifice to Zhu Rong and Wan Xiong.
In the summer, Chu State attacked Song State. Song State asked Jin State for help. Jin State sent troops to rescue Song State. King Chu Cheng had to give up and return to Chu State.
General Ziyu asked to continue fighting, and King Cheng said: Chong'er has been on the run for many years and finally returned to Jin. God is blessing him and cannot stop him.
Ziyu resolutely asked for a battle, so King Chu Cheng left with only a small army.
As expected, Jin defeated Ziyu in Chengpu. King Chu Cheng was very angry and killed Ziyu.
In the forty-sixth year, at first, King Cheng planned to establish Shang Chen as the crown prince and told Ling Yin Zishang.
The Master said: Your Majesty is still young, and you have many lovely wives and concubines. If you establish the crown prince now, he may be deposed in the future, and the country will be in trouble. The crown prince of Chu State is often born to his young son.
Moreover, the merchant's eyes were like poisonous bees and his voice was like that of a jackal. He was an extremely cruel person and it was not suitable for him to be crown prince.
The King of Chu refused to listen and finally appointed Shang Chen.
Later, the King of Chu wanted to establish the position of son, and abandoned the prince and merchant.
Shang Chen heard some rumors but had not confirmed it, so he told his teacher Pan Chong: How can we get the real situation?
Pan Chong said: Treat Jiang Miji, whom King Cheng loves, but do not respect her.
The merchants followed his plan.
Jiang Mi said angrily: The king wants to kill you and make you the crown prince.
The merchant told Pan Chong: The king really wants to depose me and replace me with another official.
Pan Chong asked: Can you serve?
The merchant replied: No!
Can you escape from here?
The merchant replied: No.
Can you do what it takes to kill a king? The merchant replied: Yes.
In October of winter, the merchants asked the palace guards to surround King Cheng. King Cheng asked to eat bear paws before dying, but the merchants refused. On the day of Ding Wei, King Cheng hanged himself.
Shang Chen came to the throne, and this was King Mu.
After King Mu ascended the throne, he gave Pan Chong his royal palace and made him the grand master to preside over state affairs.
In the third year of King Mu, Chu State was destroyed by Jiang State.
In four years, the Chu State destroyed the Six Kingdoms and the Liao Kingdom.
6. The king of Liao is a descendant of Gaotao.
In the eighth year, Chu State attacked Chen State.
In the twelfth year, King Mu passed away.
His son Zhuang Wanglu came to the throne.
King Zhuang has been on the throne for three years. He has never issued any political orders to the country. He has had fun day and night. He also issued an edict to the country: Anyone who dares to remonstrate will be killed!
Wu Ju entered the palace to admonish him.
King Zhuang holds Zheng Ji in his left hand and Yue Nu in his right hand, sitting among the singers and dancers.
Wu Ju said: I hope to give you a hidden word.
Then he said: There was a bird that landed on the mountain. It did not fly or sing for three years. What kind of bird was it?
King Zhuang said: If you don't fly for three years, you will soar into the sky; if you don't sing for three years, you will become a blockbuster.
Go down, I know what you mean.
After a few months, King Zhuang became even more lewd and indulgent.
Su Cong, the doctor, went to the palace to give advice.
King Zhuang of Chu said: Didn't you hear my edict?
Su Cong replied: It is my long-cherished wish to sacrifice myself to make you wise.
The king of Chu then stopped his lewdness and pleasure and began to handle government affairs. He killed hundreds of criminals, promoted hundreds of meritorious ministers, and appointed Wu Ju and Su Cong to manage government affairs, which was supported by the whole country.
At that time, the state of Chu was destroyed.
In six years, Chu State attacked Song State and obtained 500 chariots.
In the eighth year, the Chu State attacked Lu Hunrong and arrived at Luo, where they held a military parade on the outskirts of the Zhou capital.
King Zhou Ding sent Wang Sunman to reward King Chu.
The King of Chu asked Wang Sunman about the size of the tripod. Wang Sunman replied: Ruling a country depends on whether the government is virtuous, not on the size of the tripod.
King Zhuang said: Don't rely on owning Jiuding!
The state of Chu only had to destroy the tip of the sword to make the Jiuding. Wang Sunman said: Hey!
Has the king forgotten this?
In the past, when the Yu and Xia Dynasties were prosperous, all the remote countries came to pay tribute, and asked the chiefs of Kyushu to pay tribute to the metal and cast it into a Jiuding. Many mountains and rivers were painted on it, and all kinds of weird things were there, so that the people could know the harm done by the weird things.
Jie's morals deteriorated, so Ding was moved to the Yin Dynasty, which lasted for six hundred years.
King Zhou of Yin was cruel and violent, and Ding was moved to the Zhou Dynasty.
If the emperor's moral character is good, the tripod, although small, will be too heavy to move; if the emperor's moral character is corrupt, the tripod, no matter how heavy it is, will be easy to move.
In the past, King Cheng of Zhou placed the Jiuding in Jiaxuan, and divination said that it could be passed down to thirty generations and establish the country for seven hundred years. This was God's will.
Although the Zhou royal family is declining now, God's will is difficult to change.
The importance of Jiuding cannot be asked.
The king of Chu then withdrew his troops and returned home.
In the ninth year, King Zhuang of Chu made Ruo'ao the prime minister.
Someone slandered him in front of King Zhuang. He was afraid of being killed, so he attacked King Zhuang instead. King Zhuang killed the entire Ruao family.
In the thirteenth year, Chu State destroyed Shu State.
In the sixteenth year, the Chu State attacked the Chen State and killed Xia Zhengshu of the Chen State.
Because Zhengshu killed his own king, Chu killed him.
After capturing Chen State, Chu State designated it as its own county.
All the ministers celebrated the victory, except Uncle Shen who had just returned from a mission to Qi State who did not celebrate.
King Zhuang asked him why, and Uncle Shen replied: As the saying goes, if you lead a cow straight to someone else's field, the owner of the field will snatch the cow away.
It is indeed wrong to take cattle into other people's fields, but isn't it too much to take cattle away?
Of course, King Zhuang, you led the princes to attack it because of the turmoil in Chen State. You clearly had a reason to attack it, but you greedily classified it as one of your own counties. How can you order the world in the future?
King Zhuang then restored the status of the descendants of Chen State.
In the spring of the seventeenth year, King Zhuang of Chu surrounded the State of Zheng and captured it in three months.
Entering Zhengdu from the imperial gate, Zheng Bo took off his shirt, exposed his arm and held a sheep to greet King Zhuang, saying: I am not blessed by God and cannot serve you. You are angry because of this and come to our country. This is my sin.
How dare I not obey orders!
You can abandon me to the South China Sea, or reward me as a slave to the princes, and I will obey your orders.
If you do not forget King Zhou Li, King Xuan, Duke Huan of Zheng, and Duke Wu, and do not stop the sacrifices of their countries, let me serve you. This is my wish, and I dare not have such extravagant hopes.
Just boldly confess to you.
The ministers of Chu State all said: Your Majesty, don't agree to him.
King Zhuang said: If Lord Zheng is so humble, he will definitely be able to use his people. How can we cut off his sacrifice?
After saying this, King Zhuang personally raised the military flag, and the people on his left and right commanded the army. He led the army back thirty miles and settled down, and then agreed to make peace with the king of Zheng.
Doctor Zheng Pan Guo came to make a treaty, and Ziliang went to the state of Chu to be a hostage.
In June of summer, the Jin State rescued the Zheng State and fought with the Chu State. The Chu State defeated the Jin army on the bank of the Yellow River. The Chu State did not return until Hengyong.
Twenty years later, Chu State besieged the capital of Song Dynasty because Song State killed the Chu State envoy.
The Chu State besieged the capital of Song Dynasty for five months, and the food in the capital was exhausted. People exchanged the flesh and blood of their parents and children for food, and split human bones to be used as firewood.
Hua Yuan of Song State went out of the city to tell the Chu army the truth.
King Zhuang said: This is a gentleman!
So he withdrew his troops and left.
In the twenty-third year, King Zhuang died, and his son, King Gong Shen, came to the throne.
In the sixteenth year of King Gong's reign, the State of Jin attacked the State of Zheng.
The state of Zheng asked for help from the state of Chu, and the king of the Communist Party sent troops to rescue the state of Zheng.
The Chu army and the Jin army fought at Yanling. The Jin army defeated the Chu army and shot the king of the Communist Party of China in the eye.
The king of the Communist Party summoned the general to rebel.
Zi Fan was greedy for the cup, and his attendant Shu Yanggu tried to persuade Zi Fan to drink wine, but Zi Fan got extremely drunk.
The king of the Communist Party was furious, shot the rebels to death, and then withdrew his troops and returned to the country.
In the thirty-first year, King Gong died, and his son King Kang came to the throne.
King Kang died fifteen years after he ascended the throne, and his son Yuan came to the throne, this is Jia Ao.
King Kang had his favorite younger brothers, Gongziwei, Zibi, Zixi and Qiji.
In the third year of his reign, Jia Ao appointed his uncle, Prince Kang's younger brother Gong Ziwei, as Ling Yin, in charge of military affairs.
In the fourth year, the young master Wei went to the state of Zheng as an envoy. On the way, he heard that the king of Chu was ill and returned to the state of Chu.
On the day of Jiyou in the twelfth month, the prince surrounded the palace to inquire about King Chu's condition. He actually strangled King Chu to death with his hatband. He also killed King Chu's son Mo Pingxia and sent envoys to the state of Zheng to report the funeral.
Wu Ju asked the envoy: "Who will take the throne?"
The messenger replied: I am surrounded by widowed officials and young masters.
Wu Ju corrected him and said: Gongziwei, the son of the king of Gong, is the eldest.
Zibi fled to Jin, and Prince Wei came to the throne. He was King Ling of Chu.
In June of the third year of King Ling's reign, the Chu State sent envoys to inform the Jin State that they wanted to meet with the princes.
The princes all gathered in Shenyi of Chu State.
Wu Ju said: In the past, there was a banquet in Juntai in Xia Qi, a scene in Shangtang and Bo Gaoming, King Wu of Zhou had an alliance to swear an oath, King Cheng had a hunting meeting in Qiyang, King Kang had a pilgrimage in Feng Palace, King Mu had a meeting in Tushan, Duke Huan of Qi had a meeting in Zhaoling, and Duke Wen of Jin had an alliance in Jiantu. What kind of etiquette do you plan to use?
King Ling said: Use Duke Huan of Qi.
At that time, Zichan of the state of Zheng was present, but Jin, Song, Lu, and Wei did not participate in the meeting of Shen.
After King Ling made an alliance with the princes, he looked arrogant.
Wu Ju said: Jie still met because of You, but You Min betrayed him.
King Zhou met at Mount Li, and Dongyi betrayed him.

Why don't you lead your army back to Chu to show kindness and kindness? This is the strategy of staying in a high position forever!
Zhaoyang said: Okay!
So he led his army and left Qi. The kings of Yan and Korea began to proclaim themselves kings.
The State of Qin sent Zhang Yi to meet Chu, Qi, and Wei and make an alliance at Nosang.
In the eleventh year, Su Qin and the six kingdoms of Shandong agreed to jointly attack Qin, with King Chu Huai as the commander.
When the army reached Hangu Pass, Qin sent troops to attack. All the armies of the six countries withdrew, but the Qi army was the last to retreat.
In the twelfth year, King Min of Qi defeated the coalition forces of Zhao and Wei. Qin also defeated the Korean army and competed with Qi to become the overlord.
In the 16th year, the state of Qin wanted to attack the state of Qi, but the state of Chu and the state of Qi were on friendly terms. King Qin Hui was worried about this situation, so he threatened to remove Zhang Yi from the post of prime minister, and asked Zhang Yi to meet with the king of Chu. He said to the king of Chu: The king of our country likes you the most, even if I particularly hope to be the master of the janitor, there is no one more than the king; the king of our country hates no more than the king of Qi, and even I hate the king of Qi the most.
But your Majesty has a close relationship with him, so the king of our country cannot serve you, which makes me unable to be your janitor.
If the King of Chu can close the gate and sever diplomatic relations with Qi for me, then today you will send envoys to follow me to Qin to collect the Shangyu land with a radius of 600 miles from Chu that Qin once captured. This will weaken the power of Qi.
In this way, you can weaken the state of Qi in the north, be kind to Qin in the west, and increase the wealth of Shang's land of six hundred miles. This is really killing three birds with one stone.
King Huai was very happy, so he gave Zhang Yi the jade seal of the Prime Minister, held banquets for him every day, and declared that I had my Shang Yu again.
The ministers all congratulated, but Chen Zhen expressed his sadness.
King Huai said: Why?
Chen Zhen replied: The reason why the State of Qin values ​​you, the King, is because you are friendly and friendly with the King of Qi.
Today, severing relations with Qi before we can get the land of commerce is an approach to isolate Chu.
How can Qin value our country, which is isolated and helpless? It must despise Chu.
If Qin surrenders Shang Yu first, and then we break off diplomatic relations with Qi, then Qin's strategy will be ineffective.
If we break off diplomatic relations with Qi first and then ask for Shang Yu, we will definitely be deceived by Zhang Yi.
If you are deceived by Zhang Yi, you will definitely resent him.
Resenting him is equivalent to raising Qin's worries in the west and cutting off Qi's friendship in the north.
There are worries about Qin in the west, and diplomatic relations with Qi are severed in the north, so the armies of Han and Wei will definitely attack.
So I'm hurting.
The King of Chu did not listen to Chen Zhen's advice, so he sent a general to Qin to accept Shang Yu.
Zhang Yi returned to the state of Qin, pretended to be drunk and fell under the car, claiming to be ill. He did not show up for three months, and the state of Chu could not get the land for business.
The King of Chu said: Could it be that Zhang Yi thought that my severance of relations with Qi was not thorough enough?
So he sent the warrior Song Yi to the north to insult the King of Qi.
The king of Qi was furious and broke the talisman of Chu to become friendly with Qin.
After the alliance between Qin and Qi was completed, Zhang Yicai went to court and said to the general of Chu: Why haven't you accepted the land yet?
From somewhere to somewhere, there is a radius of six miles.
The general of Chu State said: I was ordered to accept six hundred miles, but I have never heard of six miles.
Immediately return to Chu and report to King Huai.
King Huai was furious and wanted to send troops to attack Qin.
Chen Zhen added: "It is not the best policy to attack Qin."
It is better to take the opportunity to bribe Qin with a famous city and unite with Qin to attack Qi. This way, what was lost from Qin can be compensated by Qi. In this way, our country can still be preserved.
Today, you have severed diplomatic relations with Qi and have launched an army to investigate Qin's crime of deception. This is tantamount to us allowing Qin and Qi's friendship to attract armies from all over the world. Our country will definitely be greatly harmed.
The King of Chu still refused to listen to Chen Zhen's advice, so he broke off diplomatic relations with Qin and sent troops to the west to attack Qin.
Qin also sent troops to attack the Chu army.
In the spring of the seventeenth year, the Chu army fought with the Qin army in Danyang. The Qin army defeated our army, killed 80,000 soldiers, captured the Chu general Qu Gai, the partial general Feng Hou Chou and more than 70 people, and captured various counties in Hanzhong.
King Huai of Chu was very angry and used all the troops in the country to attack Qin again. The two armies fought in Lantian, and the Chu army was defeated again.
When Han and Wei heard that Chu was trapped, they both went south to attack Chu and fought all the way to Deng.
After Chu heard the news, he led his troops to withdraw from Qin.
In the eighteenth year, Qin sent envoys to make an agreement with Chu to make peace with Chu, and gave half of Hanzhong's territory to Chu for reconciliation.
The King of Chu said: I am willing to get Zhang Yi, but not the land.
Zhang Yi heard what King Chu said and asked to go to Chu.
The King of Qin said: The King of Chu is just trying to catch you and is satisfied. What should I do?
Zhang Yi said: I am friendly with Jin Shang, the minister of the King of Chu. Jin Shang is also trusted by the King of Chu's favored wife Zheng Xiu. The King of Chu is completely obedient to Zheng Xiu. Moreover, when I was on a mission to the Chu State, I violated the agreement to cede business to Chu. Today, there is hatred in the war between Qin and Chu. I cannot eliminate the hatred unless I personally apologize to the Chu State.
Besides, as long as your Majesty is still alive, the State of Chu will not dare to do anything to me.
Sure enough, if Chu State kills me, as long as it is beneficial to Qin State, it is also the wish of the ministers.
Zhang Yi then went on a mission to Chu.
After Zhang Yi arrived in the capital of Chu, King Huai did not see him and imprisoned Zhang Yi to kill him.
Zhang Yi secretly bribed Jin Shang, and Jin Shang asked King Huai on his behalf: If you arrest Zhang Yi, the King of Qin will be angry.
The princes of the world will definitely despise you when they see that Chu has lost the friendship of Qin.
Jin Shang then said to Zheng Xiu, the wife of the King of Chu: The King of Qin liked Zhang Yi very much, but the King of Chu wanted to kill him. Now the King of Qin will use the six counties of Shangyong to bribe the Chu State, and send the beauties to the King of Chu, and the beauties in the palace who are good at singing and dancing will be given to the King as maids.
The King of Chu valued territory, so Qin's daughter must have been favored by the King of Chu, so his wife must have been ostracized.
Madam, why don't you say a nice word in front of the King of Chu to release Zhang Yi.
Zheng Xiu finally expressed his love for Zhang Yi in front of King Chu and released Zhang Yi. After Zhang Yi was released, King Huai entertained Zhang Yi very politely, and Zhang Yi took the opportunity to persuade King Chu to betray the alliance, join forces with Qin, and arrange a marriage between the two countries.
After Zhang Yi left Chu State, Qu Yuan had just returned from Qi State as an envoy. He went to remonstrate with King Huai and said, "Why don't you kill Zhang Yi?"
King Huai then regretted and sent people to chase Zhang Yi, but it was already too late.
This year, King Qin Hui passed away.
In the twenty-sixth year, King Min of Qi wanted to be the leader of a joint alliance and hated the alliance between Chu and Qin, so he sent an envoy to the King of Chu with a letter saying: I am worried that the King of Chu has not considered the honorable title.
Today, King Hui of Qin died and King Wu came to the throne. Zhang Yi fled to Wei. King Wu appointed Chu Liji and Gongsun Yan, but Chu still obeyed Qin.
Qiliji is friendly with Han, and Gongsun Yan is friendly with Wei. Chu will definitely serve Qin, but Han and Wei are afraid, and will definitely use the power of these two people to unite with Qin. Then Yan and Zhao will also serve Qin.
四国争服事秦国，那么楚国就成了秦国的一个郡县了。

Why doesn't the King of Chu know that I have worked together to conquer Han, Wei, Yan, and Zhao, and work with them to respect the Zhou royal family, so that we can support the people with troops and command the world?
No one in the world dares to obey you and you will become famous.
At that time, the King of Chu will lead the princes to attack Qin together, and they will definitely defeat Qin.
King of Chu, you can seize the Wuguan, Shu, and Han regions, occupy the wealth of Wu and Yue, and exclusively enjoy the interests of the Yangtze River and the East China Sea. South Korea and Wei will cede Shangdang to you, and approach Hangu Pass in the west. Then Chu will be a million times stronger than it is now.
Moreover, Your Majesty, you were deceived by Zhang Yi, lost the territory of Hanzhong, and your army was defeated in Lantian. Everyone in the world is angry for you.
Today you actually want to serve Qin first!
I hope you will consider it carefully.
The King of Chu was about to unite with the State of Qin. When he saw the letter from the King of Qi, he hesitated and handed it over to the ministers for discussion.
Some said they would unite with Qin, while others said they would listen to Qi's advice.
Zhaoju said: Although the king obtained territory from the Yue Kingdom in the east, it was not enough to avenge his shame. It is better for you to have deep relations with Qi and South Korea to elevate Qiliji's power. In this way, you can get the support of South Korea and Qi to seize the land.
Qin defeated South Korea in Yiyang, but South Korea still served Qin because the tomb of its ancestors was in Pingyang. Qin's Wu Sui was only seventy miles away from Pingyang, so South Korea was especially afraid of Qin.
Otherwise, if Qin attacks Sanchuan, Zhao attacks Shangdang, and Chu attacks beyond the Yellow River, Han will definitely perish.
Chu's rescue of South Korea would not save South Korea from disaster, but it was indeed Chu who saved South Korea in name.
South Korea has captured Wu Sui from Qin. With the barriers of the Yellow River and the Western Mountains, the favors it has to repay are not as generous as those of Chu. I think South Korea must eagerly serve the King of Chu.
The reason why Qi State trusted South Korea was because Han Gongzi was the Prime Minister of Qi State.
South Korea has captured Wu Sui from Qin. No matter how good the king is to it, it will use the power of Qi and South Korea to raise the status of Qiliji. If Qiliji gets the support of Qi and South Korea, his master will not dare to abandon him.
Today, the Chu State can help him again. Qiliji will definitely intercede with the King of Qin and return the land that was occupied by the Chu State to the Chu State.
So King Huai agreed to him, and finally did not unite with Qin, but united Qi and became friendly with South Korea.
In the twenty-fourth year, Chu betrayed Qi and united with Qin.
As soon as King Zhao of Qin came to the throne, he bribed the state of Chu with generous gifts.
The state of Chu went to the state of Qin to marry a woman.
In the twenty-fifth year, King Huai went to Qin to make an alliance with King Zhao of Qin, and they made an agreement at Huangji.
The King of Qin returned Shangyong of Chu State to Chu State.
In the twenty-sixth year, Qi, South Korea, and Wei allied with Qin because Chu violated the alliance and goodwill, and the three countries jointly attacked Chu.
The state of Chu asked the prince to be a hostage in the state of Qin to ask for help.
The state of Qin sent Ke Qingtong to lead an army to rescue the state of Chu, and the three kingdoms left with their armies.
In the twenty-seventh year, a senior official of the Qin State had a fight with the Prince of Chu over personal matters. The Prince of Chu killed him and fled back to the State of Chu.
In the twenty-eighth year, Qin, Qi, South Korea, and Wei jointly attacked Chu, killed Chu general Tang Mei, captured Chu's heavy hills, and left.
In the twenty-ninth year, Qin attacked Chu again and defeated the Chu army, killing more than 20,000 Chu soldiers and killing Chu general Jing Que.
King Huai was frightened and sent the prince to Qi as a hostage to seek reconciliation.
Thirty years later, Qin attacked Chu again and captured eight cities.
King Zhao of Qin sent a letter of credence to the King of Chu, saying: You and I were sworn brothers at the beginning. During the Huangji Covenant, the Chu State sent the prince as a hostage, and our relationship was very harmonious.
But the prince killed my important minister and escaped without apologizing. I was really angry and sent troops to invade your border.
Today I heard that you asked the prince to be a hostage in Qi State to seek reconciliation.
Our country and Chu State border on each other and have been married to each other for a long time.
Now that the relationship between Qin and Chu has deteriorated, it is impossible to order the princes.
I hope to meet you in Wuguan and form an alliance, and then separate after we enter into an alliance. This is my wish.
I take the liberty of telling you this idea.
King Huai of Chu was very worried when he saw King Qin's letter.
If you want to go to the meeting, you are worried about being deceived; if you don't want to go, you are worried that King Qin will be angry.
Zhaoju said: Your Majesty, please do not go forward. You should send troops to strengthen the defense of the border.
Qin is a country of tigers and wolves. We cannot believe that it has the ambition to annex the princes.
King Huai's son Zilan persuaded King Huai to go, saying: "Why do you cut off the friendship with King Qin?"
So King Huai went to meet King Zhao of Qin.
As soon as the King of Chu arrived, the Qin soldiers closed Wuguan and took King Huai to Xianyang. The King of Qin met with King Huai in Zhangtai and treated King Huai like a minister of a vassal country, without equal etiquette.
King Huai of Chu was furious and regretted not listening to Zhaoju's advice.
The King of Qin detained the King of Chu and threatened Chu to cede the counties of Wu and central Guizhou to Qin.
The King of Chu wanted to just make an alliance, while the King of Qin wanted to get the territory first.
The King of Chu was angry and said: Qin deceived me and forced me to cede territory!
He did not agree to play the king again.
The king of Qin therefore detained the king of Chu.
The ministers of Chu State were very worried and discussed with each other: Our king stayed in Qin and could not come back. The King of Qin used this to threaten us to cede the land, and the prince was a hostage in Qi State. If Qi and Qin jointly planned, Chu State would be destroyed.
So the ministers wanted to make King Huai's son in the capital the king.
Zhaoju said: "The king and the prince are both trapped in the vassal states. Today, it is inappropriate to violate the king's order and establish a concubine."
So he deceived the State of Qi and sent envoys to the State of Qi to report the funeral. King Min of Qi said to the Prime Minister: It is better to detain the prince in order to obtain Huaibei from Chu State.
The Prime Minister said: No, if a new king is established in Yingzhong, we will keep hostages and do unjust things in front of the people of the world. Someone said: No.
If a new king is established in Yingzhong, he will take the opportunity to make a deal with the new king and say: If you give us the East Kingdom, we will kill the prince for you. Otherwise, we will join forces with Qin, Han and Wei to support the prince. In this way, Xiedongguo will definitely be obtained.
The King of Qi finally adopted the Prime Minister's strategy and sent back the Prince of Chu.
After the prince returned to Chu, he was established as king. This was King Qingxiang.
So the Chu people announced to the Qin State: "Depend on the gods of Sheji, our country has a king."
In the first year of King Heng of Qingxiang, the state of Qin threatened King Huai but could not get the territory. The state of Chu established a king to deal with the state of Qin. King Qin Zhao was very angry and sent troops out of Wuguan to attack the state of Chu. He defeated the Chu army and killed 50,000 Chu soldiers. He captured fifteen cities including Xiyi and left the state of Chu.
In the second year, King Huai of Chu escaped. When Qin found out, he blocked the road to Chu. King Huai was afraid, so he borrowed a road back to Chu from Zhao.
The father of Zhao was here, and his son, King Hui, had just ascended the throne and took over the duties of King Zhao. He was too timid to accommodate King Chu.
The King of Chu wanted to run to the State of Wei, but Qin soldiers caught up with him. The King of Chu had to return to the State of Qin with the envoys of the State of Qin.
At this time, King Huai fell ill.
In the third year of King Qingxiang's reign, King Huai died in Qin. The state of Qin sent his coffin back to the state of Chu.
The people of Chu State felt sorry for the king, just like they mourned the loss of their own parents and brothers.
From then on, the princes saw that King Qin was not upright. Qin Chu broke off diplomatic relations.
In the sixth year, Qin sent Bai Qi to attack South Korea and won a great victory at Yique, killing 240,000 South Korean soldiers.
The King of Qin wrote a letter of state to the King of Chu, saying: The State of Chu has betrayed the State of Qin, and the State of Qin will lead the armies of the princes to attack the State of Chu to decide the outcome.
I hope you regroup your army for a good fight.
King Qingxiang of Chu State was very worried and planned to make peace with Qin State again.
Seven years later, Chu State went to Qin State to welcome the bride, and Qin and Chu made peace again.
In the eleventh year, the kings of Qi and Qin each proclaimed themselves emperors, and one month later, they changed the title of emperor to king.
In the fourteenth year, King Qingxiang of Chu and King Zhao of Qin had a friendly meeting in Wan and concluded a goodwill contract.
In the fifteenth year, Chu State, Qin State, Han State, Zhao State, and Wei State jointly attacked Qi State and captured Huaibei.
In the 16th year, King Chu and King Zhao of Qin had a friendly meeting in Yan.
In the autumn of that year, he was with King Rang of Qin again.
In the eighteenth year, there was a man in the Chu State who liked to shoot wild geese returning from the north with a thin bow and a thin rope. After hearing about this, King Qingxiang called him to ask about his shooting experience.
He replied: I like to shoot geese and birds. This is the function of small arrows. How can it be worth telling the king?
Moreover, with the vast land of Chu State and the wiseness of the king, the ones he shot were not just these geese and birds.
In the past, the three kings took the title of morality, and the five hegemons took the title of warlike country.
Therefore, Qin, Wei, Yan, and Zhao are small geese; Qi, Lu, Han, and Wei are small wild ducks; Zou, Fei, Tan, and Pi are small birds. The rest just aren't worth shooting.
Seeing these six pairs of birds, how do you shoot them?
Why don't you use saints as bows and warriors as arrows? Why don't you draw your bow and shoot at the right time?
Then, you can carry these six pairs of birds back to the palace in your pocket.
This kind of fun is by no means a one-time joy, and this kind of gain is definitely not a prey like wild ducks and geese.
In the morning, you open your bow and arrow to shoot at the southern part of Daliang in Wei State. Injuring his right arm will directly affect South Korea. Then the access to the Central Plains will be cut off, and the counties and counties in Shangcai will be destroyed.
Turn back and shoot at the east side of Yu, cutting off Wei's left arm, and then shoot Dingtao outwards. Then the eastern part of Wei will be given up, and the two counties of Song Dynasty and Fang Yu will be captured.
Moreover, if the left and right arms of Wei are cut off, they will fall; if they attack Tan from the front, they can seize and occupy the main beams.
You gathered your bows and arrows in Lantai, drank your horses in Xihe, and stabilized the beams of Wei. This is the joy of archery for the first time.
If you are really fond of archery and are not tired of it, then take out your treasure bow, replace it with stone arrowheads and new ropes, go to the East China Sea to shoot big birds with hooked beaks, turn back and rebuild the Great Wall as a defense line, shoot Dongju in the morning, Ciqiu in the evening, seize Jimo at night, turn around and occupy the Meridian Road, then you can capture the east side of the Great Wall and the north side of Taishan.
It borders Zhao State in the west and Yan State in the north. In this way, the three kingdoms of Chu, Zhao and Yan are like birds spreading their wings, forming a union without any covenant.
When you go to the north, you can visit Liaodong of Yan State, and when you go to the south, you can climb mountains and see Kuaiji of Yue State in the distance. This is the joy of shooting arrows again.
As for the princes of the twelve kingdoms in Sishang, if you pull them with your left hand and slap them with your right hand, you can take possession of them in one morning.
Now Qin's defeat of South Korea has actually become a long-term worry, because Qin has captured many cities in South Korea and cannot hold them; Qin's attack on Wei has no effect, and it is worried about attacking Zhao. Then Qin and Wei's courage and strength have been exhausted, and it turns out that Hanzhong, Xi, and Li lost by Chu can be regained.
King Chu, you take out your treasured bow, replace it with stone arrowheads and new ropes, set foot in the fortress, and wait until Qin is tired, then you can capture Shandong and Hanoi and complete Chu.
In this way, you can comfort the people, recuperate the soldiers, and you can face the south and become king.
Therefore, Qin is a big bird, living with its back on the mainland, standing facing the east, close to the southwest of Zhao on the left, and close to Chu on the right. Facing South Korea and Wei, it wants to monopolize the Central Plains. Its position is advantageous, and the terrain is favorable. It can soar with wings spread over a radius of three thousand miles. It can be seen that Qin cannot capture it alone and shoot in one night.
This man wanted to anger King Xiang, so he answered King Chu with these words.
As expected, King Xiang called him again to talk with him in detail, so he said: The late king was deceived by Qin and died in a foreign country. There is no greater resentment than this.
Now, because an ordinary person has resentment and uses a country as the target of revenge, this is Bai Gong and Wu Zixu.
Today, the Chu State has a radius of five thousand miles and has a million troops. It could have galloped across thousands of miles of wilderness, but it sat back and waited for death. I thought your king would not do this.
Therefore, King Qingxiang sent envoys to the vassal states to renew their agreement to attack Qin.
When Qin heard the news, he sent troops to attack Chu.
Chu wanted to join forces with Qi and South Korea to attack Qin and take the opportunity to plot against the Zhou Dynasty.
King Nan of Zhou sent Duke Wu to say to Chu Prime Minister Zhaozi: The Three Kingdoms used force to divide the suburbs of the Zhou capital for easier transportation, and transported treasures south to honor the King of Chu. I think it is wrong to do so.
If you kill the king respected by all the princes and make the king who has been passed down from generation to generation as your subjects, the big countries will definitely not get close to it. With the large number of people threatening the weak Zhou Dynasty, small countries will definitely not obey it.
If a big country doesn't get close to it and a small country doesn't obey, it can neither gain prestige nor gain substantial benefits.
If you can't gain fame or wealth, you shouldn't use force to harm the people.
If you have the reputation of plotting against the Zhou Dynasty, you will not be able to issue orders to the princes.
Zhaozi said: The plans for the Zhou Dynasty are made out of nothing.
Even so, why couldn't the Zhou Dynasty make plans?
Duke Wu replied: You can't attack unless you have five times the enemy's strength, and you can't besiege the city unless you have ten times the enemy's strength.
One Zhou Dynasty is equivalent to twenty Jin Kingdoms, as you know.
South Korea once deployed 200,000 troops to surround the city of Jin, but in the end it suffered humiliation. Elite soldiers died in battle, ordinary soldiers were injured, and Jincheng was not captured.
You don't have a hundred times the military strength of Han, but you plot against the Zhou Dynasty. This is known to everyone in the world.
You have developed a grudge against Zhou Zhou, hurt the hearts of the people of Zou Lu, a land of etiquette, severed relations with Qi, and lost your reputation in the world. It is very dangerous for you to do so.
Your harm for two weeks is to strengthen South Korea's strength. Outside Fangcheng, it will definitely be invaded by South Korea.
How could one know this outcome?
The territory of the Western Zhou Dynasty was cut off to make up for the shortcomings, with a radius of no more than a hundred miles.
The Western Zhou Dynasty was a monarch respected by all the princes in the world. In fact, occupying all its land was not enough to make the country strong, and occupying all its people was not enough to strengthen its military strength.
Even if you don't attack it, you still kill the monarch in honor.
However, monarchs who do good things and ministers who enjoy achievements always point the finger at the Zhou Dynasty when issuing orders and using military force.
What is the reason for this?
Because they saw the sacrificial vessels in Zhou Dynasty, they wanted to take possession of the sacrificial vessels, but they were so stupid that they forgot the crime of killing the monarch.
Today, South Korea is moving the sacrificial vessels to Chu State. I am worried that people in the world will hate Chu State because of the sacrificial vessels.
Let me give you an analogy.
Tiger meat is smelly, its claws and teeth are good for self-defense, and people still arrest it.
If the elk in the big swamp were covered in tiger skin, people would arrest it ten thousand times more than the tiger.
Possessing the land of Chu is enough to make the country strong; condemning the reputation of Chu is enough to make the monarch noble.
Today, you are going to kill the king respected by all the princes in the world, take possession of the treasures passed down from three generations, swallow up the nine tripods, and look down upon all the kings. Isn't this greed?
"Book of Zhou" says that if you want to get started in politics, you should not initiate chaos first. Therefore, if the sacrificial vessels were moved south to the Chu State, large armies would follow.
So Chu State gave up its original plan.
In the 19th year, Qin attacked Chu. The Chu army was defeated and ceded Shangyong and Hanbei to Qin.
Twenty years later, Bai Qi, the general of Qin State, captured Xiling of Chu State.
In the 21st year, Bai Qi, the general of Qin State, captured Ying of Chu State and burned Yiling, the tomb of the late king.
King Chu Xiang's army was defeated and could no longer fight, so he retreated to the northeast and defended Chencheng.
In the 22nd year, Qin State captured Wu County and Qianzhong County of Chu State.
In the twenty-third year, King Xiang gathered the soldiers from the east, a total of more than 100,000 people, and went west to capture the fifteen cities on the Yangtze River that Qin had captured, and divided them into counties to resist Qin.
In the twenty-seventh year, Chu sent 30,000 men to help the Three Jins attack Yan.
Chu made peace with Qin again and asked the prince to serve as a hostage in Qin.
The state of Chu asked Zuo Tu to serve the prince in the state of Qin.
In the thirty-sixth year, King Qingxiang fell ill, and the prince fled back to Chu. In autumn, King Qingxiang died, and prince Xiong Yuan came to the throne. This was King Kaolie.
King Kaolie appointed Zuo Tu as his Ling Yin and granted him the title of Lord Chunshen of Wu.
In the first year of King Kaolie's reign, he gave the state to Qin in order to make peace with Qin.
At this time, the state of Chu was getting weaker and weaker.
In the sixth year, the State of Qin surrounded Handan. The State of Zhao asked the State of Chu for help. The State of Chu sent the late general Jingyang to rescue the State of Zhao.
In seven years, Chu State invaded Xinzhong.
The Qin army left.
In the twelfth year, King Zhao of Qin passed away, and the King of Chu asked Chun Shenjun to come to Qin to express his condolences.
In the 16th year, King Zhuangxiang of Qin passed away, and King Zhao Zheng of Qin came to the throne.
In the twenty-second year, the Chu State and the vassal states jointly attacked the Qin State, failed in the battle and withdrew their troops.
The Chu State moved its capital eastward to Shouchun, which was called Ying.
In the twenty-fifth year, King Kaolie passed away, and his son You Wanghan came to the throne.
Li Yuan killed Chun Shenjun.
In the third year of King You, Qin and Wei attacked Chu.
Lu Buwei, the prime minister of Qin, passed away.
In the ninth year, Qin destroyed South Korea.
In the tenth year, King You passed away, and his younger half-brother, You, came to the throne. This was King Ai.
More than two months after King Ai came to the throne, the gangsters of King Ai's brother, Fu Chu, attacked and killed King Ai, and made Fu Chu king of Chu.
At that time, Qin captured Zhao Wangqian.
In the first year of Wang Fuchu's reign, Prince Dan of Yan sent Jing Ke to assassinate the King of Qin.
In the second year, Qin sent generals to attack Chu, defeated the Chu army and captured more than ten cities.
In three years, Qin State destroyed Wei State.
In the fourth year, the Qin general Wang Jian defeated the Chu army in Qi and killed the general Xiang Yan.
In the fifth year, the Qin generals Wang Jian and Meng Wu invaded the capital of Chu, captured the Chu king Fu Chu, destroyed the Chu state, and established three counties in Chu.
Tai Shigong said: When King Ling of Chu gathered the princes in Shen, killed Qi Qingfeng, built Zhanghua Terrace, and asked for the nine tripods of the Zhou royal family, he had lofty ambitions and looked down on the world. When he died of starvation at Shenhai's house, he was ridiculed by the people of the world.
It is really sad that we have not gained integrity and character!
Can people be careless about power?
Abandoning illness to create civil strife and ascending the throne, favoring the women of Qin was too much, and almost caused the country to perish again!
summary:
The ancestors of the Chu State originated from Gaoyang, Emperor Zhuanxu, who was the grandson of Huangdi. The lineage passed through several generations to Chongli, who served as Huozheng under Emperor Ku and was granted the title Zhurong. After Chongli failed to completely suppress the Gonggong rebellion, Emperor Ku executed him and appointed his younger brother Wu Hui as his successor. Wu Hui fathered Luzhong, who had six sons by caesarean section. The youngest son, Jilian, whose surname was Mi, became the ancestor of the Chu royal family. Jilian's descendants included Yuxiong, who served King Wen of Zhou like a son but died young.

During King Cheng of Zhou's reign, Yuxiong's descendant Xiong Yi was granted the title of baron in the Chu Man region with Danyang as his residence. Xiong Yi served the Zhou king alongside other noble descendants. The lineage continued through several generations until Xiong Qu, who gained support from people along the Yangtze and Han Rivers. He conquered territories including Yong and Yangyue, and declared his three sons kings of various regions in the Chu Man area. When King Li of Zhou ascended, Xiong Qu removed his kingly title out of fear.

After several successions and internal conflicts, Xiong Tong killed his nephew and ascended the throne as King Wu of Chu. He declared himself king after the Zhou royal family refused to grant him a higher title, stating that his ancestor had served King Wen and that the Zhou had only given his family a baron's title in the Chu region. King Wu attacked Sui and died of illness during the campaign. His son King Wen Xiong Yu moved the capital to Ying. Under King Wen, Chu attacked Shen, Cai, and Deng, becoming powerful and intimidating smaller states in the region.

King Cheng Xiong Yun extended kindness to the people and restored relations with other states. He expanded Chu's territory to a thousand miles in radius. When Duke Huan of Qi invaded Chu, King Cheng made an alliance with him. King Cheng later captured and humiliated Duke Xiang of Song, attacked Song, and entertained the Jin prince Chong'er. After Chong'er returned to Jin, Chu's general Ziyu was defeated at Chengpu, and King Cheng executed him. King Cheng initially established Shang Chen as crown prince despite warnings about his cruel nature. When King Cheng planned to replace him, Shang Chen surrounded the palace, and King Cheng hanged himself.

King Mu Shang Chen ascended and destroyed several states. His son King Zhuang Lu initially indulged in pleasure but reformed after remonstrance from Wu Ju and Su Cong. King Zhuang attacked Lu Hunrong, paraded troops near the Zhou capital, and asked about the Nine Tripods. Wang Sunman replied that ruling depends on virtue, not tripods, and that the Zhou dynasty's mandate was difficult to change. King Zhuang withdrew. He later attacked Chen, captured it, but restored it after Shen Shu's advice. He besieged Zheng, accepted its surrender, and defeated Jin at the Yellow River. He besieged Song for five months until its people resorted to cannibalism, then withdrew.

King Gong Shen was defeated by Jin at Yanling and shot in the eye. After several successions, King Ling Xiong Wei gathered the princes, built Zhanghua Terrace, and asked about obtaining the Zhou tripod. He became arrogant but faced rebellion when his brother Qiji conspired with Guan Cong. King Ling's soldiers abandoned him, and he died of starvation at Shen Hai's house. Qiji ascended as King Ping, who deceived and killed two kings to gain the throne. He extended favors to the people, returned territories, and improved governance.

King Ping listened to Fei Wuji's slander against Prince Jian, imprisoned Wu She, and forced Prince Jian to flee. Wu She's son Wu Zixu escaped to Wu. King Ping married the woman intended for Prince Jian and fathered Xiong Zhen, who became King Zhao. Fei Wuji's slander caused Prince Jian's exile and Wu She's execution. King Zhao fled when Wu invaded, and Wu Zixu desecrated King Ping's tomb. King Zhao eventually returned with Qin's help.

King Hui was kidnapped by Bai Gongsheng but rescued by Ye Gong. After several more successions, King Huai was deceived by Zhang Yi into breaking relations with Qi, then attacked Qin and was defeated. He was later tricked into meeting King Zhao of Qin, who detained him. King Huai died in Qin, causing Chu to break relations with Qin. King Qingxiang moved the capital eastward as Qin captured Chu territories. The Chu state continued to weaken, eventually moving its capital to Shouchun. Qin generals Wang Jian and Meng Wu captured the Chu king, destroyed the state, and established three commanderies in Chu territory.

Liu Jiao, King of Chu Yuan Dynasty, was the younger half-brother of Emperor Gaozu. His courtesy name was You.
There were four Gaozu brothers, the eldest brother was a famous uncle, and his uncle had died long ago.
When Gao Zuwei was a child, in order to avoid trouble, he often passed by his sister-in-law's house to have dinner with guests.
The eldest sister-in-law hated her brother-in-law. When the uncle and guests came to the house, the eldest sister-in-law pretended that she had finished the soup and scraped the pot with a spoon, so the guests left.
Later, when he saw that there was still soup in the pot, Emperor Gaozu resented his sister-in-law from then on.
When Emperor Gaozu became emperor, he divided his brothers into feudal lords, except for the eldest brother's son.
The Emperor interceded for his grandson, and Emperor Gaozu said: It's not that I forgot to confer him a title, because his mother is so unlike her elders.
So her son Xin was granted the title of Genjiehou.
He named his second brother Zhong as acting king.
In the sixth year of Emperor Gaozu's reign, after arresting King Han Xin of Chu in Chen County, he made his younger brother King of Chu and made his capital Pengcheng.
Jiao died in the 23rd year of his reign, and his son Ying, King of Yi, succeeded him.
King Yi died in the fourth year of his reign and was succeeded by his son Wang Wu. Twenty years after Wang Wu took the throne, in winter, he committed a private crime during the mourning period for Empress Dowager Bo, and the fiefdom of Donghai County was cut off.
In the spring of the next year, Wu conspired with the King of Wu to rebel, but his prime minister Zhang Shang and Taifu Zhao Yiwu tried to stop him and refused to listen.
Wu killed Zhang Shang and Zhao Yiwu, raised an army and went westward with King Wu to attack Liang State, and captured Jibi.
He went to the south of Changyi and engaged the Han general Zhou Yafu.
The Han army cut off the food routes of the Wu and Chu armies, and the soldiers were hungry. King Wu was defeated, King Wu of Chu committed suicide, and the Wu and Chu armies surrendered to the Han army.
The Han army had put down the rebellions of Wu and Chu. Emperor Xiaojing wanted Dehou Guang's son to inherit the throne of Wu and King Yuan's son Li to inherit the throne of Chu.
Empress Dowager Dou said: King Wu is of the older generation and should be loyal to the clan and do good deeds.
Now he is leading the rebellion of the Seven Kingdoms and disrupting the world. Why should he continue his descendants!
It is not allowed to establish the descendants of the King of Wu, but only the descendants of the King of Chu.
At that time, Li was the Zongzheng of the Han Dynasty, so Li was named King of Chu and enshrined in the ancestral temple of King Yuan. This was King Wen of Chu.
King Wen died three years after he took the throne, and his son An Wangdao succeeded him.
King An died in the 22nd year of his reign, and his son Jian Wangzhu succeeded him.
King Xiang died in the fourteenth year of his reign, and his son Wang Chun succeeded him.
After Wang Chun succeeded to the throne, in the second year of Dijie, the eunuchs complained to the King of Chu of rebellion. The King of Chu committed suicide, the country's title was abolished, and the fiefdom was returned to the Han Dynasty and changed to Pengcheng County.
Zhao Wang Liu Sui, his father ranked in the middle among Gaozu's sons, was famous as a friend, and his posthumous name was "You".
King You died of sorrow, so his posthumous name was You.
Empress Gao made Lu Lu the king of Zhao, and Empress Gao died a year later.
The ministers executed Lu Lu and other Lu family members, and then made King You's son King of Zhao.
In the second year after Emperor Xiaowen came to the throne, Li Sui's younger brother Piqiang cut off the Hejian County of Zhao State and became the King of Hejian. This was King Wen.
He died in the thirteenth year of his reign and was succeeded by his son Ai Wangfu.
Fu died in the first year, without any children, and had no descendants. The title of the country was abolished, and the fiefdom was returned to the Han Dynasty.
Sui had been king of Zhao for twenty-six years. During the reign of Emperor Xiaojing, Chao Cuo deprived him of Changshan County because of his negligence.
Wu and Chu rebelled, and King Zhao conspired with them to raise troops.
His prime minister, Jian De, and his internal history king fiercely resisted and refused to obey.
He burned Jiande and Wang Han to death, and stationed troops on the western border of Zhao State, hoping to wait for the Wu army to advance westward.
He also sent people to the Xiongnu in the north, hoping to unite with the Xiongnu to attack the Han Dynasty.
The Han Dynasty sent Quzhou Hou Liji to attack Zhao.
King Zhao then retreated and defended Handan. They faced off for seven months. The Wu and Chu armies were defeated in Liang State and could not advance westward.
When the Xiongnu heard the news, they also stopped sending troops and refused to enter the Han border.
After Luan Bu returned from the front line where he defeated Qi, he joined forces with Li Ji to divert water to the capital of Zhao.
Zhao's capital city was destroyed by water, King Zhao committed suicide, and Handan surrendered.
King Zhao You cut off his descendants.
Tai Shigong said: When a country is about to rise, there must be auspicious omens. Gentlemen will be valued and villains will be dismissed.
When the country is about to perish, the wise men retire and the treacherous officials become dignified.
If King Wu of Chu did not punish Duke Shen and listened to his words, how could King Zhao appoint Mr. Fang Yu to have a conspiracy to usurp him and be killed by everyone in the world?
Wise man! Wise man!
How can a king who is not inherently virtuous use you?
So important! The safety of the country depends on the decrees issued, and the survival of the country depends on the ministers appointed. This is so true.

Liu Jiao, King of Chu Yuan, was the younger half-brother of Emperor Gaozu. As a child, Gaozu often brought guests to his sister-in-law’s house for meals. She resented him and once scraped the pot to pretend no soup was left, causing guests to leave. Gaozu later saw soup remained, fostering resentment. When he became emperor, he enfeoffed his brothers but initially excluded his eldest brother’s son, citing the mother’s unworthiness, though he later granted the son the title of Genjiehou. His second brother Zhong was made acting king. In the sixth year of his reign, after arresting King Han Xin of Chu, Gaozu made Jiao King of Chu, with his capital at Pengcheng. Jiao reigned 23 years, succeeded by his son Ying, then grandson Wang Wu. Wu, during mourning for Empress Dowager Bo, committed a private crime, losing Donghai County. The next spring, Wu conspired with the King of Wu to rebel. His prime minister Zhang Shang and Taifu Zhao Yiwu opposed him; Wu killed them and marched west with the King of Wu, attacking Liang and capturing Jibi. At Changyi, they fought General Zhou Yafu. The Han army cut off Wu and Chu’s food routes; starving, the King of Wu was defeated, and the King of Chu committed suicide. Their armies surrendered. Emperor Xiaojing initially wanted to restore their descendants, but Empress Dowager Dou opposed it for the King of Wu. Only the King of Chu’s descendant, Li, then Zongzheng, was named King Wen of Chu. He reigned three years, succeeded by An Wangdao, then Jian Wangzhu, then Wang Chun. In the second year of Dijie, eunuchs accused Chun of rebellion; he committed suicide, and Chu’s territory became Pengcheng County.

Zhao Wang Liu Sui, a son of Gaozu, was posthumously named You. King You died of sorrow. Empress Gao made Lu Lu King of Zhao; after her death, ministers executed the Lu clan and made King You’s son king. In Emperor Xiaowen’s second year, Sui’s younger brother Piqiang became King Wen of Hejian. He reigned 13 years, succeeded by Ai Wangfu, who died heirless, ending the kingdom. Sui ruled Zhao for 26 years. During Emperor Xiaojing’s reign, Chao Cuo deprived him of Changshan County. When Wu and Chu rebelled, King Zhao conspired with them. His prime minister Jian De and internal history Wang Han resisted; he burned them to death and stationed troops on Zhao’s western border, awaiting the Wu army. He also sought Xiongnu aid. The Han sent Quzhou Hou Liji to attack Zhao. King Zhao defended Handan for seven months. After Wu and Chu were defeated, Xiongnu withdrew. Luan Bu, returning from Qi, joined Liji to divert water against Zhao’s capital. The city fell; King Zhao committed suicide, and his line ended.

Tai Shigong remarked: A rising nation shows auspicious signs, with valued gentlemen and dismissed villains. A perishing nation sees wise men retreat and treacherous officials rise. Had King Wu of Chu heeded Duke Shen, or King Zhao appointed Mr. Fang Yu, they might have avoided usurpation and death. A king without inherent virtue cannot use wise men. The nation’s safety depends on decrees and appointments—this is profoundly true.
