Duke Huan of Zheng was the youngest son of King Zhou Li and the younger brother of King Zhou Xuan.
Twenty-two years after King Xuan ascended the throne, Youcai was granted the title of Zhengdi.
He was sealed for thirty-three years, and the people all loved him.
King You appointed him as Situ.
He made the people of Zhou Dynasty live in harmony, and the people were very happy. People in the Yellow River and Luoshui basins missed him.
When he was a Situ for a year, because King You doted on Bao Si and neglected political affairs, the problems became difficult to recover. Some princes betrayed King You. So Huan Gong asked Tai Shibo: "The royal family is in serious disaster. How can I escape from death?"
Tai Shibo replied: Only the east of Luoshui and the south of the Yellow River can live in peace.
Duke Huan asked: Why?
Tai Shibo replied: The kings of the neighboring countries of Guo, Hao, Guo and Hao in that area were greedy and liked to take advantage of small things, so the people did not obey them.
Now, you are Situ, and the people love you. If you really ask to live in that area, the kings of Guo and Hao will easily give you land if they see that you are legitimate.
If you really live in that area, the people of Guo and Hao will be your people. Duke Huan: I want to live in the Yangtze River Basin in the south. How about it?
Taishi replied: In the past, Zhu Rong controlled fire for the Gao Xin family and made great contributions, but his descendants did not prosper in the Zhou Dynasty. Chu State is his descendant.
If the Zhou royal family is weak, Chu will surely prosper.
If the state of Chu prospers, it will definitely not be beneficial to the state of Zheng.
Duke Huan said; I want to live in the west, how about it?
Tai Shibo replied: The people there are greedy and profit-seeking, and it is difficult to live there for a long time.
Duke Huan said: If the Zhou royal family is weak, which country will prosper?
Tai Shibo replied: Qi, Qin, Jin, Chu, right?
Qi State, whose surname was Jiang, was a descendant of Boyi, who assisted Yao in managing the ceremonial system.
Qin, whose surname is Ying, is a descendant of Boyi, who assisted Shun in bringing many tribes into submission.
As for the ancestors of the Chu State, they have also established meritorious deeds for the people of the world.
After King Wu of Zhou defeated King Zhou, King Cheng granted the Tang Dynasty to Shuyu. The mountains and rivers there were dangerous. With these virtuous descendants coexisting with the weak Zhou family, the Jin Kingdom would definitely be able to prosper. Duke Huan said: OK.
So he quickly asked King You for instructions and moved his people to the east of Luoshui. As expected, the kings of Guo and Xi donated ten cities to him, and he finally established the state of Zheng.
In the second year, Quan Rong killed King You and Duke Huan at the foot of Mount Li.
The people of Zheng supported Duke Huan's son Jutu, who was Duke Wu.
In the tenth year of Duke Wu's reign, he married the daughter of Marquis Shen as his wife, named Wu Jiang.
Wu Jiang gave birth to the prince Wusheng, but it was difficult to deliver the baby. After the birth, his wife did not like Wusheng.
Later, Wu Jiang gave birth to a younger son, Shu Duan, who was born naturally. His wife loved Shu Duan very much.
In the twenty-seventh year, Duke Wu fell ill. His wife asked him to make Duan the crown prince, but Duke Wu refused.
At that time, Duke Wu passed away and Wansheng came to the throne. This was Duke Zhuang.
In the first year of Emperor Zhuang's reign, Duke Zhuang granted his younger brother Uncle Duan a title to the capital, and he was known as Taishu.
Ji Zhong said: The capital is larger than the capital, so it cannot be granted to a younger brother.
Duke Zhuang said: Wu Jiang wants to do this, and I dare not object.
Uncle Duan arrived in Beijing, reorganized his military equipment, and conspired with his mother Wu Jiang to attack Zhengdu.
In the twenty-second year, Shu Duan attacked Zhengdu, and Wu Jiang acted as an internal response.
Duke Zhuang sent troops to attack Shu Duan. Duan fled and Duke attacked the capital. The people in the capital betrayed Shu Duan. Shu Duan had no choice but to flee to Yan.
The people of Yanyi fled. Uncle Duan had no choice but to flee to the Republic of China.
So Zhuang Gong moved his mother Wu Jiang to Chengying and swore that he would not see her until he came to Huangquan.
More than a year later, Duke Zhuang regretted what he had said and missed his mother very much.
Uncle Kao from Yinggu presented a gift to Duke Zhuang, and Duke Zhuang gave her food.
Uncle Kao said: I have an old mother. Please give food to my mother.
Duke Zhuang said: I miss my mother very much, but I hate breaking my oath. What should I do?
Uncle Kao said: Control the tunnel to a place with spring water, and then you mother and son can meet.
So Zhuang Gong followed his method and finally saw his mother.
In the twenty-fourth year, Duke Mu of Song died, and his son Feng fled to Zheng.
Zheng Guo invaded Zhou's fields and seized the crops in the fields.
In the twenty-fifth year of the year, Zhouxu of Wei State killed his own king Huan Gong and ascended the throne, and joined forces with Song State to attack Zheng State because Zheng State accepted Gongzi Feng.
In the twenty-seventh year, Zheng Juncai paid homage to King Huan of Zhou. King Huan was angry with Zheng for grabbing crops and did not treat him according to etiquette.
In the twenty-ninth year, Duke Zhuang was angry that King Huan of Zhou did not treat him courteously, so he deliberately used Qi to exchange the land of Lu State, which was close to Xu State.
In the thirty-third year, the Song Dynasty killed Confucius' father.
In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Zhuang did not pay homage to King Huan of Zhou, so King Huan led Chen, Cai, Guo, and Wei to attack Zheng.
Zhuang Gong, Ji Zhong, and Gao Qumi sent out troops to attack and defeated King Huan's army. Zhu Yu shot King Huan in the arm.
Zhu Yu asked to continue pursuing King Huan, but Duke Zhuang stopped him and said: If you violate an elder, you will be punished, let alone insulting the emperor.
Then Zhu Yu stopped chasing.
Duke Zhuang sent Ji Zhong late at night to inquire about King Huan's arrow wound.
In the thirty-eighth year, Beirong attacked the state of Qi. The state of Qi sent envoys to the state of Zheng to ask for help. The state of Zheng sent Prince Hu to lead the army to rescue the state of Qi.
Duke Qi wanted to marry his daughter to Prince Hu. Hu resigned and said: Our country is a small country and it is not suitable to match the big country of Qi.
At that time, Ji Zhong was with the prince and persuaded the prince to agree to the marriage, saying: Our king of Zheng has many beloved concubines. The prince will not be able to ascend the throne without the help of the Taiguo. All three princes can become kings.
The three young masters mentioned by Ji Zhong include Prince Hu, his younger brother Tu, and his younger brother Zi Qian.
Forty-three years later, Duke Zhuang of Zheng passed away.
At first, Ji Zhong was favored by Duke Zhuang. Duke Zhuang asked him to be a minister. Duke Zhuang asked Ji Zhong to marry a beautiful woman from Deng State for him and gave birth to Prince Hu. Therefore, Ji Zhong made Hu the king. This is Duke Zhao.
Duke Zhuang once married a woman from the Yong family of the Song Dynasty and gave birth to Li Gongtu.
Women of the Yong family are very favored by the monarch.
When Duke Zhuang of Song Dynasty heard that Ji Zhong supported Hu, he sent someone to trick Ji Zhong into arresting him, and threatened him: If you don't make Tu the king, you will be executed.
The king of Song also arrested Tu Qiu for taking bribes.
Ji Zhong agreed to the Song Dynasty and swore an alliance with the Song Dynasty king.
He was going to take Tu Tu back to his country and make Tu Tu his king.
Duke Zhao suddenly heard that Ji Zhong had proclaimed his younger brother Tu as king due to threats from the Song Dynasty. On Dinghai in the ninth month, he suddenly fled to the Wei Kingdom.
On the day of Jihai, he suddenly came to Zhengdu and took the throne. This was Duke Li.
In the fourth year of Li Gong's reign, he offered sacrifices to Zhong Zhuanquan.
Duke Li was concerned about this matter and secretly asked Ji Zhong's son-in-law to kill Ji Zhong.
Yong Jiu's wife was Ji Zhong's daughter. When she found out about this, she asked her mother: Which one is closer, father or husband?
The mother said: There is only one father, but there are many choices for husbands!
Ji Zhongnu told Ji Zhong about this, but Ji Zhong killed Yong Jiu and exposed his body in the busy market.
Duke Li was helpless with Ji Zhong, but he was very angry with Yong Jiu, saying: After discussing with the woman, he deserved to die. In the summer, Duke Li was driven to live in Queyi on the border.
Ji Zhong welcomed Zhao Gonghu, and on Yihai day in the sixth month, Hu returned to Zhengdu and ascended the throne.
In the autumn, Duke Li of Zheng relied on the people of the city to kill Uncle Shan, the official of Liyi, and settled in Liyi.
When the princes heard that Duke Li had escaped, they attacked Zheng Guo, but they left without defeating Zheng Guo.
The State of Song gave Duke Li a large number of troops and asked him to stand guard in Liyi. Therefore, the State of Zheng stopped attacking the city.
In the second year of Duke Zhao, when Duke Zhao became the crown prince, his father, Duke Zhuang, wanted to make Gao Qumi his minister. The prince suddenly disliked Gao Qumi. Duke Zhuang did not listen to Hu's advice and finally made Qumi his minister.
When Zhaogong came to the throne, Qumi was worried that Zhaogong would kill him. On Xinmao day in October in winter, Qumi and Zhaogong went hunting and shot Zhaogong in the countryside.
Ji Zhong and Qu Mi did not dare to accept Duke Li, so they made Zhao Gong's younger brother Zi Qi the king instead, and they called him Zi Qi. He had no posthumous title.
In the seventh month of the first year of Ziqian, Duke Xiang of Qi met with the princes at the first stop. Zheng Ziqian went to the meeting, assisted by Gao Qumi, who followed Ziqian there. Ji Zhong excused himself from illness.
The reason why Ji Zhong did this was because Zi Qi once fought with Xianggong of Qi when he was a prince, and the two sides became enemies. When the princes met, Ji Zhong asked Zi Qi not to go.
Zi Qian said: The state of Qi is strong and Duke Li lives in Yue. If I don't go, Qi will lead the princes to attack me and ask Duke Li to return to the capital.
Why don't I go there? Why will I be humiliated? And why will I end up in the situation you imagined?
Zi Qian finally went there.
Ji Zhong was worried that Qi would kill Zi Qian and his followers, so he claimed to be ill.
When Zi Qian arrived, he did not apologize to the Marquis of Qi. The Marquis of Qi was very angry, so he set up an ambush and killed Zi Qian.
Gao Qumi fled back to the state of Zheng, discussed with Ji Zhong, and called Zi Qi's younger brother Gong Ziying from the state of Chen to support him as the king. This was Zheng Zi.
That year, Duke Xianggang of Qi asked his son Peng Sheng to kill Duke Huan of Lu by breaking his ribs while he was drunk.
In the eighth year of Zheng Zi, the governor of Qi State, Zhifu, and others rebelled and killed their own monarch, Duke Xiang.
In the twelfth year of the Song Dynasty, Wan Chang, a man of the Song Dynasty, killed his own king Min Gong.
This year, Zheng Guojizhong passed away.
In the fourteenth year, the people who had fled to Liyi with Duke Li of Zheng sent someone to trick him into taking the official's leave, and coerced him to help Duke Li return to the capital to restore his throne.
Fu Ji said: Forgive me, I will kill Zheng Zi for you and let you return to the capital.
After Duke Li made a covenant with him, he released him.
On the Jiazi Day in the sixth month, Fu falsely killed Zheng Zi and his two sons, and ushered in Li Gongtu, who came back from Yue to ascend the throne.
At the beginning, there was a fight between a snake in the south gate of Zhengdu and a snake outside the city, and the snake in the city died.
Six years later, Duke Li came back again.
After Duke Li returned to Zhengdu, he blamed his uncle and said: I lost my country and went to live outside the capital, but my uncle has no intention of accepting me. This is too much.
Yuan said: Serving the king cannot have two minds. This is the duty of a minister.
I know the sin.
After that, he committed suicide.
Duke Li then said to Fu Jiu: You have two intentions in serving the king.
So he killed him.
When he was about to die, he pretended to regret and said: "It's just right that I didn't repay Zheng Zi for his great virtue and ended up like this!"
In the first year after Li Gongtu was restored to power, Qi Huangong began to dominate.
In the fifth year, the states of Yan and Wei, together with King Zhou Hui's younger brother Dai, attacked King Zhou Hui. King Hui fled to Wen, and his younger brother Dai ascended the throne as King of Zhou.
In the sixth year, King Hui appealed to the State of Zheng for help. Duke Li led an army to attack Prince Dai of Zhou, but failed to win. So Duke Li and King Hui of Zhou withdrew to the State of Zheng, and King Hui lived in Yue.
In the spring of the seventh year, Duke Li of Zheng and Uncle Guo jointly attacked and killed Prince Dai and escorted King Hui to the capital of Zhou.
In the autumn, Duke Li died, and his son Duke Wen ascended the throne.
Just four years after Li Gong took the throne, he fled to live in Yue. He lived in Yue for seventeen years and then returned to Zhengdu. He reigned for seven years, which together with the time of escape, totaled twenty-eight years.
In the seventeenth year of Duke Wen, Duke Huan of Qi led his army to defeat the State of Cai, and then attacked the State of Chu, all the way to Zhaoling.
In the twenty-fourth year, Duke Wen had a concubine named Yan Ji. She dreamed that the Emperor of Heaven gave her an orchid and said: I am Bo Min.
I am your ancestor.
Use this orchid to be your son. The orchid has a strong and mellow aroma.
Yan Yan told Wen Gong about this dream, and Wen Gong slept with her. And gave her bluegrass as a voucher.
So Yan Ji gave birth to a son, named Lan.
In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Chong'er of Jin passed by the state of Zheng, and Duke Wen of Zheng was not polite to him.
Uncle Zhan, Wen Gong's younger brother, said: "Chong'er is a wise man and has the same surname as us. He passed by you when he was in poverty. You cannot be rude to him."
Duke Wen said: "There are many fugitive princes from the princes passing by here. How can I receive them according to the courtesy?"
Uncle Zhan said: "If you don't treat him politely, kill him. If you don't kill him, if he returns to the country, he will be a worry to the state of Zheng."
Duke Wen did not listen to Uncle Zhan's advice.
In the spring of the thirty-seventh year, Duke Chong'er of Jin returned to Jin and ascended the throne. He was Duke Wen of Jin.
In the autumn, the State of Zheng invaded the State of Hua, and the State of Hua only obeyed Zheng's orders. Soon, the State of Hua joined the State of Wei, so the State of Zheng attacked the State of Hua again.
King Zhou Xiang asked Bo Fu to intercede on behalf of the Hua Kingdom. Zheng Wengong resented King Hui for fleeing to Yue. It was Wen Gong's father, Li Gong, who escorted King Hui back to the throne. However, King Hui did not reward Duke Li with a salary for the throne. He also resented King Xiang for joining the Wei Kingdom and the Hua Kingdom. Therefore, Wen Gong did not listen to King Xiang's intercession for the Hua Kingdom and instead imprisoned Bo Fu.
King Xiang was very angry and united with the Zhai people to attack Zheng State, but failed to win.
In winter, the Zhai people attacked King Xiang of Zhou, and King Xiang fled to Zheng State. Zheng Wengong asked King Xiang to live in Chi.
In the thirty-eighth year, Duke Wen of Jin sent King Xiang of Zhou back to Chengzhou.
In the forty-one year, Zheng Guo helped Chu State attack Jin State.
Because Jin Wengong passed by Zheng and Zheng was rude to him, Zheng betrayed Jin and helped Chu.
Forty-three years ago, Duke Wen of Jin and Duke Mu of Qin jointly besieged the capital of Zheng. They attacked Jun Zheng for helping Chu to attack Jin, and Wen Gong passed by Jun Zheng for his rude crime.
At the beginning, Zheng Wengong had three wives and five beloved sons, all of whom died early due to their crimes.
Zheng Wengong hated Zi Xia and drove away the princes.
Zilan fled to Jin and followed Duke Wen of Jin to besiege Zhengdu.
At that time, Zilan served Duke Wen of Jin with great respect, and Duke Wen of Jin favored him very much. He acted secretly in Jin and took the opportunity to ask to return to Zheng to be the crown prince.
At this time, the state of Jin wanted to get Shu Zhan and kill him.
Duke Wen of Zheng was very frightened and did not dare to tell Uncle Zhan. When Uncle Zhan heard about this, he told Zheng Jun: I once told you that I wanted to kill Chong'er, but you didn't listen to me. Jin has finally become a worry for our country.
But the reason why Jin State besieged the capital of Zheng was because of me. If I die, I can pardon Zheng State. This is my wish.
So Uncle Zhan committed suicide.
The people of Zheng gave Uncle Zhan's body to the State of Jin.
Duke Wen of Jin said: I definitely want to see Lord Zheng and insult him before leaving.
The people of Zheng were worried about this, so they sent someone to tell Qin privately: Defeating Zheng is good for Jin, not Qin.
The Qin army withdrew after hearing this.
Duke Wen of Jin sent Zilan to the State of Zheng to be crown prince and took the opportunity to inform the State of Zheng.
Shi Gui, a doctor in the state of Zheng, said: I heard that the daughter named Ji is the first wife of Houji, and her descendants should be prosperous. Zilan's mother is his descendant.
Besides, the madam's sons are all gone, and none of the remaining sons can compare with Lan Xianneng.
Now it is urgent for the Jin State to surround Zheng. The Jin State asks for Zilan's return to Zheng. There is no better condition than this!
So the state of Zheng agreed to the state of Jin, made an alliance with the state of Jin, and finally made Zilan the crown prince, and the Jin army withdrew.
In the forty-fifth year, Duke Wen of Zheng passed away and Zilan came to the throne. This was Duke Mu.
In the spring of the first year of Emperor Miao, Duke Mu of Qin sent three generals to lead an army to attack the state of Zheng. When they arrived in the state of Hua, they met the merchant Xian Gao of the state of Zheng.
After the death of Duke Wen of Zheng, the garrison officer Zanhe in the capital of Zheng State betrayed the inside story of Zheng State to Qin State, so the Qin army came to attack Zheng State.
In three years, the State of Zheng sent troops to follow the State of Jin to attack the State of Qin, and defeated the Qin army in Wang.
The prince of Chu State, Shang Chen, killed his father and became king and ascended the throne.
In the twenty-first year, the Chu State and the Song State Hua Yuan attacked the Zheng State.
Hua Yuan slaughtered sheep to reward the soldiers, but did not give meat to his driver, Yang Zhen. Yang Zhen was angry and drove the chariot to Zheng State. Zheng State imprisoned Hua Yuan. Song State redeemed Hua Yuan with a large sum of money, but Hua Yuan had already escaped.
The state of Jin asked Zhao Chuan to lead his army to attack the state of Zheng.
In the twenty-second year, Duke Mu of Zheng passed away, and his son Yi came to the throne. This was Duke Lin.
In the spring of the first year of Linggong, Chu State dedicated it to Linggong turtle.
Zijia and Zi Gong were about to pay homage to Linggong. Zi Gong's index finger trembled and said to Zi Jia: My finger has moved before, so I must eat rare food.
After entering the palace, he saw Duke Ling eating turtle soup. Zigong smiled and said, "It's true."
Duke Lin asked why Zigong was laughing, and Zigong told Duke Lin the above situation.
Duke Ling called him over, but he didn't give him the soup. Zigong was very angry, so he dipped his finger in the soup and tasted it before leaving the palace.
Duke Lin was very angry and wanted to kill his son.
Zigong and Zijia Shangyi made the first move.
In summer, they killed Ling Gong.
The people of Zheng wanted to appoint Linggong's younger brother Quji, but Quji humbly said: "I must let a worthy person take the throne, and I, Quji, have no talent; I must let him take the throne in the order of eldest son and youngest son, then Prince Jian will be older than me."
Jian is Linggong's younger brother and Quji's older brother.
So he made Zijian the king, and he was Xianggong.
After Duke Xiang ascends the throne, he will kill all the Miao family.
The Miao family is the family of the son who killed Duke Ling. Qu Ji said: The Miao family must be killed, and I will leave Zheng.
Only then did Duke Xiang stop.
And appointed Miao Du as a doctor.
In the first year of Xiang AD, the state of Chu was angry that the state of Zheng had accepted bribes from the state of Song, released Hua Yuan, and attacked the state of Zheng.
The state of Zheng betrayed the state of Chu and became close to the state of Jin.
Five years later, Chu State attacked Zheng State again, and Jin State came to rescue Zheng State.
In the sixth year, Zijia died, and the people of Zhengdu drove out Zijia's family because he killed Duke Ling.
In the seventh year, Zheng and Jin formed an alliance in Yanling.
In the eighth year, King Zhuang of Chu came to attack Zheng because of his alliance with Jin. He besieged the capital of Zheng for three months. Zheng surrendered the capital to Chu.
When the King of Chu entered the city from the imperial gate, Zheng Xianggong took off his shirt, exposed his arms, and held a sheep to greet the King of Chu. He said: "I cannot serve you in the border town. It is my sin to let you come to the capital of our country angrily."
I dare not take orders.
You exiled me to the south of the Yangtze River and gave Zheng to the princes, and I obeyed your orders.
If the king has not forgotten King Zhou Li, King Xuan of Zhou, Duke Huan of Zheng, and Duke Zheng Wu, and feels pity for them and cannot bear to cut off their sacrifices, you can give me a barren land so that I can serve you again. This is my wish, but I do not dare to hope.
I just took the liberty to show my sincerity and will obey your orders.
King Zhuang ordered the army to retreat thirty miles and then settled down.
The ministers of the Chu State said: We have traveled thousands of miles to get here, and the officers and soldiers have also worked hard for a long time.
Now the country that has been conquered is giving up again, why?
King Zhuang said: The reason why we attack is to attack the untamed king.
Today I am already obedient, what else do you want?
The Chu army finally withdrew.
Jin heard that Chu was attacking Zheng and sent troops to rescue him.
When the Jin army set out, the Jin army was not unanimous and was still undecided, so it arrived late. By the time it reached the Yellow River, the Chu army had already left.
Some Jin generals wanted to cross the river to pursue them, while others wanted to return home, but they finally crossed the Yellow River.
After King Zhuang heard about it, he turned around and attacked the Jin army.
Instead, Zheng helped Chu and defeated the Jin army on the Yellow River.
Ten years later, Jin came to attack Zheng again because it opposed Jin but was close to Chu.
Eleven years ago, King Zhuang of Chu attacked the State of Song, and the State of Song asked the State of Jin for help.
Jin Jinggong wanted to send troops to rescue the Song Dynasty. Bo Zong came to admonish the Jin Dynasty and said: God is helping the Chu Kingdom and cannot attack Chu.
The Jin State then found a strong man named Xie Yang, named Zihu, who was from the Huo State.
The state of Jin asked Xie Yang to deceive the state of Chu and ask the state of Song not to surrender. Xie Yang passed by the state of Zheng. The state of Zheng had a close relationship with the state of Chu, so he arrested Xie Yang and dedicated it to the state of Chu.
The King of Chu rewarded Xie Yang with a generous gift and made a covenant with him, asking him to tell the truth and ask Song to surrender quickly. The King of Chu threatened Xie Yang many times, and Xie Yang reluctantly agreed.
So the King of Chu asked Xie Yang to board the chariot where he was watching the enemy troops, and asked him to shout to the Song army. But Xie Yang actually broke the agreement with the Chu people, conveyed the order given to him by the Jin Jun, and shouted loudly: The Jin State is gathering all the troops from all over the country to rescue the Song State. Although the Song State is in an urgent situation, it must not surrender to the Chu State. The Jin Army will arrive soon!
The King of Chu was very angry when he heard this and was about to kill Xie Yang.
Xie Yang said: It is the duty of the king to formulate orders, and it is the duty of his subjects to carry out the orders.
I accept the order of the king of our country and go abroad to do business. I would rather die than let the king's life be harmed.
King Zhuang said: So, you have promised me and then betrayed me. Where is your credit?
Xie Yang said: The reason why I agreed to you is to use it to fulfill the order of our king.
When Xie Yang was about to be executed, he turned around and said to the Chu army: As a minister, you must not forget to be loyal and then die!
The younger brothers of the King of Chu all went to the King of Chu to pardon Xie Yang, so the King of Chu pardoned him and allowed him to return to the Kingdom of Jin.
The State of Jin granted him the title of Shangqing.
In the eighteenth year, Duke Xiang passed away, and his son Duke Yu came to the throne.
In the first year of mourning, Duke Xu Linggong went to Chu to slander Zheng, so Duke asked his younger brother to go to Chu to defend himself.
His defense was unsuccessful and he was imprisoned by the State of Chu.
So Duke Zheng came to Jin to talk about reconciliation between the two countries.
He had friendship with Zi Fan of Chu State, and Zi Fan interceded for his release to the State of Zheng.
In the second year, the state of Chu attacked the state of Zheng, and the Jin army came to rescue him.
That year, when Duke Du passed away, Zheng Guoliang appointed Duke Duke's younger brother, Cheng Gong.
In the third year of Chenggong's reign, the King of the Communist Party of Chu said: I am kind to Zheng Cheng. Then he sent people to Zheng to make an alliance with Duke Cheng.
Duke Cheng secretly formed an alliance with Chu. In the autumn, Duke Cheng paid homage to the state of Jin. Jin said: "The state of Zheng secretly made peace with Chu and arrested Duke Cheng."
And sent Luan Shu to attack Zheng Guo.
In the spring of the fourth year, the state of Zheng was worried that the state of Jin would come to surround him, so the son decided to make his elder brother the king.
In April of that year, Jin heard that Zheng had established a new king and asked Duke Cheng to return to the country.
When the people of Zheng heard that Duke Cheng had returned to the country, they killed him to welcome him.
The Jin army withdrew.
Ten years later, the state of Zheng betrayed its alliance with the state of Jin and formed an alliance with the state of Chu.
Duke Li of Jin was very angry and sent troops to attack Zheng Guo.
The King of the Communist Party of Chu rescued Zheng Guo.
Jin and Chu fought at Yanling. The Chu army failed. The Jin army shot the King of Chu in the eye, and the two sides ceased fighting and left.
In the thirteenth year of the Jin Dynasty, Duke Dao of Jin attacked Zheng Guo and stationed his troops in Weishang.
The Zheng army defended the city, and the Jin army also left.
In the fourteenth year, Duke Cheng passed away and his son Hui came to the throne. This was Duke Li.
In the fifth year of Ligong's reign, Si, the Prime Minister of the State of Zheng, went to pay homage to Ligong, but Ligong was not polite to him.
Zi Si was very angry and asked the cook to kill Li Gong with poison. He announced to the princes that Li Gong had died of a sudden illness.
Li Ligong's son Jia was born. Jia was five years old at that time. This was Jian Gong.
In the first year of Jian AD, the princes planned to kill Zi Si, the Prime Minister of the country. Zi Si found out and killed all the princes.
In the second year, the State of Jin attacked the State of Zheng. The State of Zheng formed an alliance with the State of Jin, and the State of Jin left.
In winter, Zheng Guo entered into an alliance with Chu State.
Zisi was afraid of being killed, so he was close to both Jin and Chu.
In the third year, the prime minister Zi Si wanted to establish himself as the king. The prince Kong sent Wei Zhi to kill the prime minister Zi Si in his place.
Zi Kong also wanted to establish himself as king.
Zichan said: Zisi cannot stand on his own, so you killed him, and today you imitate him. In this way, the civil strife will never subside.
So Zi Kong listened to Zi Chan's advice and still only became the prime minister of Zheng Jiangong.
In the fourth year, Jin was angry that Zheng had made an alliance with Chu and attacked Zheng. Zheng also formed an alliance with Jin.
The King of the Communist Party of Chu rescued Zheng Guo and defeated the Jin army.
Duke Jian wanted to make peace with Jin, but Chu imprisoned Zheng's envoys.
In the twelfth year, Duke Jian was very angry that Zi Kong, the prime minister, had monopolized power. He killed Zi Kong and made Zi Chan the minister.
In the 19th year, Duke Jian came to Jin and interceded with Lord Wei to allow him to return to the country. He also granted six towns to Zichan.
Zichan resigned and only accepted three cities.
In the 22nd year, the state of Wu sent Yanling Jizi to Zhengguo. Yanlingjizi and Zichan hit it off and said to Zichan: There are many people in power in Zheng who are doing evil. Disaster is about to happen, and the power will fall into your hands.
If you are in power, you must govern the country according to etiquette; otherwise, Zheng will suffer a disastrous defeat.
Zi Chan met Ji Zi favorably.
In the twenty-three years, the princes competed for favor and killed each other, and they also wanted to kill Zichan.
Some princes came to remonstrate and said: Zichan is a benevolent person. The reason why Zheng can survive is because of Zichan. Don't kill him!
The young men just gave up.
In the twenty-fifth year, the state of Zheng sent Zi Chan to the state of Jin to inquire about Duke Ping's condition.
Duke Ping asked: After my divination, I said they were Shi Shen and Tai Ni Zuo Chong. The historian does not know their origins, so I take the liberty to ask what kind of gods they are.
Zichan replied: The Gaoxin family had two sons. The eldest son was called Yan Bo and the second son was named Shi Shen. They lived in the big forest and couldn't tolerate each other. They fought against each other every day. Emperor Yao didn't like them, so he moved to Shangqiu to preside over sacrifices. Merchants continued to worship Chenxing, so Chenxing was called Shangxing. Emperor Yao asked Shi Shen to live in Daxia and presided over the sacrifice of Chenxing. The people of the Tang Dynasty followed it and served the Xia and Shang dynasties. The last monarch of the Tang Dynasty was called Tang Shuyu.
When King Wu's wife, Yi Jiang, was pregnant with her uncle, she dreamed that the Emperor of Heaven said to her: "I will name your son Yu, so I gave him the Tang Dynasty title and entrusted him to sacrifice to Ginseng and breed offspring there."
After the uncle was born, the texture on his palms resembled the character "Yu", so he was named after "Yu".
After King Zhou Cheng destroyed the Tang Dynasty, he gave the Tang Dynasty title to his uncle.
Therefore, Shenxing is the star of the Jin Kingdom.
From this we learned that Shi Shen is the god of the ginseng star.
In the past, Jin Tianshi had a descendant named Mei who was a water official and gave birth to Yunge and Taiyi.
Tai Ni could inherit the official position of his predecessors, dredged the Fen River and Tao River well, built embankments for Daze, and lived in Taiyuan.
Emperor Zhuanxu rewarded him for this and sealed Fenshui to him.
Shen, Si, Piao, and Huang Guo were actually in charge of his sacrifices.
Now, Jin ruled the Fen River Basin and destroyed the countries in this area.
From here, Tai Ni is the god of Fen and Tao rivers.
However, these two gods will not harm your body. For the gods of mountains and rivers, sacrifices should be made when floods and droughts occur. For the gods of the sun, moon and stars, sacrifices should be made when snow, frost, wind and rain come out of season. If you are sick, it is caused by eating, drinking, music, and women.
After discussing this with Zichan, Duke Ping and his uncle praised him and said: Yes, you are truly worthy of being a knowledgeable gentleman!
Give your son a generous gift.
In the summer of the twenty-seventh year, Duke Jiang of Zheng went to pay homage to the king of Jin.
In the winter, the state of Zheng was afraid that King Ling of Chu was powerful, so he paid homage to the state of Chu, and Zichan followed him.
In the twenty-eighth year, Zheng Jun fell ill and sent Zichan to meet with the princes and make an alliance with King Ling of Chu in Shen. King Chu killed Qi Guo Qingfeng.
In the thirty-sixth year, Duke Jian passed away, and his son Ding Gongning came to the throne.
In autumn, Duke Dinggong paid homage to Duke Zhao of Jin.
In the first year of Ding AD, the prince of Chu State Qi Ji killed the king of the country, King Ling, and established himself as king. This was King Ping.
King Ping wanted to do something benevolent and moral among the princes, so he returned all the land that King Ling had invaded from Zheng to Zheng.
In four years, Jin Zhaogong passed away. The six ministers of Jin became stronger and the country's power weakened.
Zichan said to Han Xuanzi: To hold power must be based on benevolence, righteousness and morality, and do not forget the reasons for the consolidation of power.
In the sixth year, a fire broke out in the state of Zheng, and Duke Din wanted to pray to ward off the disaster.
Zichan said: It is better to practice virtuous government.
In the eighth year, Prince Jian of Chu State fled to Zheng State.
In the tenth year, Prince Jian discussed with Jin State to attack Zheng State.
Zheng Guo killed Prince Jian, and Prince Jian's son fled to Wu.
In the eleventh year, Duke Dinggong arrived in Jin.
Jin and Zheng negotiated to kill the rebellious ministers of the Zhou royal family and send King Jing back to Zhou.
In the thirteenth year, Duke Ding passed away and his son Xiangong Hui came to the throne.
Duke Xian died in the thirteenth year, and his son Sheng Gongsheng ascended the throne.
At this time, the six ministers of Jin became stronger and invaded Zheng's territory, causing Zheng to decline.
In the fifth year of Duke Sheng's reign, the Prime Minister of Zheng died. The people of Zheng all cried, mourning for him as they mourned for their own relatives.
Zichan is the youngest son of Zheng Chenggong.
Be kind and caring to others, serve the king with loyalty and honesty.
Confucius once passed by the state of Zheng and was as close as brothers to Zichan.
When he heard that Zichan had died, Confucius cried sadly: Zichan's benevolence is really a legacy from ancient times!
In the eighth year, the Fan and Zhongxing clans of Jin rebelled against Jin. Jin asked Zheng for help, and Zheng rescued them.
The Jin State therefore attacked the Zheng State and defeated Zheng's army at Tieba.
In the fourteenth year, Duke Jinggong of Song Dynasty destroyed Cao State.
Twenty years later, Tian Chang of the State of Qi killed his own monarch, Duke Jian, and Tian Chang became the Prime Minister of the State of Qi.
In the twenty-second year, King Hui of Chu destroyed the state of Chen.
Confucius passed away.
In the thirty-sixth year, Zhibo of Jin State attacked Zheng State and captured nine cities.
In the thirty-seventh year, Duke Sheng passed away, and his son Duke Ai came to the throne.
In the eighth year of Duke Ai, the people of Zheng killed Duke Ai and made Chou, the younger brother of Duke Sheng, the king of the country.
In the third year of Gong Gong's reign, the three Jin Dynasties destroyed Zhibo.
In the thirty-first year, Gonggong passed away, and his son Yougong came to the throne.
In the first year of Yougong, Han Wuzi attacked Zheng Guo and killed Yougong.
The people of Zheng appointed You Gong's younger brother as the king of the country. This was Duke Fang.
In the fifteenth year of Gong Gong's reign, Han Jinghou attacked Zheng Guo and captured Yongqiu.
Zheng Guo built the capital.
In the 16th year, Zheng Guo attacked South Korea and defeated the Korean army in Fushu.
In twenty years, Han, Zhao, and Wei became vassal states.
In the twenty-third year, Zheng Guo surrounded Yangzhai in South Korea.
In the twenty-fifth year, Zheng Jun killed Yang, the Prime Minister of the country.
In the twenty-seventh year, Ziyang's followers killed Gong Xi and made You Gong's younger brother Yi the king of the country. This was Zheng Jun.
Two years after Zheng Junyi took the throne, the people who were occupied by Zheng Guo rebelled and returned to Korea.
In the eleventh year, South Korea attacked Zheng Guo and captured Yangcheng.
In the twenty-first year, Marquis Ai of Han destroyed the State of Zheng and annexed it.
Tai Shigong said: As the saying goes, people who rely on power and interests to bond together will become estranged when the power and interests end. This is exactly the case with Fu Xia.
Although Fu Xia kidnapped and killed Zheng Zi and accepted Li Gong back as king, Li Gong eventually abandoned him and killed him. What is the difference between this approach and Jin's Rick?
But if someone like Xun Xi sticks to his integrity, he will not be able to save Xi Qi even if he dies.
Because accidents happen, there are many reasons!
summary:
Duke Huan of Zheng, the youngest son of King Zhou Li, was granted the title of Zhengdi and served as Situ under King You. Loved by the people, he sought advice from Tai Shibo on escaping the Zhou royal family's impending disaster. Tai Shibo advised moving east of Luoshui and south of the Yellow River, where the greedy rulers of Guo and Hao would cede land. Duke Huan relocated his people there, establishing the state of Zheng. However, in the second year, Quan Rong killed King You and Duke Huan at Mount Li. Duke Huan's son, Duke Wu, succeeded him. Duke Wu's wife, Wu Jiang, favored their younger son Shu Duan over the crown prince Wusheng (Duke Zhuang). After Duke Wu's death, Duke Zhuang granted Shu Duan the capital, leading to rebellion. Duke Zhuang defeated Shu Duan, exiled Wu Jiang, but later reconciled with her through a tunnel.

Duke Zhuang's reign saw conflicts with Zhou, Song, and Wei. He defeated King Huan of Zhou in battle but refrained from pursuing him. After Duke Zhuang's death, his son Duke Zhao briefly ruled but was ousted by Duke Li, who was backed by Song. Duke Li killed Ji Zhong but was later driven out, and Duke Zhao returned. Duke Zhao was assassinated by Gao Qumi, leading to a succession of short-lived rulers. Duke Li eventually returned, executed those who betrayed him, and reigned until his death. His son Duke Wen succeeded him.

Duke Wen's reign involved conflicts with Jin and Chu. He was rude to Chong'er (later Duke Wen of Jin), who later besieged Zheng. Duke Wen's son Zilan, favored by Jin, became crown prince and later Duke Mu. Duke Mu's reign saw Qin's failed attack on Zheng, exposed by merchant Xian Gao. Zheng allied with Jin against Qin. After Duke Mu's death, Duke Lin was killed by Zigong over a turtle soup dispute. Duke Xiang succeeded him, facing Chu attacks and shifting alliances between Jin and Chu. Duke Xiang surrendered to Chu but was spared by King Zhuang.

Later rulers included Duke Cheng, who was captured by Jin for allying with Chu, and Duke Li, who was poisoned by Zi Si. Duke Jian's reign featured Zichan, a wise minister who stabilized Zheng through diplomacy and reforms. Zichan's advice to Jin's Duke Ping on gods and governance earned him praise. After Zichan's death, Zheng declined under pressure from Jin's six ministers and Han's invasions. Duke Sheng's reign saw Zichan's death, mourned by all. Confucius wept for Zichan, calling his benevolence a legacy from ancient times.

Zheng's final years were marked by internal strife and Korean aggression. Duke Ai was killed, and subsequent rulers faced Korean attacks. In the twenty-first year of Zheng Junyi's reign, Marquis Ai of Han destroyed Zheng, annexing its territory. Tai Shigong reflected on the fickle nature of power and loyalty, citing Fu Xia's betrayal of Zheng Zi and Li Gong's eventual execution of him, comparing it to Jin's Rick. He noted that even steadfast figures like Xun Xi could not prevent disaster, as unforeseen events often alter outcomes.

translation:
Prime Minister Chen Ping was a native of Humiao Township, Yangwu County.
Chen Ping's family was poor when he was a boy, but he loved studying. His family had 30 acres of land, and he lived with his brother Chen Bo.
Brother Chen Bo usually farmed at home, leaving Chen Ping to study abroad.
Chen Ping is tall and handsome.
Someone said to Chen Ping: How could a poor family eat and become so fat?
Chen Ping's sister-in-law was angry that Chen Ping didn't take care of the family and was not engaged in labor and production. She said: "It's just eating bran and throat vegetables. It's better to have such a brother-in-law than not."
When Uncle Chen heard these words, he divorced his wife and kicked her out of the house.
When Chen Ping grew up and it was time to marry a wife, no one from a wealthy family would marry his daughter to him, and Chen Ping felt ashamed to marry a daughter-in-law from a poor family.
After a long time, there was a rich man named Zhang Fu in Hufu. His granddaughter married five times, and each husband died. No one dared to marry her again.
Chen Ping wanted to marry her.
There was a funeral in the township. Because Chen Ping's family was poor, he went to help with the funeral. He went early and came back late to earn more money to supplement his family's income.
Zhang Fu met him at the mourning house and fell in love with the tall and burly Chen Ping; for this reason, Chen Ping left the mourning house very late.
Once, Zhang Fu followed Chen Ping to his home. The Chen family was in a remote alley near the outer city wall. They used a shabby mat as the door, but there were many wheel marks left by noble people outside the door.
After Zhang Fu returned home, he said to his son Zhang Zhong: I plan to marry my granddaughter to Chen Ping.
Zhang Zhong said: Chen Ping is poor and not engaged in productive labor. Everyone in the county laughs at what he does. Why did you marry your granddaughter to him?
Zhang Fu said: How could a man as handsome as Zhang Ping remain poor and humble for a long time?
Finally, he married his granddaughter to Chen Ping.
Because Chen Ping was poor, the Zhang family lent him money to hire him and gave him money to buy banquets to get married.
Zhang Fu warned his granddaughter: Don't serve others disrespectfully because the Chen family is poor.
Serve your elder brother Chen Bo as you serve your father, and serve your sister-in-law as you serve your mother.
After Chen Ping married a girl from the Zhang family, his wealth became increasingly abundant and his contacts became wider and wider.
Kushangli, where Chen Ping lived, worshiped the earth god. Chen Ping was the person who presided over the cutting of the meat. He distributed the sacrificial meat evenly.
The fellow villagers said: Well, the Chen family’s children are really good at cutting up sacrificial meat!
Chen Ping said: Alas, if I were allowed to rule the world, I would divide the meat like this!
After Chen Sheng raised an army, he proclaimed himself king in Chen County, sent Zhou Shi to pacify the Wei area, established Wei Jiu as the king of Wei, and fought with the Qin army in Linji.
Before that, Chen Ping had bid farewell to his brother Chen Bo and went to Linji with some young people to work under Wei Wang Jiu.
The king of Wei appointed him as his servant.
Chen Ping spoke to the King of Wei, but the King of Wei did not listen. Some people said bad things about him, so Chen Ping had no choice but to flee.
After a long time, Xiang Yu captured the land and reached the edge of the Yellow River. Chen Ping went to Xiang Yu and followed Xiang Yu into the Pass to conquer Qin. Xiang Yu gave him the title of Qing.
Xiang Yu returned eastward and proclaimed himself king in Pengcheng. The King of Han returned to pacify the Three Qin Dynasties and marched eastward. The King of Yin rebelled against Chu.
Xiang Yu then named Chen Ping Lord Xinwu and asked him to lead Wei Wang Jiu's men who had stayed in Chu to defeat and surrender King Yin and return in triumph.
King Xiang sent Xiang Han to appoint Chen Ping as a lieutenant and rewarded him with twenty yi of gold.
Not long after, the king of Han conquered Yin again.
King Xiang was furious and prepared to kill the generals who had conquered Yin the previous time.
Chen Ping was afraid of being killed, so he sealed the gold and official seal awarded to him by King Xiang, sent someone to return King Xiang, and escaped from the road alone with his sword.
When Chen Ping was crossing the Yellow River, the boatman saw a handsome man walking alone. He suspected that he was a fugitive general and that he must have a gold and jade weapon hidden in his waist, so he stared at Chen Ping and planned to kill him.
Chen Ping was very scared, so he took off his clothes and helped the boatman to punt the boat with his upper body naked.
The boatman saw that he had nothing, so he did not take action.
Chen Ping then went to Xiuwu and surrendered to the Han army. He asked to see the King of Han through Wei Wuwu, and the King of Han summoned him.
At this time, Shi Fen, the king of Wanshi, acted as the king's lieutenant. He took Chen Ping's name sticker and introduced Chen Ping to see the king of Han.
Chen Ping and seven others went in, and the king of Han gave them food and drink.
The king of Han said: After eating, go to the guest house to rest.
Chen Ping said: I have something important to come here, and what I want to say cannot be postponed beyond today.
So the king of Han talked with him and liked him very much. The King of Han asked: What official position did you hold in the Chu army? Chen Ping said: Become a captain.
On the same day, the King of Han appointed Chen Ping as the captain, and asked him to serve as a chariot officer and in charge of guarding the army.
All the generals made a noise and said: Your Majesty just got a deserter from Chu State a few days ago. You didn't know the level of his skills, so you rode in the same carriage with him and asked him to supervise us veteran generals!
When the King of Han heard these discussions, he favored Chen Ping even more.
The king of Han then took Chen Ping to the east to attack King Xiang.
When he arrived at Pengcheng, he was defeated by the Chu army.
The King of Han led his troops back and collected scattered soldiers along the way to Xingyang. He appointed Chen Ping as deputy general, subordinate to King Xin of Han, and stationed in Guangwu.
Zhou Bo, Guan Ying, etc. all made slanderous remarks to slander Chen Ping, saying: Although Chen Ping is a handsome man, he is just like the jade used for decoration on his hat. He may not have great talent inside.
We heard that when Chen Ping was at home, he had an affair with his sister-in-law. He couldn't find a place to work with the king of Wei, so he fled and joined the king of Chu. After joining the king of Chu, it was not compatible, so he fled again and surrendered to the king of Han.
Now the king thinks so highly of him that he becomes a high official and appoints him as a guard to supervise the army.
We heard that Chen Ping accepted money from generals, and those who gave more money received benefits, while those who gave less money encountered bad situations.
Chen Ping is a capricious and rebellious minister, and I hope the king will be aware of it.
The king of Han was suspicious of Chen Ping and summoned Wei Wuzhi to question him.
Wei Wuwu said: What I am talking about is talent, and what your Majesty is asking about is character.
Now, if there are people with the character of Wei Sheng and Xiao Yi, but it is not conducive to the victory or defeat of the war, why would Your Majesty reuse these people?
In the confrontation between Chu and Han, I recommend people who are good at making clever plans. I only care about whether his plans can really benefit the country.
As for having an affair with your sister-in-law and accepting money, what is there to be suspicious of?
The King of Han summoned Chen Ping and asked him: "My husband did something inconsistent with the King of Wei, so he went to the King of Chu to do something and left halfway." Now that you have come to follow me again, is it true that those who make promises are so half-hearted?
Chen Ping said: I was working for the King of Wei, but the King of Wei could not adopt my suggestions, so I left him to work for King Xiang.
King Xiang cannot trust people. The people he trusts and favors are either brothers from the Xiang clan or his wife's family. Even if they have talents, they cannot reuse them. Therefore, I left the King of Chu.
I heard that the king of Han can use people, so I came to join you.
I came alone and had no money to pay for my services.
If my strategy is indeed worthy of adoption, I hope your Majesty will adopt it; if it is not worthy of adoption and the money is still there, please allow me to seal it and send it back to the government, and ask your Majesty to allow me to resign.
The King of Han then apologized to Chen Ping, rewarded him generously, and appointed him as the lieutenant of the army guard to supervise all the generals.
The generals did not dare to say anything more.
Later, the Chu army stepped up its offensive, cutting off the corridors through which the Han army transported grain and grass, and besieging the Han king in Xingyang City.
After a while, the king of Han was worried about this predicament and asked for the cession of the area west of Xingyang to make peace.
King Xiang disagreed.
The King of Han said to Chen Ping: The world is in such chaos, when will it settle down?
Chen Ping said: King Xiang was courteous and caring, and most of the scholars with integrity and good manners joined him.
When it came time to reward him based on his merits and confer titles and towns, he was stingy with these titles, so the scholars no longer truly attached themselves to him.
Nowadays, the king is arrogant and lacks etiquette, and scholars with integrity do not come to join him. However, the king is willing to give people titles and houses, and those who are smooth, spineless, profit-seeking and shameless tend to join the king of Han.
If each of you can put aside the shortcomings of both sides and adopt the strengths of both sides, then with just a wave of your hand, the world will be settled.
However, the king loves to insult people at will and cannot attract honest and honest scholars.
However, there are areas where the Chu army can be disrupted. King Xiang's upright ministers like Yafu Fan Zeng, Zhongli Mei, Long Qie, and Zhou Yin are just a few.
If your Majesty is willing to spend tens of thousands of kilograms of gold to carry out counter-insurgency strategies, alienate the relationship between the kings and ministers of Chu State, and make them suspicious of each other. King Xiang is suspicious and easy to listen to slander, and they will definitely kill each other among themselves.
The Han army can take the opportunity to send troops to attack them, and they will definitely defeat the Chu army.
The King of Han thought that Chen Ping was right, so he gave Chen Ping 40,000 kilograms of gold and allowed him to use it without asking about his expenditure.
Chen Ping spent a lot of gold to create discord among the Chu army. He threatened among the generals that Zhongli Mei and others, as generals of King Xiang, had made a lot of contributions, but they could not allocate territory and become kings. They planned to join forces with the King of Han to eliminate King Xiang, divide the land of Chu, and make each of them king.
Xiang Yu became suspicious and no longer trusted Zhong Limei and others.
King Xiang had already suspected Zhong Limei and others, so he sent envoys to the Han army to find out.
The king of Han prepared a sumptuous banquet and ordered people to bring it in.
When he saw the envoy from the King of Chu, the King of Han pretended to be surprised and said: I thought it was Yafu's envoy, but it turned out to be the envoy from the King of Chu!
He also asked people to take away the wine and food, and replaced them with poor food to serve to the envoy of the King of Chu.
After the King of Chu's envoy returned, he reported the situation to King Xiang.
As expected, King Xiang was greatly suspicious of Kia's father.
Fan Zeng wanted to capture Xingyang City quickly, but King Xiang did not trust him and refused to obey.
When Fan Zeng heard that King Xiang was doubting him, he said angrily: "The major events in the world are basically settled. The king can do it himself!"
I beg to resign and return home!
Before he reached Pengcheng when he returned to his hometown, he died of a sore attack on his back.
Chen Ping then asked two thousand women to leave the east gate of Xingyang City at night. The Chu army launched an attack, and Chen Ping and the King of Han fled out of the city through the west gate of Xingyang City.
The King of Han then entered Guanzhong, collected the scattered soldiers and marched eastward again.
The next year, Han Xin, the Marquis of Huaiyin, defeated the State of Qi and proclaimed himself King of Qi. He sent an envoy to report the incident to the King of Han.
The king of Han was furious and scolded Han Xin.
Chen Ping secretly stepped on the King of Han's toes, and the King of Han also realized it, so he entertained the King of Qi's envoy generously and sent Zhang Zifang to immediately make Han Xin the King of Qi.
The king of Han granted the town of Hufu to Chen Ping.
The King of Han adopted Chen Ping's ingenious tactics and finally destroyed the Chu State.
Chen Ping once followed the King of Han as a lieutenant in the army to put down the rebellion of King Zang Tu of Yan.
In the sixth year of the Han Dynasty, someone reported that Han Xin, the king of Chu, was planning to rebel.
Emperor Gao asked the generals, who said: Send troops quickly to bury this kid alive.
Emperor Gao remained silent.
Emperor Gao asked Chen Ping, but Chen Ping declined again and again and asked: What did the generals say?
The emperor told Chen Ping what the generals said.
Chen Ping asked: Does anyone else know about the person who wrote a letter to report Han Xin's rebellion? The emperor said: No.
Chen Ping asked: Does Han Xin himself know about this situation? The emperor said: I don’t know.
Chen Ping said: Which of your Majesty's elite troops is better than that of Chu?
The emperor said: Not as good as them.
Chen Ping asked: Is there any of your Majesty's generals who can surpass Han Xin in using troops?
The emperor said: There is no one like him.
Chen Ping said: Now your Majesty's army is not as elite as the Chu State, and the generals are not as talented as Han Xin. If you send troops to attack him, you will encourage him to fight against us. I am privately worried about your Majesty's safety.
The emperor said: What should we do?
Chen Ping said: In ancient times, the emperor visited various places and met with the princes.
There is Yunmengze in the south. Your Majesty can pretend to travel to Yunmeng and meet with the princes in Chen County.
Chen County is on the western border of Chu State. When Han Xin heard that the emperor was traveling with good intentions, he must have thought that everything was fine, so he went to the outskirts to greet his majesty.
When he came to pay his respects, His Majesty took the opportunity to capture him. This was something that only a strong man could do.
Emperor Gao thought his strategy was good, so he sent envoys to inform the princes to meet in Chen County, saying that I was about to patrol Yunmeng south.
The emperor set off immediately.
The trip had not yet arrived at Chen County, and as expected, King Han Xin of Chu greeted him on the road to the outskirts.
Emperor Gao had prepared warriors in advance. When he saw Han Xin coming, he immediately took him down, tied him up, and put him in the passenger car.
Han Xin shouted: Now that the world is at peace, I should have been cooked and killed!
Emperor Gao turned around and said to Han Xin: "Stop shouting!"
Your rebellion is already very clear!
The warrior tied Han Xin's hands behind his back.
Emperor Gao then met with the princes in Chen County and all pacified Chu.
Emperor Gao returned to Luoyang, pardoned Han Xin, conferred him the title of Marquis of Huaiyin, and cut talismans with meritorious ministers to determine rewards.
At that time, he and Chen Ping broke the talisman and wanted the Chen family to be passed down from generation to generation forever, and he was granted the title of Huyouhou.
Chen Ping declined and said: This is not my credit.
The emperor said: I adopted your master's strategy and defeated the enemy. What is the credit if it's not yours?
Chen Ping said: If it weren't for Wei Wuzhi, how could I be an official in the court?
The emperor said: It can be said that you, sir, have never forgotten your roots.
So Wei Wuwu was rewarded.
The next year, Chen Ping followed Emperor Gao as a lieutenant in the army to attack the rebel King Xin of Han in Daidi.
The Han army marched in a hurry to Pingcheng, where they were besieged by the Xiongnu and had no food for seven days.
Emperor Gao adopted Chen Ping's ingenious plan and sent people to Chanyu's Yan family to clear the way, and then he was able to relieve the siege.
After Emperor Gao escaped, the plan proposed by Chen Ping has been kept strictly confidential, and no one in the world knows the inside story.
Emperor Gao returned south and passed by Qu Ni. He climbed up the city tower and saw the large houses in the county seat. He said: "This county is so spectacular!"
I have traveled all over the world and I have only seen Luoyang and this county like this.
He turned around and asked the censor: "What is the household registration of Qu Ni?"
The censor replied: At the beginning of the Qin Dynasty, there were more than 30,000 people. During the years of war, many people fled and went into hiding. Now there are only 5,000 people.
At that time, Emperor Gao ordered the imperial censor to change the title of Chen Ping to the title of Qu Nihou, allowing him to enjoy the tax income of every household in the county, and cancel the food fiefdom of Humo Township that had been previously granted.
After that, Chen Ping followed Emperor Gao as a lieutenant in the army to conquer Chen Xi and Yingbu.
He came up with six strange strategies in total, and each time he proposed a strategy, he increased the number of fiefs, a total of six times.
Some of the strange schemes are quite secret, and no one in the world knows about them.
Emperor Gao returned with the army that defeated Tingshi. He fell ill due to trauma and slowly marched to Chang'an.
King Lu Wan of Yan rebelled, and the emperor sent Fan Kuai to lead troops to conquer him as prime minister.
After setting off, some people spoke ill of Fan Kuai.
Emperor Gao was angry and said: "Fan Kuai saw that I was sick, so he hoped that I would die."
Then he adopted Chen Ping's strategy and summoned Jianghou Zhou Bo to receive orders in front of his sickbed, saying: "Chen Ping quickly drove his chariot and horse to the station and took Zhou Bo to lead the army in place of Fan Kuai. When Chen Ping arrived in the army, he immediately beheaded Fan Kuai!"
The two accepted the order and drove quickly to the post station. They had not yet reached the army. They discussed as they walked: Fan Kuai is an old friend of Emperor Gao. He has made many contributions. He is also the husband of Empress Lu's sister Lu Huan.
We would rather imprison him and hand him over to the emperor, who will execute him himself.
Before they reached the military camp, they piled earth to build an altar and used talismans to summon Fan Kuai.
Fan Kuai accepted the order and was immediately tied up and put into a prison cart. He was sent to Chang'an from the post station. Jianghou Bo was ordered to replace Fan Kuai as a general and lead troops to pacify the rebellious counties in Yan.
When Chen Ping learned of the death of Emperor Gao when he returned, he was afraid that Lu Yanjin would slander him and Empress Lu would be angry after hearing the slander, so he hurriedly drove his carriages and horses ahead of him.
On the way, I met an envoy who ordered Chen Ping and Guan Ying to garrison Xingyang.
Chen Ping accepted the imperial edict and immediately drove to the palace. Weeping very sadly, he took the opportunity to report to Empress Lu how to deal with Fan Kuai in the mourning hall of Emperor Gao.
Empress Dowager Lu pitied Chen Ping and said: "You have worked hard, go out and have a good rest."
Chen Ping was afraid of being slandered, so he insisted on staying in the palace and serving as a guard.
Empress Dowager Lu then appointed him as Lang Zhongling and said: "Please assist and teach Emperor Xiaohui well."
After that, Lu Huan's slander had no effect.
Fan Kuai was taken to Chang'an, where he was pardoned and restored to his original title and fiefdom.
In the sixth year of Emperor Xiaohui's reign, Prime Minister Cao Shen passed away, and Wang Ling, the Marquis of Anguo, was appointed Prime Minister on the right and Chen Ping was Prime Minister on the left.
Wang Ling, originally from Peixian County, was a wealthy gentry in the county. At first, when Gaozu was in a humble position, he served Wang Ling like an elder brother.
Wang Ling lacks literary talent, is emotional, and likes to be outspoken.
When Emperor Gaozu raised troops in Pei County and entered Guanzhong and arrived in Xianyang, Wang Ling also gathered thousands of party members and stationed in Nanyang, refusing to follow Pei Gong.
When the King of Han returned to attack Xiang Ji, Wang Ling led his troops to return to the King of Han.
Xiang Yu captured Wang Ling's mother and placed her in the military camp. When Wang Ling's envoy arrived, Xiang Yu made Wang Ling's mother sit facing east, hoping to attract Wang Ling's surrender.
When Wang Ling's mother sent the envoy away in private, she cried and said: Please tell Wang Ling for me to serve the King of Han carefully.
The King of Han is a generous elder, so don’t have any second thoughts because of me.
I will die to see you off.
After saying this, he drew his sword and killed himself.
King Xiang became angry and cooked her body.
Wang Ling finally followed the King of Han to bring peace to the world.
Wang Ling had a good relationship with Yong Chi. Yong Chi was the enemy of Emperor Gao. Wang Ling had no intention of following Emperor Gao, so he was granted the title late and was named Marquis of Anguo.
An Guohou became the right prime minister. Two years later, Emperor Xiaohui died.
The Empress Dowager Lu wanted to make a member of the Lu family king, so she asked Wang Ling about it, and Wang Ling said: No.
Asked Chen Ping again, Chen Ping said: Yes.
Empress Dowager Lu was angry, so she pretended to promote Wang Ling to the emperor's tutor, but actually did not reuse Wang Ling.
Wang Ling became angry and resigned due to illness. He stayed behind closed doors and never met the emperor. He died seven years later.
After Wang Ling was dismissed from the post of prime minister, Empress Dowager Lu transferred Chen Ping to the right prime minister and appointed Piyang Hou Shenshi as the left prime minister.
Prime Minister Zuo does not have an office and often handles government affairs in the palace.
Shen Shi is also from Peixian County.
When the King of Han was defeated west of Pengcheng, the Chu army captured the King of Han's father and Empress Lu as hostages, forcing them to serve Empress Lu as retainers.
He later followed the Han army to defeat Xiang Yu and was granted the title of Marquis, and was favored by Empress Dowager Lu.
When he became the Prime Minister of Zuo and lived in the palace, all officials had to use him to decide national affairs.
Lu Yan often slandered Chen Ping many times because he had made plans for Emperor Gao to arrest Fan Kuai: Chen Ping ignored government affairs when he was prime minister, drank fine wine every day, and played with women.
After hearing this, Chen Ping started drinking and having fun more and more.
When Empress Dowager Lu heard about this, she was secretly happy.
She said to Chen Ping in front of Lu Yan: As the saying goes, "The words of children and women cannot be trusted. It depends on how you treat me."
Don't be afraid that Lu Yan will say bad things about you.
Empress Dowager Lu made a member of the Lu family king, and Chen Ping pretended to obey.
After the death of Empress Dowager Lu, Chen Ping conspired with Taiwei Zhou Bo, and finally killed all the Lu family and installed Emperor Xiaowen on the throne. Chen Ping was the main planner of this matter.
After examining the food, he was dismissed from the post of Prime Minister Zuo.
After Emperor Xiaowen came to the throne, he believed that Taiwei Zhou Bo had made great contributions by personally leading troops to annihilate the Lu clan. Chen Ping wanted to give up the title of Prime Minister You to Zhou Bo, so he retired due to illness.
Emperor Xiaowen had just ascended the throne and felt that Chen Ping was strangely ill, so he went to inquire about him.
Chen Ping said: During the reign of Emperor Gaozu, Zhou Bo's contribution was not as good as mine, Chen Ping.
When it came time to annihilate the Lu family, my contribution would not be as good as Zhou Bo's.
I am willing to give up the position of Prime Minister You to Zhou Bo.
So Emperor Xiaowen appointed Jianghou Zhou Bo as Prime Minister of the Right, ranking first; Chen Ping was transferred to Prime Minister of the Left, ranking second.
Chen Ping was given a thousand pieces of gold as a reward, and three thousand households were granted food fiefs.
After a period of time, Emperor Xiaowen gradually became more familiar with national affairs. When he was interviewed by ministers, he asked Zhou Bo, the right prime minister: How many cases were judged in the country in a year?
Zhou Bo apologized and said: I don’t know.
Emperor Xiaowen asked again: How much is the country's annual expenditure on money and grain?
Zhou Bo apologized again and said he didn't know. He was so anxious that he was sweating profusely and felt ashamed that he couldn't answer.
So the emperor asked Chen Ping, Prime Minister Zuo.
Chen Ping said: There is a person in charge who is responsible.
The emperor said: Who is in charge?
Chen Ping said: If your Majesty asks about the status of the judgment case, you can ask the Tingwei; if you want to ask about the income and expenditure of money and food, you can ask the history of Zhi Su Nei.
The emperor said: If each has a person in charge, then what is it that you are in charge of?
Chen Ping apologized and said: I am truly terrified!
Your Majesty did not know that I was of low intelligence, so I reluctantly held the position of prime minister.
The position of prime minister is to assist the emperor to regulate yin and yang and comply with the four seasons, to nurture all things to grow in time, to calm the barbarians and princes externally, to care for and unite the people internally, so that the ministers and officials can fulfill their duties.
After hearing this, Emperor Xiaowen praised him for his good answer.
The Right Prime Minister Zhou Bo was greatly ashamed. After he retired from the court, he complained to Chen Ping and said: Why don't you teach me how to answer these words in normal times?
Chen Ping smiled and said: "You are in a position, don't you know your responsibilities?"
If Your Majesty asks about the number of thieves in Chang'an City, will you have to make up the numbers to answer?
At this time Jianghou Zhou Bo knew that his talents were far inferior to Chen Ping.
After a while, Jianghou Zhou Bo was ill and asked to be relieved of the post of Prime Minister You, and Chen Ping took on the entire post of Prime Minister alone.
In the second year of Emperor Xiaowen's reign, Prime Minister Chen Ping passed away, and his posthumous title was Xianhou.
His son Gonghou Chenmai succeeded him.
Chen Mai died after reigning for two years, and his son Chen Hui, Marquis of Jian, succeeded him.
Chen Hui died in the 23rd year of his reign, and his son Chen He succeeded him.
In the twenty-third year of Chen He's reign, he committed the crime of seizing other people's wives and was sentenced to death. The feudal state was abolished.
Chen Ping once said: I often use secretive strategies, which is taboo in Taoism.
If my descendants are deposed, they will stop and will not rise again in the end. This is because I secretly accumulated a lot of troubles.
Afterwards, Chen Ping's great-grandson Chen Zhang relied on his relationship with the Wei family to hope to inherit the original title of the Chen family, but this failed in the end.
Tai Shigong said: When Prime Minister Chen Ping was young, he originally liked the teachings of Huangdi and Laozi.
As he sliced ​​the sacrificial meat on the chopping block, his ambitions were already high.
He wandered between Chu and Wei, and finally surrendered to Emperor Gao.
He often comes up with ingenious ideas to resolve numerous crises and eliminate disasters in the country.
During the reign of Empress Lu, many things happened, but Chen Ping was still able to avoid disasters, stabilize the Han Dynasty, maintain a glorious reputation throughout his life, and was called a virtuous prime minister. Isn't this a good beginning and a good end?
Without wisdom and strategy, who could achieve this?
summary:
Chen Ping, a native of Humiao Township, Yangwu County, was born into poverty but loved studying. His brother Chen Bo farmed while Chen Ping studied abroad. Tall and handsome, Chen Ping faced criticism for his lack of labor, leading his sister-in-law to complain. Chen Bo divorced her upon hearing this. When Chen Ping sought marriage, wealthy families refused him, and he hesitated to marry a poor woman. Eventually, he married Zhang Fu's granddaughter, who had been widowed five times. Zhang Fu, impressed by Chen Ping's appearance and potential, lent him money for the wedding, advising his granddaughter to serve the Chen family respectfully. After marriage, Chen Ping's wealth and connections grew.

Chen Ping presided over cutting sacrificial meat for the earth god, distributing it evenly, and remarked, "If I ruled the world, I would divide it like this." During the Chen Sheng uprising, he served Wei Wang Jiu but left after his advice was ignored. He then joined Xiang Yu, who appointed him Lord Xinwu. Fearing execution after a failed campaign, Chen Ping fled to the Han king, Liu Bang, who made him a captain. Despite slander from generals like Zhou Bo and Guan Ying about his past and alleged bribery, Chen Ping defended himself, and Liu Bang rewarded him generously, appointing him to supervise the army.

Chen Ping advised Liu Bang to use gold to sow discord among Xiang Yu's ministers, leading to Xiang Yu's suspicion of Fan Zeng and others. Fan Zeng resigned and died. Chen Ping then helped Liu Bang escape Xingyang by sending women out the east gate while they fled west. Later, he advised against attacking Han Xin directly, instead capturing him during a meeting in Chen County. Liu Bang granted Chen Ping the title of Huyouhou, which Chen Ping attributed to Wei Wuzhi's recommendation.

Chen Ping devised six secret strategies, including rescuing Liu Bang from a Xiongnu siege at Pingcheng. After Liu Bang's death, Chen Ping avoided Empress Lu's suspicion by pretending to indulge in drinking and women. He conspired with Zhou Bo to eliminate the Lu clan and install Emperor Xiaowen. Chen Ping later ceded the position of Right Prime Minister to Zhou Bo, citing Zhou Bo's greater role in suppressing the Lu family. When Emperor Xiaowen questioned the prime ministers about state affairs, Zhou Bo faltered, while Chen Ping explained the prime minister's role in regulating yin and yang and ensuring officials fulfilled their duties. Zhou Bo resigned, and Chen Ping served as sole prime minister until his death in 166 BC.

Chen Ping's descendants inherited his title but lost it due to crimes. He once remarked that his secretive strategies were taboo in Taoism, predicting his descendants' decline. Sima Qian praised Chen Ping for his wisdom and ability to navigate crises, maintaining a glorious reputation as a virtuous prime minister.
