After his death, his son Hu Hai became the Second Emperor. In the third year of the Second Emperor's reign, princes rebelled. Zhao Gao killed the Second Emperor and made Ziying emperor. Ziying was killed by princes, and Qin was destroyed.

The Grand Historian noted that Qin's ancestors were surnamed Ying, with descendants scattered across various states, taking their fiefs as surnames. Qin was granted Zhao City due to Zaofu, so they were also called the Zhao family.

translation:
Xiang Ji, Xia Xiangren, named Yu.
He was twenty-four years old when he started to fight.
His uncle was Xiang Liang, and Xiang Liang's father was Chu general Xiang Yan, who was killed by Qin general Wang Jian.
The Xiang family has been a general of Chu for generations and was granted the title of Xiang, hence the surname Xiang.
When Xiang Ji was a child, he learned to read and write but failed.
He gave up learning calligraphy and switched to fencing, but failed again.
Xiang Liang was very angry with him.
Xiang Ji said: Characters are only used to remember names.
A sword can only withstand one enemy, so it is not worth learning. You must learn to be able to withstand ten thousand people.
So Xiang Liang taught Xiang Ji the art of war. Xiang Ji was very happy and roughly understood the general idea of ​​the art of war, but he refused to finish it seriously.
Xiang Liang was once implicated in the Yueyang crime case, so he asked Cao Jiu, the warden of Qixian County, to write to Sima Xin, the warden of Yueyang, and the matter was settled.
Xiang Liang killed someone, and he and Xiang Ji went to Wuzhong to avoid their enemies.
None of the talented scholar-bureaucrats in Wuzhong could compare with Xiang Liang.
Whenever there was a large-scale military service or funeral in Wuzhong, Xiang Liang often took charge of the arrangements and secretly used military arrangements to arrange guests and children, so he understood everyone's abilities.
When the First Emperor of Qin visited Kuaiji and crossed Zhejiang, Xiang Liang and Xiang Ji went to watch it together.
Xiang Ji said: I can replace that emperor.
Xiang Liang covered his mouth and said, "Don't talk nonsense, or the whole clan will be beheaded!"
Xiang Liang therefore felt that Xiang Ji was different from ordinary people.
Xiang Ji is more than eight feet tall, can lift a cauldron, and is so talented that the children of Wuzhong already fear him.
In July of the first year of Qin II, Chen She and others revolted in Daze Township.
In September of that year, Yin Tong, the governor of Kuaiji County, told Xiang Liang that Jiangxi had rebelled, and that this was also the time when God would destroy the Qin Dynasty.
I heard that those who strike first can control others, and those who strike last are controlled by others.
I want to send troops and send you and Huan Chu to lead them.
At that time, Huan Chu fled to Zezhong.
Xiang Liang said: Huan Chu died and was hiding outside. No one knew his whereabouts. Only Xiang Ji knew.
Xiang Liang came out and told Xiang Ji to wait outside with his sword.
Xiang Liang went in again and sat with the county guard. Xiang Liang said: "Please allow me to call Xiang Yu in and let him accept the order to recall Huan Chu." The Sheriff said: Okay.
Xiang Liang called Xiang Ji in.
After a while, Xiang Liang winked at Xiang Ji and said, "It's time to take action!"
So Xiang Yu drew his sword and chopped off the head of the governor.
Xiang Liang took the county governor's head and tied the official seal of the county governor on his body.
The guards of the county guard were greatly alarmed and in chaos, Xiang Yu killed more than a hundred people.
Everyone in the mansion was in a state of fear and submission, and no one dared to resist.
Xiang Liang summoned the courageous and powerful officials he was familiar with in the past and made it clear to everyone what he was going to do to raise an army against Qin, so he recruited the soldiers of Wu Zhong to revolt.
He sent people to recruit strong men from the subordinate counties and got 8,000 elite soldiers.
Xiang Liang arranged for the heroes of Wuzhong to be school captains, marquises, and Sima.
One person was not appointed and went to complain to Xiang Liang himself.
Xiang Liang said: There was a funeral some time ago and I asked you to take charge of something. You couldn't handle it, so I didn't appoint you.
So everyone admired Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang was the governor of Kuaiji, and Xiang Ji was the general. Zhenfu subordinate counties and cities.
Zhao Ping, a native of Guangling, was trying to capture the territory of Guangling for King Chen, but he did not surrender.
Hearing that King Chen was defeated and fled, and that Qin soldiers were about to arrive, he crossed the river and asked King Chen to give him orders to worship Xiang Liang as the king of Chu's Shangzhu Kingdom.
Zhao Ping said: Jiangdong has been pacified, so quickly lead troops to the west to attack the Qin army.
Xiang Liang crossed the river with eight thousand men and headed west.
He heard that Chen Ying had captured Dongyang, so he sent an envoy to join forces with Chen Ying to advance westward.
Chen Ying turned out to be the governor of Dongyang. He had always been honest and prudent in the county, and people called him a loyal elder.
Young people in Dongyang killed their county magistrate and gathered thousands of people to elect a leader. When no one was found, they asked Chen Ying to take over.
Chen Ying refused and said he was not qualified, so everyone forcibly elected him as the leader, with 20,000 followers in the county.
The young people planned to elect Chen Ying to be king. In order to distinguish himself from other armies, the soldiers wore green scarves on their heads to signify the sudden rise of the army.
Chen Ying's mother said to Chen Ying: Since I became the daughter-in-law of the Chen family, I have never heard that your predecessors had high officials or noble titles.
It's not a good sign to suddenly gain a lot of fame now.
It's better to belong to something. If things succeed, you can still get a title. If things fail, it's easier to escape because you won't attract the attention of the world.
Therefore, Chen Ying did not dare to become king.
He said to his military officers: The Xiang family has been a general for generations and is famous in Chu.
Now if you want to accomplish great things, you have to use the right general.
If we rely on famous families, we will definitely destroy the Qin Dynasty.
So everyone listened to him and gave the army to Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang crossed the Huai River, and generals Yingbu and Pu also led their troops to surrender.
Xiang Liang had a total of sixty or seventy thousand men stationed in Xiapi.
At this time, Qin Jia had established Jingju as King of Chu and stationed himself east of Pengcheng, hoping to resist Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang said to the soldiers: King Chen started the rebellion first, and the battle was not successful. His whereabouts are unknown.
Now Qin Jia betrayed King Chen and established Jingju, which was a treasonous act.
Xiang Liang then marched to attack Qin Jia.
Qin Jia's army was defeated and fled, and Xiang Liang pursued him to Hu Ling.
Qin Jia returned to the army and fought for a day. Qin Jia was killed in battle and his soldiers surrendered.
Jingju fled and died in Liangdi.
Xiang Liang has merged Qin Jia's army and is stationed in Huling, and will lead the army westward.
Zhang Han's army arrived at Li County, and Xiang Liang sent generals Zhujishi and Yu Fanjun to fight with him.
Yu Fanjun died in battle, Zhujishi's army was defeated and fled to Huling.
Xiang Liang then led his troops into Xue County and killed Zhujishi.
Before this, Xiang Liang sent Xiang Yu to lead another army to attack Xiangcheng, but Xiangcheng held on and refused to surrender.
After the capture, all the soldiers and civilians who defended the city were killed, and they came back to report to Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang heard that King Chen was indeed dead, so he summoned all the generals to Xue County to discuss important matters.
At this time, Pei Gong also raised troops from Pei and went to Xue County.
Fan Zeng, a Juhuan, is seventy years old. He has always lived at home and likes to come up with clever ideas. He went to lobby Xiang Liang and said: Chen Sheng's failure was the right thing to do.
Qin destroyed the six kingdoms, and Chu was the least at fault.
Since King Huai of Chu entered Qin and never returned, the people of Chu still miss him. Therefore, Duke Nan of Chu said, "Although Chu has three households, if Qin is destroyed, it will be Chu."
Now that Chen Sheng is the first to start the rebellion and proclaim himself king instead of a descendant of Chu, his situation will not last long.
Now that you have launched an army to the east of the Yangtze River, the people of Chu are like swarms of bees, all vying to join you. This is because the Xiang family has been Chu generals for generations and can once again establish the descendants of Chu.
Xiang Liang thought he was right, so he found the grandson of King Huai of Chu among the people. He was tending sheep for people. Xiang Liang made him King Huai of Chu and obeyed the people's wishes.
Chen Ying ruled the Shangzhu Kingdom of Chu and had five counties in his fiefdom. Together with King Huai of Chu, he established Xutai as the capital.
Xiang Liang called himself Lord Wu Xin.
A few months later, Xiang Liang led troops to attack Kangfu, and together with the troops of Tian Rong and Sima Longqie of Qi State, he rescued Dong'a and defeated the Qin army in Dong'a.
Tian Rong led his army back to his old place and drove away King Tianjia of Qi.
Tianjia fled to Chu State.
Tian Jiao, the prime minister of Tianjia, fled to Zhao.
Tian Jiao's younger brother Tian Jian turned out to be a general of Qi State, but he stayed in Zhao State and did not dare to go back.
Tian Rong made Tian Dan's son Tian Shi the king of Qi.
Xiang Liang had already defeated the Qin army in Dong'e, so he pursued him.
He sent envoys many times to urge the Qi army, intending to join forces with it to march westward.
Tian Rong said: Chu killed Tianjia, and Zhao killed Tianjiao and Tianjian, so I will send troops.
Xiang Liang said: Tianjia is the king of a country friendly to Chu. He came to rely on me when he was desperate. I couldn't bear to kill him.
Zhao also did not kill Tianjiao and Tianjian as a condition of exchange with Qi.
So Qi refused to send troops to help Chu.
Xiang Liang sent Pei Gong and Xiang Yu to lead another army to attack Chengyang and massacred the county seat.
Xiangxi defeated the Qin army east of Puyang, and the Qin army withdrew its troops and entered Puyang.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu attacked Dingtao.
After failing to capture Dingtao, he led his army to leave, marched westward and captured the territory, reaching Yongqiu, where he defeated the Qin army and killed Li You.
He returned to attack Waihuang but failed to capture it.
Xiang Liang set out from Dong'a and marched westward. When he arrived at Dingtao, he defeated the Qin army again. Xiang Yu and others killed Li You again. Therefore, Xiang Liang despised the Qin army more and more and looked arrogant.
Song Yi advised Xiang Liang: If you win a battle but your generals are arrogant and your soldiers are lazy, you will lose.
Now the soldiers are a little slack and the number of Qin soldiers is increasing day by day. I am worried about you.
Xiang Liang did not listen to the advice.
So he sent Song Yi as envoy to Qi.
On the way, I met Gaoling Junxian, the envoy of Qi State, and asked him: Are you going to see Mr. Wu Xin?
Answer: Yes.
Song Yi said: I conclude that Lord Wu Xin's army must have failed.
If you walk slowly you will avoid death, if you walk fast you will suffer disaster.
Qin Guoran mobilized all its troops to reinforce Zhang Han, attacked the Chu army, and defeated the Chu army in Dingtao. Xiang Liang died in the battle.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu left Waihuang to attack Chenliu, but Chenliu was entrenched and could not capture it.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu discussed with each other: Now Xiang Liang's army has collapsed and the soldiers are afraid.
So he led his troops and marched eastward with Lu Chen's army.
Lu Chen was stationed to the east of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu was stationed to the west of Pengcheng, and Peigong was stationed in Dang.
Zhang Han had already defeated Xiang Liang's army and thought that Chu's enemies no longer had to worry, so he crossed the Yellow River to attack Zhao and defeated the Zhao army.
At this time, Zhao Xie was the king of Zhao, Chen Yu was the general, and Zhang Er was the prime minister, and they all ran into Julu City.
Zhang Han ordered Wang Li and Shejian to besiege Julu. Zhang Han stationed himself to the south of Julu and built tunnels to transport food to Wang Li and Shejian's army.
As a general, Chen Yu led tens of thousands of soldiers to station in the north of Julu. This was the so-called Hebei Army.
The Chu army was defeated in Dingtao. King Chu Huai was very frightened and went from Xutai to Pengcheng, where he merged with the armies of Xiang Yu and Lu Chen and led them personally.
Lu Chen was appointed as Situ, and his father Ye Qing was appointed as Ling Yin.
He appointed Pei Gong as the governor of Dang County and was granted the title of Marquis of Wu'an, commanding the army of Dang County.
The Qi envoy Gaoling Junxian whom Song Yi met before was still in the Chu army. When he met King Huai of Chu, he said: Song Yi concluded that Wu Xinjun's army must have failed. After a few days, his army did indeed fail.
An army that sees signs of defeat before starting a war can be said to understand military affairs.
King Huai of Chu summoned Song Yi and discussed the matter with him. He was very happy, so he appointed Xiang Yu as the top general, Xiang Yu as the Duke of Lu, as the second general, and Fan Zeng as the last general, to rescue Zhao.
All the other generals belong to Song Yi, and Song Yi is called the Champion of Qingzi.
He walked to Anyang and stayed for forty-six days without moving forward.
Xiang Yu said: I heard that the Qin army surrounded King Zhao at Julu. I quickly led the troops across the river. The Chu army attacked from the outside and the Zhao army responded from the inside. I will definitely defeat the Qin army. Song Yi said: No.
A gadfly that bites a cow cannot harm a louse. Now the Qin army attacks the Zhao army. If they win, they will be exhausted. We will take advantage of the Qin army's exhaustion. If we cannot win, we will lead the army to march westward with drums beating. We will definitely defeat the Qin army.
So it is better to let Qin and Zhao fight each other first.
Wearing armor, holding sharp weapons in hand, charging into battle, Song Yi is not as good as you; sitting down to make plans, you are not as good as Song Yi.
Therefore, an order was issued to the army: Anyone who is as fierce as a tiger, as ruthless as a sheep, as greedy as a wolf, and who is stubborn and disobeys orders will be beheaded.
Song Yi also sent his son Song Xiang to assist the state of Qi, and personally sent him to Wuyan, where he held a banquet with wine and gathered guests.
It was cold and raining heavily, and the soldiers were freezing and hungry.
Xiang Yu said: Originally, we planned to attack Qin together, but we stopped for a long time.
Nowadays, there is famine and hunger, and the people are poor. The soldiers can only eat half a liter of beans, and there is no food in the army. However, Song Yi still holds banquets and receives guests. Instead of leading the army across the river to take Zhao's food on the spot, he says "wait for the Qin army to be exhausted."
With Qin's powerful troops attacking the newly established Zhao State, the result of the development of the situation must be that the Qin army defeats the Zhao army.
Zhao's army was defeated, and Qin's army was stronger. What opportunity could there be to take advantage of exhaustion!
Moreover, the Chu army had been defeated recently, and the king was restless, so he concentrated all the troops in the country under the general's command. The safety of the country was at stake.
Nowadays, we do not care about the soldiers, but only seek selfish interests. This is not a minister who shares the same interests with the country.
Xiang Yu met General Song Yi in the morning, cut off Song Yi's head in his tent, and came out to give orders to the army: Song Yi and Qi State conspired against Chu, and the King of Chu secretly ordered me to kill him.
At this time, the generals were all afraid and surrendered, and no one dared to resist.
It is said that the generals and their families founded the State of Chu.
Now it was the general who executed the rebels again.
The generals jointly elected Xiang Yu as acting general.
He sent people to chase Song Yi's son, and caught up with him in Qi State and killed him.
Xiang Yu sent Huan Chu to report to King Huai of Chu.
King Huai of Chu made Xiang Yu the general, and both Dangyang Jun and General Pu belonged to Xiang Yu.
Xiang Yu had killed the champion of Qingzi, which shocked the Chu country and became famous among the princes. He sent Lord Dangyang and General Pu to lead 20,000 soldiers across the river to rescue Julu.
After the war was somewhat successful, Chen Yu asked Xiang Yu for more troops.
Xiang Yu led his entire army across the river, scuttled the ships, smashed the cooking utensils, burned the camps, and carried three days of rations to show that the soldiers fought to the death and no one had any intention of coming back alive.
As soon as the army arrived, they surrounded Wang Li, encountered the Qin army, fought nine battles, cut off the Qin army's corridors, and defeated the Qin army. Killed Su Jiao and captured Wang Li.
Shejian refused to surrender to the Chu army and burned himself to death.
At that time, the Chu army was famous among the princes.
At that time, the various princes who came to rescue Zhao had more than a dozen large camps, but they did not dare to send troops easily.
When the Chu army attacked, the princes and generals were watching the battle on the camp.
The soldiers of the Chu army were all equal to ten. The shouts of the Chu soldiers shook the sky, and the soldiers of the princes were frightened.
Having defeated the Qin army, Xiang Yu summoned all the princes and generals. They entered the camp gate and walked forward on their knees, not daring to look up.
From then on, Xiang Yu became the general of the princes' armies, and all the princes surrendered to him.
Zhang Han was stationed at Jiyuan and Xiang Yu was stationed at the south bank of Zhangshui River. The two armies were in a stalemate and there was no fighting.
The Qin army retreated many times, and the Second Emperor sent someone to punish Zhang Han.
Zhang Han was frightened and sent Chief Shi Simaxin to ask for instructions.
When he arrived in Xianyang, he waited outside the door for three days. Zhao Gao did not receive him, which was a sign of distrust.
Chief Shi Sima Xin was frightened and hurriedly fled back to the army. He didn't dare to take the original route. As expected, Zhao Gao sent people to chase him, but he failed to catch up.
Sima Xin arrived in the army and reported to Zhang Han: Zhao Gao has great power in the DPRK, and the people below cannot make a difference.
Now that the battle can be won, Zhao Gao must be jealous of our achievements; if the battle cannot be won, he will inevitably be executed.
I hope the general will think this through.
Chen Yu also sent a letter to Zhang Han saying: Bai Qi was the general of Qin. He attacked Yan and Ying to the south, killed horses and soldiers to the north, attacked the city and lost ground. He was countless, and in the end he was killed.
Meng Tian was a Qin general who drove the Xiongnu from the north and opened up an area of ​​thousands of miles in Yuzhong. He was eventually killed in Yangzhou.
Why?
There was too much merit, and Qin could not grant titles according to merit, so it used national laws to kill them.
Now that the general has been the general of Qin for three years, he has lost hundreds of thousands of soldiers, and the princes' armies have risen at the same time, increasing their numbers.
That Zhao Gao has always been flattering for a long time. Now the situation is critical, and he is afraid that the second generation will kill him, so he plans to use the national law to kill the general to shirk his responsibility, and to send someone from outside to replace the general to get rid of the disaster.
The general has been away for a long time, and many people in the court are alienated from you. Even if you have merit, you will be killed, and if you have no merit, you will be killed.
Besides, Qin is going to be destroyed, and both the stupid and the smart people know it.
Nowadays, the general cannot express his opinions directly at home, but outside he is the general of a country that is about to perish. He is isolated and helpless and wants to stay for a long time. Isn't it sad?
Why don't the general defect and join forces with various princes, sign a peace treaty, jointly attack Qin, cede the land to the king, sit facing south, and claim to be a lonely Taoist and a widower? Which one is better, or to be killed on the anvil and have his wife killed?
Zhang Han hesitated and secretly sent military commander Shicheng to Xiang Yu's camp to sign a peace treaty.
The peace treaty was not negotiated, so Xiang Yu asked General Pu to lead his troops across Sanhujin day and night, camped on the south bank of Zhang River, fought with the Qin army, and defeated the Qin army again.
Xiang Yu led the entire army to attack the Qin army on the sewage, and defeated the Qin army.
Zhang Han sent people to see Xiang Yu and planned to make a peace treaty.
Xiang Yu summoned the military officials to discuss: The army is short of food and wants to allow him to sign a peace treaty.
All the military officers said, "Okay."
Xiang Yu and Zhang Han made an appointment to meet at the Yin Ruins on the south bank of Huan River.
The alliance had been concluded. When Zhang Han saw Xiang Yu, he broke down in tears and told Xiang Yu all the deeds of Zhao Gao.
Xiang Yu then appointed Zhang Han as King Yong and placed him in the Chu army camp.
The envoy commander Shi Sima Xin was appointed as the general and led the Qin army as the advance force.
The army arrived at Xin'an.
The officers and soldiers of the princes' armies had previously passed through Guanzhong because of their corvee service and guarding the border areas. The Qin soldiers often insulted them. When the Qin army surrendered to the princes' army, the officers and soldiers of the princes' army took advantage of the victory in the war and treated them like slaves and prisoners, torturing and humiliating the Qin officers and soldiers at will.
Most of the Qin officers and soldiers discussed privately: General Zhang and others deceived us into surrendering to the princes' armies. Now we can enter the pass and defeat Qin, which is good; if we can't, the princes' troops will capture us and go eastward; Qin will definitely put our parents and wives to death.
The generals of the princes' armies secretly heard their plan and reported it to Xiang Yu.
Xiang Yu went to Generals Ying Bu and Pu to discuss: There were still many Qin officers and soldiers, and they were dissatisfied. If they did not obey orders when they arrived at Guanzhong, things would be in danger. It would be better to kill them, and only enter Qin with Zhang Han, Chang Shi Sima Xin, and Captain Dong Yi.
So the Chu army executed more than 200,000 Qin soldiers at night and buried them in the south of Xin'an City.
Xiang Yu is about to capture the Qin Guanzhong area.
Hangu Pass is guarded by soldiers and cannot enter.
When he heard that Pei Gong had conquered Xianyang, Xiang Yu was furious and sent Dangyang Lord and others to attack the pass.
Xiang Yu then entered Hangu Pass and reached the west bank of the water.
Pei Gong garrisoned Ba Shang, but was unable to meet Xiang Yu.
Cao Wushang, the minister on the left of Pei Gong, sent someone to tell Xiang Yu: Pei Gong wants to claim the title of King of Guanzhong, make Ziying his prime minister, and possess all the treasures.
Xiang Yu was so angry that he said: "Tomorrow morning, if we feast our soldiers, we will defeat Pei Gong's army!"
At this time, Xiang Yu had 400,000 troops stationed at Xinfenghongmen, and Peigong had 100,000 troops stationed at Bashang.
Fan Zeng advised Xiang Yu: When Pei Gong was in Shandong, he was greedy for money, lustful and fond of beautiful women.
Now that he has entered the pass, he does not accept property or get close to women. From this, it seems that his ambition is not small.
I asked people to observe the clouds in the sky above him. They were all shaped like dragons and tigers, and were colorful. This was the spirit of the emperor.
Attack quickly and don't miss the chance.
Xiang Bo, Zuo Yin of the Chu State, was Xiang Yu's uncle and had always been friendly with Liu Hou Zhang Liang.
Zhang Liang was following Pei Gong at this time, and Xiang Bo rode to Pei Gong's camp at night. He met Zhang Liang in private, told what happened, and planned to ask Zhang Liang to leave with him.
He said: Don't die with them.
Zhang Liang said: I was ordered by the King of Han to escort Pei Gong. Now that Pei Gong is encountered, it would be unethical to escape, so I have to tell him.
Zhang Liang went in and told Pei Gong everything.
Pei Gong was shocked and said, "What should we do?"
Zhang Liang said: Who gave the king this idea?
Pei Gong said: A boy advised me to guard Hangu Pass and not let the princes' troops come in. I can take all the land of Qin as my own and call myself the king here.
I took him at his word.
Zhang Liang said: "Does the king think that the current military strength is enough to resist King Xiang?"
Pei Gong remained silent and said: Of course his military strength is not as good as Xiang Yu's, so what should we do?
Zhang Liang said: Please let me tell Xiang Bo that Pei Gong does not dare to betray King Xiang.
Pei Gong said: How come you have friendship with Xiang Bo?
Zhang Liang said: Before Qin destroyed the six kingdoms, Xiang Bo and I were friends. He killed someone and I saved him.
Things were in danger now, and luckily he came to tell me.
Pei Gong said: Who is older than you, Xiang Bo?
Who is younger? Zhang Liang said: He is older than me.
Pei Gong said: "You call him in for me. I will treat him like an elder brother."
Zhang Liang came out and invited Xiang Bo.
Xiang Bo went in to see Pei Gong.
Pei Gong raised a glass to Xiang Bo and made a toast to his children's relatives. Pei Gong said: When I entered the pass, I did not dare to have any interests in it. I made a register to register the officials and people, sealed up the treasury, and waited for the general.
Therefore, the purpose of sending generals to guard the pass is to prevent other thieves from coming in and out and unexpected incidents.
I look forward to the arrival of the general day and night, how dare I rebel!
Please explain to the general in detail that I dare not be ungrateful.
Xiang Bo agreed and said to Pei Gong: "You must come early tomorrow morning to apologize to King Xiang."
Pei Gong said: OK.
So Xiang Bo left that night, returned to the army, and reported to King Xiang exactly what Pei Gong said.
Then he said to Xiang Yu: "If Pei Gong doesn't attack Guanzhong first, how dare you come in?"
Nowadays, it is unethical to attack someone who has made great achievements. It is better to treat him kindly.
King Xiang agreed.
The next morning, Pei Gong brought more than a hundred cavalry to see King Xiang. When he arrived at Hongmen, he apologized to Xiang Yu and said: The general and I attacked Qin together. The general fought in Hebei and I fought in Henan. However, I myself did not expect to enter the pass first and conquer Qin, so that I could see the general here again.
Now there is a villain's words, which creates a gap between the general and me.
King Xiang said: This is what Cao Wushang, your Sima of Pei Gong, said, otherwise, why would I be like this?
King Xiang stayed with Pei Gong to drink with him that day.
King Xiang and Bo Xiang sat facing east, and Yafu sat facing south.
Yafu is Fan Zeng.
Pei Gong sat facing north, and Zhang Liang sat facing west.
Fan Zeng winked at King Xiang many times and repeatedly raised his jade ornaments to signal to King Xiang, but King Xiang responded silently.
Fan Zeng got up and went out to find Xiang Zhuang and said to him: "The king is not ruthless. You go in and propose a toast. After the toast is finished, he asks for a sword dance and takes the opportunity to attack Pei Gong in his seat and kill him."
Otherwise, all of you will be captured by him.
Xiang Zhuang went in to toast. After the toast, he said: "The king and Pei Gong are drinking. There is nothing for entertainment in the army. Please allow me to dance with my sword to help." King Xiang said: OK.
Xiang Zhuang drew his sword and danced. Xiang Bo also drew his sword and danced. Xiang Bo often used his body to cover Pei Gong, so Xiang Zhuang did not get the opportunity to assassinate him.
At this time, Zhang Liang came to the military gate and summoned Fan Kuai.
Fan Kuai said: How are things going today?
Zhang Liang said: It is extremely critical.
At this moment, Xiang Zhuang was dancing with his sword, and his intention was always on Pei Gong.
Fan Kuai said: "This is urgent. Please let me in and live and die with Pei Gong."
Fan Kuai immediately entered the military gate with his sword and shield in his hand.
The guard guarding the gate of Jiaogan tried to stop him from entering, but Fan Kuai hit him with his shield, causing the guard to fall to the ground. Fan Kuai entered the big tent, opened the curtain, stood facing west, looked at King Xiang with wide, angry eyes, his hair pointing up, and his eyes broken.
King Xiang straightened his upper body with his sword in his hand and said, "What are the guests here for?"
Zhang Liang said: This is Pei Gong's chariot, Fan Kuai.
King Xiang said: Strong man! Give him a glass of wine.
Give him a large glass of wine.
Fan Kuai thanked him and stood up, drinking it all in one gulp.
King Xiang said: Give him pig legs as a reward. There is a pig leg on the left and right.
Fan Kuai laid his shield on the ground, put the pig's leg on the shield, drew his sword and cut the meat into pieces. King Xiang said: Strong man! Can I drink alcohol again? Fan Kuai said: I am not afraid of death. How can I refuse a glass of wine!
The King of Qin has the heart of a tiger and a wolf. He kills people for fear that he will not be able to kill them all, and uses punishments for fear that the punishment will not be severe, so that everyone in the world will rebel against him.
King Huai of Chu and his generals agreed that the one who conquered Qin first and entered Xianyang would be the king of Guanzhong.
Now that Pei Gong had conquered Qin and entered Xianyang, he did not dare to get close to him for the slightest benefit. He closed the palace and returned to the army to wait for the arrival of the king.
Therefore, generals are sent to guard the pass to guard against other thieves and accidents.

What can you do if your glory is not gone? What can you do if you are worried!
After singing it several times, the beauty sang along with him.

Therefore, the Han army caught up with King Xiang.

The chasing Han cavalry numbered several thousand.
King Xiang himself was probably unable to escape, so he said to his cavalry: It has been eight years since I raised my army, and I have personally fought more than seventy battles. Whoever resists me, I defeat, and whoever I attack surrenders. I have never lost a battle, so I dominate the world.
However, now I am finally besieged here. This is because God wants to destroy me, and it is not my fault in fighting.
Of course I am determined to fight to the death today, and I am willing to fight a happy battle for you. I must win three times, break through the siege for you, kill the enemy generals, and cut down the enemy's flag, so that you will know that it is God who destroyed me, and it is not my fault in fighting.
King Xiang divided his cavalry into four teams, facing all directions.
The Han army surrounded King Xiang on several levels.
King Xiang said to his cavalry: I will kill one of his generals for you.
King Xiang ordered the cavalry to gallop down in all directions and agreed to meet in three places on the east side of the mountain.
So King Xiang shouted loudly and rushed down. The Han army was frightened and collapsed, and King Xiang beheaded a Han general.
At that time, Chiquanhou was a cavalry general and chased King Xiang. King Xiang roared angrily, and Chiquanhou's men and horses were frightened and retreated for several miles. King Xiang and his cavalry gathered in three places.
The Han army didn't know where King Xiang was, so they divided their army into three parts and surrounded King Xiang. King Xiang rode on horseback and killed a captain of the Han army, killing more than a hundred people. He then gathered his cavalry and only lost two cavalrymen.
King Xiang said to his cavalry: How is it?
The cavalry all admired him and said: Just as the king said.
King Xiang wanted to cross the Wu River eastward.
The chief of the Wujiang Pavilion pulled the boat to the shore and waited for King Xiang. He said to King Xiang: Although Jiangdong is small, it stretches thousands of miles and has hundreds of thousands of people, which is enough to call him king.
I hope the king can cross the river quickly.
Now I am the only one who has ships. When the Han army comes here, there are no ships to cross the river.
King Xiang smiled and said: "God wants to destroy me, so why should I cross the river?"
Besides, I crossed the Yangtze River to the west with eight thousand people from Jiangdong, and now no one has come back. Even if the Jiangdong father and brother took pity on me and allowed me to become king, what face would I have to see them?
Even if they don't say anything, don't I, Xiang Ji, feel guilty for not doing it?
King Xiang said to the pavilion chief: I know you are a loyal and honest man.
I have been riding this horse for five years and it is invincible. I once galloped a thousand miles a day. I cannot bear to kill it, so I will give it to you.
He asked the cavalry to dismount and walk, and the soldiers engaged in short-range combat.
Xiang Ji alone killed hundreds of Han soldiers.
King Xiang also suffered more than ten injuries.
He turned around and saw Lu Matong, the cavalry commander of the Han army, and said, "Aren't you my old friend?"
Lu Matong faced King Xiang, pointed out to Wang Yi and said, "This is King Xiang."
King Xiang said: I heard that the Han army put a thousand catties of gold and ten thousand households as a reward for my head. I will do you a favor.
He killed himself and died.
Wang Yi cut off King Xiang's head, and the other cavalry trampled on each other, fighting for King Xiang's body, and killed dozens of each other.
Finally, the lieutenants rode Yang happy and the Sima Lu Matong. The lieutenants Lu Sheng and Yang Wu each got a piece of King Xiang's body.
The five men put their limbs together, and they all belonged to King Xiang.
Therefore, the rewarded land was divided into five parts: Lu Matong was granted the title of Zhongshui Marquis, Wang Yi was granted the title of Du Yanhou, Yang Xi was granted the title of Chiquan Marquis, Yang Wu was granted the title of Wu Fanghou, and Lu Sheng was granted the title of Nieyang Marquis.
After King Xiang's death, all parts of the Chu State surrendered to the Han army, except the city of Lu, which refused to surrender.
The king of Han then led his soldiers to massacre the city of Lu because they adhered to etiquette and sacrificed their lives for their masters. The king of Han showed King Xiang's head to the people of Lu, and the father and brother of Lu surrendered.
Initially, King Huai of Chu granted Xiang Ji the title of Duke of Lu. When Xiang Ji died, Lu City finally surrendered, so King Xiang was buried in Gucheng with the etiquette of Duke Lu.
The king of Han mourned for King Xiang, cried for a while, and then left Lucheng.
The king of Han did not kill any of the Xiang clans.
Xiang Bo was granted the title of Marquis of Sheyang.
Taohou, Pingjinghou and Xuanwuhou are all members of the Xiang clan and are given the surname Liu.
Tai Shigong said: I heard Zhou Sheng said that Shun's eyes probably had two pupils, and I also heard that Xiang Yu also had two pupils.
Is Xiang Yu a descendant of Shun?
Why did it rise so quickly?
The Qin Dynasty was politically corrupt. Chen She was the first to attack, and countless heroes began to compete with each other.
However, Xiang Yu had no basis to rely on, so he took advantage of the situation and started from among the people. In three years, he led five armies of princes to eliminate the Qin Dynasty, divided the world, created kings and princes, and established his own government. He was named "Overlord". Although he did not always maintain his status, there has never been such a thing in modern times.
When until Xiang Yu gave up Guanzhong, missed the Chu land, exiled Yi Emperor and made himself king, complained that the princes betrayed him, it was already difficult to control the situation.
He boasted about his achievements and acted out his own selfish wisdom. He did not follow the example of the ancients and thought that to create an overlord's cause, he needed to use force to run the world. In just five years, he lost his own country and died in Dongcheng. He has not yet awakened and does not condemn himself. This is wrong.
Isn't it ridiculous to use the excuse that God destroyed me because it was not my fault in fighting the war?
summary:
Xiang Ji, also known as Xiang Yu, was a man from Xiaxiang who began his military career at age twenty-four. His uncle was Xiang Liang, son of Chu general Xiang Yan, who was killed by Qin general Wang Jian. The Xiang family had served as Chu generals for generations and were granted the title of Xiang. As a child, Xiang Ji failed at learning calligraphy and fencing, dismissing them as insufficient for facing ten thousand enemies. He studied the art of war under Xiang Liang but refused to master it completely. After Xiang Liang killed someone, they fled to Wuzhong, where Xiang Liang organized military and funeral services, secretly assessing people's abilities. When Qin Shi Huang visited Kuaiji, Xiang Ji declared he could replace the emperor, prompting Xiang Liang to cover his mouth and warn against such talk. Xiang Liang then recognized Xiang Ji's exceptional nature. Xiang Ji was over eight feet tall, could lift a cauldron, and was feared by the youth of Wuzhong.

In July of Qin II's first year, Chen She rebelled in Daze Township. In September, Yin Tong, the governor of Kuaiji, proposed raising troops with Xiang Liang and Huan Chu. Xiang Liang, knowing Huan Chu's whereabouts, had Xiang Ji wait with a sword. After entering the governor's chambers, Xiang Liang called Xiang Ji in, who beheaded the governor. Xiang Yu killed over a hundred guards, and the rest submitted. Xiang Liang raised an army of 8,000 elite soldiers from Wuzhong, appointing local heroes as officers. He became governor of Kuaiji, with Xiang Ji as general. Zhao Ping of Guangling urged Xiang Liang to lead troops west to attack Qin. Xiang Liang crossed the river with 8,000 men, joined forces with Chen Ying of Dongyang, and gained 60,000-70,000 troops at Xiapi. He defeated Qin Jia, who had betrayed King Chen, and merged his army. After defeating Qin forces at Dong'a, Xiang Liang grew arrogant, ignoring Song Yi's warnings. Qin reinforced Zhang Han, who defeated and killed Xiang Liang at Dingtao.

After Xiang Liang's death, King Huai of Chu appointed Song Yi as supreme general to rescue Zhao, with Xiang Yu as second-in-command. Song Yi stalled at Anyang for 46 days. Xiang Yu killed him for incompetence and took command, leading the army across the river after sinking ships and burning camps. They defeated the Qin army at Julu, killing Su Jiao and capturing Wang Li. The Chu army's victory made Xiang Yu the commander of all allied forces. Zhang Han, facing pressure from Zhao Gao, surrendered to Xiang Yu after negotiations. Xiang Yu appointed Zhang Han as King Yong but later executed over 200,000 Qin soldiers at Xin'an due to fears of rebellion.

Xiang Yu entered Hangu Pass and camped at Hongmen, where Pei Gong (Liu Bang) had already taken Xianyang. Fan Zeng urged Xiang Yu to kill Pei Gong, but Xiang Bo warned Pei Gong, who apologized at the Hongmen feast. Xiang Zhuang's sword dance failed to assassinate Pei Gong, who escaped with Fan Kuai's help. Xiang Yu later entered Xianyang, killed Ziying, burned the Qin palace, and collected treasures. He divided the empire, making Pei Gong King of Han and himself Hegemon-King of Western Chu. He moved Emperor Yi to Chen County and had him killed. Conflicts arose as Tian Rong rebelled in Qi and Chen Yu attacked Changshan. The King of Han conquered the Three Qins and marched east, leading to a prolonged war with Xiang Yu.

The war saw numerous battles, including the Han defeat at Pengcheng and the siege of Xingyang. Xiang Yu's forces were weakened by defections and food shortages. After a stalemate at Guangwu, Xiang Yu agreed to divide the empire at the Hong Canal, releasing the King of Han's family. However, the King of Han broke the treaty and pursued Xiang Yu. At Gaixia, Xiang Yu's army was surrounded, and hearing Chu songs, he realized defeat was imminent. He fled with 800 cavalry, but only 28 remained at Dongcheng. After killing hundreds of Han soldiers, he committed suicide, refusing to cross the Wu River. His body was divided among five Han officers for rewards. The city of Lu surrendered only after seeing his head, and he was buried with the rites of a duke. The Han king did not kill the Xiang clan, granting some titles. Sima Qian noted Xiang Yu's rise from obscurity to dominance in three years but criticized his arrogance, abandonment of Guanzhong, and failure to learn from the past, attributing his downfall to his own faults rather than divine will.

translation:
Gaozu was born in Zhongyangli, Fengyi, Peixian County. The surname is Liu and the courtesy name is Ji.
The father's name is Taigong, and the mother's name is Liu Yu.
Previously, Lady Liu had rested on the shore of the Great Lake and met God in her sleep.
At this time, there were thunder and lightning, and the sky was dark and the earth was dark. Grandpa Gong went to see Lady Liu and saw a dragon on her body. Later Lady Liu became pregnant and gave birth to Gaozu.
Gaozu had a high nose, a plump forehead like a dragon, a beautiful beard, and seventy-two black moles on his left leg.
He is kind and loving to others, likes to give charity, and is broad-minded.
They often have lofty ambitions and do not engage in ordinary people's production operations.
When he reached his prime, he tried to be an official and became the chief of the Sishui Pavilion. Every official in the court was familiar with him and was teased by him.
He likes drinking and women.
He often borrowed wine from Wang Lao and Wu Fu and slept drunk. Wu Fu and Wang Lao often saw a dragon above him and felt very strange.
Every time Emperor Gaozu came to buy wine and stayed in the hotel to drink, the wine in the hotel sold several times more than usual.
When a strange phenomenon was discovered, at the end of the year, these two hotels often wrote off the credit debts of Gao Zu.
Emperor Gaozu once went to Xianyang to perform corvées and allowed people to watch. When he saw Qin Shihuang, he sighed and said: Ah, a real man should look like this!
Lu Gong, a single father, was friendly with the magistrate of Peixian County. In order to avoid his enemies from visiting the magistrate's house, he moved his family to Peixian County.
When the outstanding officials in Pei County heard that the county magistrate had a distinguished guest, they all went to send gifts to congratulate him.
Xiao He is the chief official of the county and is in charge of collecting gifts. He said to all distinguished guests: "Those whose gifts are less than one thousand yuan should sit down in the hall."
When Emperor Gaozu was the chief of the pavilion, he always looked down upon the officials. So he deceitfully said "Congratulations on thousands of dollars" on his name card, but in fact he didn't take out any money.
When the famous assassin was handed in, Lu Gong was shocked, stood up, and went to the door to greet Gaozu.
Lu Gong was a good person, so when he saw Gaozu's appearance, he respected him especially and led him to sit in the hall.
Xiao He said: Liu Ji originally talked a lot but rarely achieved anything.
Emperor Gaozu then teased the guests in the hall and sat at the top of the table, showing no humility.
The banquet was about to end, and Duke Lu signaled Gao Zu not to leave with his eyes.
Gaozu finished his drink and stayed behind.
Lu Gong said: I have been good at meeting people since I was young. I have met many people, but none of them is as noble as you, Liu Ji. I hope you, Liu Ji, take care of yourself.
I have a biological daughter who is willing to be your wife, Liu Ji, who holds a broom and sweeps.
After the banquet, Mrs. Lu was angry with Mr. Lu and said: "At first you always wanted to make this daughter different and marry her to a noble man."
Pei Ling was friendly with you and asked to marry your daughter, but you didn't agree. Why did you arbitrarily decide to marry Liu Ji?
Lu Gong said: This is not what you women and children can understand.
So he married his daughter to Liu Ji.
The daughter of Duke Lu was Empress Lu, who gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.
When Emperor Gaozu was the director of the pavilion, he once asked for leave to go home.
Queen Lu and her two children were weeding in the field. An old man passed by and asked for some water. Queen Lu gave him some food.
The old man met Empress Lu and said, "My wife is a noble person in the world."
Empress Lu asked him to read the faces of the two children. The old man looked at Xiaohui and said: Madam, the reason why she is so noble is because of this child.
After seeing Lu Yuan, he was also a noble prime minister.
The old man had already left, and Gaozu happened to come to the field from someone else's house. Empress Lu told him that a guest was passing by and showed our faces to mother and son, saying that we would both be noble people in the future. Gaozu asked where my father was, and Empress Lu said: "It's not far away."
Gaozu caught up with the old man and asked him.
The old man said: I met my wife and children just now, and they are all similar to you. Your appearance is beyond words.
Emperor Gaozu thanked me and said: If it is true as my father said, I will never forget your kindness to me.
When Emperor Gaozu became famous, he didn't even know where the old man was.
When Emperor Gaozu was the director of the pavilion, he used bamboo skin as a hat. This hat was made by a thief he sent to Xue County, and he often wore it. When he became a distinguished person, he still often wore it. The so-called "Liu's crown" refers to this kind of hat.
Emperor Gaozu served as the pavilion chief and sent servants to Mount Li for the county. Many of the servants fled on the way.
He estimated that by the time they reached Lishan Mountain, everyone would have fled. He went to the swamp area west of Fengyi and stopped to drink. At night, Gaozu released the slaves he had escorted.
Emperor Gaozu said: "Everyone, let's go. I'm running away from now on!"
Among the servants, there were more than ten young and strong men who were willing to follow Gaozu.
Emperor Gaozu was drunk, so he took a small road through the swamp that night and sent a man to explore the way.
The person who went out to explore the road came back and reported: There is a big snake lying across the road ahead. Please go back.
Emperor Gaozu was drunk and said: "When a hero walks, there is nothing to be afraid of!"
So he stepped forward, drew his sword and struck the snake, cutting it into two pieces, and the road was opened.
After walking for a few miles, he got drunk and lay down to sleep.
The people behind came to the place where the snake was killed and saw an old lady crying at night.
People asked why she was crying. The old lady said: Someone killed my son, so I cried.
People said again: Old lady, why was your son killed?
The old lady said: My son, the son of the White Emperor, turned into a snake and was lying on the road. Now he was killed by the son of the Red Emperor, so I cried.
People thought the old lady was dishonest and wanted to give her a hard time. The old lady suddenly disappeared.
Those who were left behind arrived at the place where Gaozu was resting, and Gaozu had already woken up.
They told Gaozu what had just happened. Gaozu was secretly happy and felt arrogant.
Those who followed him grew in awe of him.
Qin Shihuang often said that "there is the emperor's energy in the southeast", so he traveled to the east to suppress the emperor's energy in the southeast.
Emperor Gaozu suspected that the incident was related to him, so he ran away and hid among the rocks in the Mangshan and Dangshan areas.
Queen Lu searched with others, and often found Gaozu as soon as they arrived.
Emperor Gaozu felt strange and asked Empress Lu. Empress Lu said: There are often clouds where you are. If you look for the clouds, you can often be found.
Gaozu was very happy.
When some of the children in Pei County heard about this, many wanted to join him.
In the autumn of the first year of Qin II, Chen Sheng and others revolted in Qixian County and established themselves as kings in Chenxian County, known as Zhang Chu.
Most of the counties and counties killed their chiefs in response to Chen Sheng.
The magistrate of Peixian County was frightened and wanted to respond to Chen Sheng with Peiju. The chief official Xiao He and the jailer Cao Shen said to him: As an official of the Qin Dynasty, you are now rebelling against Qin and leading the children of Peixian County. I am afraid they will not obey your orders.
I hope you can gather hundreds of people who are fleeing outside. Use this power to intimidate the masses, and they will not dare to disobey your orders.
The county magistrate sent Fan Kuai to summon Liu Ji. Liu Ji's team already numbered nearly a hundred people.
So Fan Kuai followed Liu Ji to Peixian County.
The magistrate of Peixian County regretted it again. Fearing that something might happen to Liu Ji, he closed the city gates and sent people to defend him, intending to kill Xiao He and Cao Shen.
Xiao He and Cao Shen were frightened and climbed over the city wall to attach themselves to Liu Ji.
Liu Ji wrote a letter on silk and sent it to the city, telling the elders of Peixian County: The world has been suffering from the tyranny of the Qin Dynasty for a long time.
Now the elders are guarding the city for Pei Ling, but the princes from all over the world have revolted and want to massacre Pei County.
If the elders of Peixian County unite to kill Pei Ling and select the leader among their children who can be appointed as the leader to respond to the princes' army, then the lives of the whole family can be saved.
Otherwise, both father and son would be killed and their deaths would be meaningless.
The elders led their children to kill Pei Ling, opened the city gate, and welcomed Liu Ji, hoping to make him the magistrate of Pei County.
Liu Ji said: The world is in chaos, and all the princes are in rebellion. If the elected generals are not qualified, they will be completely defeated.
I am not begrudging my own life, but I am afraid that my talents are too weak to save my father, brothers and children.
This is a big deal, and I hope we can jointly elect someone who can do the job.
Xiao He, Cao Shen and others were civil servants who valued their wealth and life, and were afraid that the Qin Dynasty would exterminate their entire clans if the matter failed, so they all recommended Liu Ji.
The elders all said: We usually hear many strange things about Liu Ji. It seems that Liu Ji should be honored. And after divination, no one is more auspicious than Liu Ji.
At this time, Liu Ji repeatedly made concessions, but no one dared to take up the post. Finally, Liu Ji was appointed Duke of Pei.
In the courtyard of the Pei County Yamen, they offered sacrifices to the Yellow Emperor and Chi You, and used the blood of sacrifices to raise drum flags.
The flags are all red, because the snake Liu Ji killed was the son of the White Emperor, and the one who killed the snake was the son of the Red Emperor, so he respected red.
So the young men and powerful officials, such as Xiao He, Cao Shen, Fan Kuai and others, recruited soldiers for Pei Gong. They gathered two to three thousand people to attack Hu Ling and Fang Yu, and then returned to defend Fengyi.
In the second year of Qin II, General Chen Sheng led Zhou Zhang's army to the west to play in the water and return.
Yan, Zhao, Qi, and Wei all established themselves as kings.
Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu raised troops in Wu.
Qin Ping, the governor of Sishui County, led his troops to surround Feng. Two days later, Peigong sent troops to fight and defeated the Qin army.
Duke Pei ordered Yong Chi to guard Fengyi and led his troops to Xue.
Zhuang, the governor of Sishui County, was defeated in Xue and fled to Qi. Pei Gongzuo Sima captured Zhuang, the governor of Sishui County, and killed him.
Pei Gong returned to the army to fight against his father. When he arrived, there was no fighting.
King Chen Sheng of Chen sent Wei people to Zhoushi to attack the city and seize the territory.
The envoy from Zhoushi said to Yong Chi: "Feng, it turns out that King Liang once moved here."
Now Wei has captured dozens of cities. If you, Yongchi, surrender to Wei, Wei will make you Yongchi a marquis and still garrison Fengyi.
If you don't surrender, Fengyi will be slaughtered with blood.
Yong Chi was originally very reluctant to submit to Pei Gong. When Wei Guo surrendered, he betrayed Pei Gong and defended Fengyi for Wei Guo.
Duke Pei led his troops to attack Feng, but failed to capture it.
Pei Gong fell ill and returned to Pei County.
Pei Gong resented that Yong Chi and Fengyi's children had betrayed him. When he heard that Dongyang Ningjun and Qin Jiali had made Jingju the false king and lived in Liu County, he attached himself to them and wanted to borrow troops to attack Fengyi.
At this time, Qin general Zhang Han was chasing King Chen's troops, while Sima Yi, the general of Sima Yi, led his army northward and captured Chu. They reached Xiangtu City and arrived at Dang County.
Dongyang Ningjun and Peigong led their troops to the west and fought with Sima Yi in the west of Xiao County, but they did not take advantage.
He returned to collect scattered soldiers, gathered in Liuxian County, and led troops to attack Dangxian. He captured Dangxian County in three days.
He collected troops from Dang County and obtained five to six thousand men. He attacked Xiayi and defeated them.
Return to Fengyi.
I heard that Xiang Liang was in Xue County, so he brought more than a hundred cavalry to see Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang assigned 5,000 additional soldiers to Peigong and ten generals at the level of five officials.
Duke Pei returned and led his troops to attack Feng.
Peigong followed Xiang Liang for more than a month, and Xiang Yu had already conquered Xiangcheng and returned.
Xiang Liang summoned all the generals to Xuexian County. When he heard that King Chen was indeed dead, he made Xin, a descendant of Chu State and the grandson of King Huai of Chu, king of Chu, and made Xutai his capital.
Xiang Liang was named Wu Xinjun.
After stopping for a few months, he went north to attack Kangfu, rescued Dong'a, and defeated the Qin army.
The Qi army returned to Qi, but the Chu army pursued the defeated soldiers alone. He sent Pei Gong and Xiang Yu to lead another army to attack Chengyang and massacred the soldiers and civilians in the city.
Peigong and Xiang Yu garrisoned east of Puyang, fought with the Qin army, and defeated the Qin army.
The Qin army cheered up again, defended Puyang, and cut off the water.
The Chu army left and turned to attack Dingtao, but Dingtao was not captured.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu went west to capture the city. When they arrived at Yongqiu City, they fought with the Qin army, defeated the Qin army and killed Li You.
He returned to attack Waihuang, but Waihuang was not captured.
Xiang Liang defeated the Qin army again, looking proud.
Song Yi warned him, but he didn't listen.
Qin sent troops to reinforce Zhang Han and secretly attacked Xiang Liang at night. They defeated Xiang Liang in Dingtao and died in the battle.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu were attacking Chenliu. When they heard that Xiang Liang was dead, they led their troops and marched eastward with General Lu.
Lu Chen was stationed to the east of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu was stationed to the west of Pengcheng, and Peigong was stationed in Dang.
Zhang Han had defeated Xiang Liang's army and thought that the enemies in Chu did not need to worry, so he crossed the Yellow River and attacked Zhao from the north, defeating the Zhao army.
At this time, Zhao Xie was the king of Zhao, and Qin general Wang Li besieged Zhao Xie in Julu City. This is the so-called Hebei Army.
In the third year of Qin II, King Huai of Chu saw that Xiang Liang's army was defeated. He was frightened, moved away from Xutai, established his capital in Pengcheng, merged the armies of Lu Chen and Xiang Yu, and took command personally.
Peigong was appointed as the governor of Dang County and was granted the title of Marquis of Wu'an, commanding the army of Dang County.
Xiang Yu was granted the title of Marquis of Chang'an and his title was Duke of Lu.
Lu Chen was appointed Situ, and his father Lu Qing was appointed Ling Yin.
Zhao requested rescue many times, so King Chu Huai sent Song Yi as his general, Xiang Yu as his second general, and Fan Zeng as his junior general, and went north to rescue Zhao.
He ordered Pei Gong to march west and invade Guanzhong.
An agreement was made with the generals: whoever conquers Guanzhong first will be crowned king in Guanzhong.
At this time, the Qin army was strong and often took advantage of the victory to pursue, but the generals did not think it was advantageous to enter the pass first.
Only Xiang Yu hated Qin for defeating Xiang Liang's army, and was so angry that he was willing to enter the pass with Peigong west.
King Huai's veterans all said: Xiang Yu is agile but fierce, cunning and cruel.
Xiang Yu once attacked Xiangcheng, but no one was left alive in Xiangcheng. They were all buried alive. Wherever they passed, they were slaughtered and destroyed.
Moreover, the Chu army attacked and conquered many times, and King Chen and Xiang Liang failed before.
It is better to send another kind-hearted elder to march westward with the call of justice and explain the truth clearly to Qin's father and brothers.
Qin's father and brothers have suffered from their monarch's rule for a long time. Now if they can really get a generous elder to go to Guanzhong without bullying and tyranny, they should be able to win Guanzhong.
Now Xiang Yu is so fierce that he cannot be dispatched.
Only Pei Gong, who has always been a tolerant elder, can be dispatched.
In the end, King Huai did not agree to Xiang Yu's request and sent Peigong to the west to attack Qin. Collecting the scattered troops of King Chen and Xiang Liang, they passed through Dang and arrived at Chengyang. They faced off against the Qin army in Gangli and defeated the two Qin troops.
The Chu army sent troops to attack Wang Li and severely defeated his army.
Peigong led his troops to the west, met Peng Yue in Changyi, and joined him to attack the Qin army. The battle was not won.
Returning to Li County, I met Marquis Gangwu and captured his army, about 4,000 people, and merged them together.
Peigong, together with the troops of Wei General Huang Xin and Wei Shentu Wu Pu, jointly attacked Changyi, but Changyi was not captured.
Passing through Gaoyang on the way west.
Li Shiqi was the prison gate and said: "There are many generals passing by here. I think Pei Gong is a big man, with the demeanor of a kind and elder man."
So he went to seek an audience and lobby Pei Gong.
Peigong sat on the bed, stretched out his legs, and asked the two women to wash his feet.
Li Sheng did not bow down, but bowed deeply and said: "We must destroy the cruel and cruel Qin Dynasty with one step. We should not sit down with our legs stretched out to meet the elders."
So Pei Gong stood up, straightened his clothes, apologized to him, and asked him to take his seat.
Li Shiqi persuaded Peigong to attack Chenliu and obtain the grain and rice accumulated by Chenliu.
Pei Gong then appointed Li Shiqi as Lord of Guangye and Li Shang as general, led Chen Liu's army, and attacked Kaifeng together with Pei Gong, but Kaifeng was not captured.
Xiangxi fought with Qin general Yang Xiong at Baima, and then fought to the east of Quyu, defeating Yang Xiong's army.
Yang Xiong fled to Rongyang, and Qin II sent an envoy to behead him in public.
Peigong went south to attack Yingyang and massacred the city of Yingyang.
Relying on Zhang Liang, he captured the royal palace in South Korea.
At this time, Zhao general Sima Yin was about to cross the Yellow River and enter Hangu Pass. Peigong attacked north to defeat Pingyin and cut off the Yellow River ferry.
Heading south, they fought in the east of Luoyang, but the battle was unfavorable. After returning to Yangcheng, they gathered their cavalry and fought with the governor of Nanyang County in Guidong, defeating the Qin army.
After capturing the city of Nanyang County, the governor of Nanyang County fled and retreated to Wan County.
Duke Pei led his troops to bypass Wancheng and march westward.
Zhang Liangjin remonstrated and said: "Pei Gong, although you are eager to break into Hangu Pass, there are still many Qin soldiers and they are guarding the dangerous position."
If Wancheng is not captured now, the defenders of Wancheng will attack from behind and the powerful Qin army will block it from the front. This is a dangerous tactic.
So Pei Gong led his troops back from another road at night, changed the flag, and surrounded Wancheng on three levels at dawn.
The governor of Nanyang County wanted to commit suicide, but his bodyguard Chen Hui said: "It's not time to die yet."
