Chen Sheng, courtesy name She, was born in Yangcheng.
Wu Guang, courtesy name Shu, was from Yangxia.
When Chen She was young, he and others were hired to farm.
Once I was resting on the ridge of the field. I was frustrated for a long time and said: If you become rich, no one should forget the other.
The fellows who were employed laughed and asked: "You are hired to plow the fields. What wealth do you get?"
Chen Sheng sighed and said: Alas, how can a sparrow know the ambition of a swan?
In the autumn and July of the first year of Qin II, the government fine-tuned the households on the left side of Juli Lane to guard the border and went to Yuyang with 900 people. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang both served as village chiefs.
When we walked to Qidaze Township, it was raining heavily and the roads were blocked, so we probably missed the registration deadline.
If you miss the deadline, you will be beheaded according to the law. Chen Sheng and Wu Guang said together: "To escape now is to die. To rise up and do something big is to die. The same is to die. Is it okay to die in state affairs?"
Chen Sheng said: The people of the world have suffered from the violent Qin rule for a long time.
I heard that the second emperor was a young son and should not succeed to the throne. The son Fusu should succeed.
Fusu could not be established as crown prince due to repeated admonitions, so the First Emperor sent him to lead troops elsewhere.
Now it was heard that he was not guilty, and II killed him.
The common people had heard that Fusu was a capable person, but they didn't know that he was dead.
Xiang Yan was a general of the Chu State. He had made many meritorious deeds and loved his soldiers. All the people of the Chu State loved him.
Now if we pretend to be Fu Su and Xiang Yan and take the lead for the people of the world, many people should respond.
Wu Guang thought he was right.
So he went to divination.
The fortune tellers understood their intentions and said: All your affairs will come true and you will achieve great success.
But you have to ask ghosts and gods for divination!
Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were very happy. After thinking about the matter of asking ghosts, they said: This is to teach us to gain prestige among people through ghosts and gods.
So they wrote the words "King Chen Sheng" on the silk with cinnabar, and secretly stuffed it into the belly of the fish that others had picked up with a fishing net.
It was strange that the soldiers of the garrison bought fish and cooked it, but found the silk book in the fish's belly.
Chen Sheng also privately asked Wu Guang to go to the shrine in the woods where he was stationed. He lit a fire at night, pretended to be a fox and howled and shouted: "Great Chu is rising, King Chen Sheng."
The garrison soldiers were frightened and restless at night.
The next morning, the garrison soldiers were talking about this everywhere, pointing and looking at Chen Sheng and Wu Guang.
Chen Sheng and Wu Guang have always been considerate of others, and many people in the garrison were willing to listen to their orders.
The general escorting the garrison was drunk. Wu Guang deliberately threatened to run away many times to anger the general and let him humiliate him in public to anger everyone.
As expected, the general whipped Wu Guang.
When the general drew his sword, Wu Guang rose up to grab the sword and kill the general.
Chen Sheng also came to help, and together they killed the two generals.
He summoned his subordinates and said: "You are caught in the rain and have missed the deadline. If you miss the deadline, you should be beheaded."
If we had not killed them, sixty-seven out of ten people would have died while guarding the border.
Moreover, a strong man must not die but must leave a great name in the world.
How can princes, generals and prime ministers be born with such talent?
Subordinates all say: Accept orders respectfully.
So they pretended to be princes, Fusu and Xiang Yan, and staged an uprising to obey public opinion.
The garrison soldiers all had their right arms exposed and were known as Da Chu.
They built a high altar and swore an oath, and used the heads of generals as sacrifices.
Chen Sheng established himself as general and Wu Guang as captain.
Attacked Daze Township and captured it.
He recruited troops to attack Qixian and captured it.
He sent Ge Ying from Fuli to lead troops to attack the Yisu area of ​​Qixian County, attack Liao, Zheng, Ku, Zhe, Qiao and other counties, and captured them all.
While marching, they continued to recruit and expand their troops. By the time they reached Chen County, there were six to seven hundred tanks, more than a thousand cavalry, and tens of thousands of infantry.
When Chen County was attacked, neither the county guard nor the county magistrate was present, leaving only the Shou Cheng to resist in Qiaomen.
Unable to win, Shou Cheng died in battle, so he entered the city and occupied Chen County.
A few days later, Chen Sheng ordered to summon the three elders of the township officials and local gentry to gather for a meeting.
The three elders and the squires all said: General, you are wearing boring armor and holding sharp weapons in your hands. You crusade against the unjust, eradicate the violent Qin, and rebuild the Chu Kingdom. In terms of merit, you should be called the king.
So Chen Sheng was proclaimed king and known as Zhang Chu.
At this time, all counties and counties were suffering from the tyranny of Qin officials and killed their officials in response to Chen She.
So Wu Guang was appointed acting king and led the generals to attack Rongyang westward.
He ordered Wu Chen, Zhang Er, and Chen Yu from Chen County to capture Zhao, and ordered Deng Zong from Ruyin to capture Jiujiang County.
At this time, thousands of Chu rebels gathered together and it was impossible to count them.
Ge Ying arrived in Shucheng and established Xiang Qiang as King of Chu.
Ge Ying later heard that Chen Sheng had been established as king, so he killed Xiang Qiang and returned to report.
As soon as he arrived in Chen County, Chen Sheng killed Ge Ying and ordered Wei people from Zhoushi to go north to capture Wei.
Wu Guang surrounded Rongyang. Li You was appointed governor of Sanchuan County and guarded Rongyang, which Wu Guang could not capture.
So Chen Sheng summoned domestic heroes to discuss countermeasures and appointed Cai Ci, the Lord of Shangcai Renfang, as the Shangzhu Kingdom.
Zhou Wen was a wise man in Chen County. He once served as the Japanese official in Xiang Yan's army, and also served Chun Shenjun. He claimed to be familiar with military affairs.
Chen Sheng awarded him the seal of general and ordered him to lead his army westward to attack Qin.
Soldiers and horses were recruited along the way to Hangu Pass. Sometimes there were thousands of chariots and hundreds of thousands of soldiers. They arrived at the theater and stationed themselves.
Qin II ordered Zhang Han, the young governor, to pardon the prisoners serving in Lishan and the sons of slaves, and sent them all to attack the Chu army and defeated them.
Zhou Wen was defeated, retreated from Hangu Pass, and garrisoned Caoyang.
For more than two months, Zhang Han led his troops to pursue and defeat Zhou Wen, and they retreated to garrison in Tsui Pond.
After more than ten days, Zhang Han attacked and defeated them.
Zhou Wen committed suicide and the army lost its combat effectiveness.
When the military minister arrived in Handan, he proclaimed himself King of Zhao, Chen Yuren was appointed as the general, and Zhang Er and Zhao Sao were appointed as the left and right prime ministers.
Chen Sheng was angry, captured Wu Chen and other family members, and planned to kill them.
Zhuguo Cai Ci suggested: If the Qin Dynasty kills the family members of King Zhao, generals and prime ministers before the Qin Dynasty declines, it is equivalent to adding another Qin Dynasty as an enemy. It is better to seal him with power.
King Chen sent an envoy to Zhao to congratulate him, and then transferred the family members of the military officials and others who were under house arrest to the palace.
Zhang Ao, Zhang Er's son, was granted the title of Lord of Chengdu and urged Zhao soldiers to quickly march to Hangu Pass.
The king of Zhao, the generals and ministers discussed it and said: It is not the original intention of the Chu State that the king calls Zhao king.
After Chu defeated Qin, it was inevitable that troops would be added to Zhao. A better idea would be not to march westward, but to send generals north to capture the land of Yan to expand our territory.
Zhao State defends the Yellow River in the south, and there are vast areas of Yan and Dai in the north. Even if Chu State defeats Qin, it will not be able to conquer Zhao State. If the Chu State cannot defeat Qin, it will definitely pay attention to the Zhao State.
Zhao State can take advantage of the decline of Qin and Chu to achieve success in the world.
King Zhao thought it was right, so he did not send troops westward. Instead, he sent Han Guang, a former soldier of Shanggu County, to lead his army north to attack Yan.
The wealthy nobles of the old Yan State advised Han Guang: "The land of Chu has a king, and the land of Zhao has a king."
Although the land of Yan is small, it is a country with thousands of troops and chariots. I hope that the general will establish himself as the king of Yan.
Han Guang said: My mother lives in the State of Zhao, so I can't do it. The Yan people said: The State of Zhao is worried about Qin in the west and Chu in the south. His power cannot restrain us.
Moreover, as Chu State was so powerful, it did not dare to harm the family members of the generals and kings of Zhao. How could Zhao State dare to harm the generals’ families now?
Han Chen thought he was right, so he made himself king of Zhe.
A few months later, Zhao Er escorted King Yan's mother and family members back to the Kingdom of Yan.
At this time, countless generals from all over the country were attacking cities and territories.
Zhou Shi marched north to Di County. Tian Dan, a native of Di County, killed the magistrate of Di County and proclaimed himself the king of Qi. He raised troops in Qi and attacked Zhou Shi.
Zhou Shi's army was defeated and returned to Wei, intending to make Ningling Junjiu, a descendant of the original Wei king, the king of Wei.
At that time, Guan was with Chen Sheng and could not go to Wei.
After Wei was pacified, people wanted to establish Zhou Shi as King of Wei, but Zhou Shi refused.
The envoy traveled back and forth between King Chen and Wei five times, and Chen Shengcai agreed to make Ningling Junjiu King of Wei and send him back to Wei.
Zhou Shi finally became the prime minister.
General Tian Zang and others jointly planned and said: Zhou Zhang's army has been defeated. The Qin army will come sooner or later. We have surrounded Rongyang City for a long time and cannot attack it. Once the Qin army arrives, it will definitely suffer a huge defeat.
It is better to leave a small number of troops behind, enough to surround Rongyang, and mobilize all the elite troops to attack the Qin army.
Now the acting king Wu Guang is arrogant and does not understand military tactics. He cannot work with him. If he does not kill him, the whole matter may be ruined.
Therefore, under the pretense of King Chen's order, they executed Wu Guang and presented Wu Guang's head to Chen Sheng.
Chen Sheng sent an envoy to give Tian Zang the seal of Chu State's Ling Yin and appointed him as a general.
Tian Zang sent his generals Li Gui and others to garrison outside Rongyang City. He led his elite troops to the west to meet the Qin army in Aocang.
The two sides fought, Tian Zang died in the battle, and the army collapsed.
Zhang Han marched to attack Li Gui and others at Rongyang City and defeated them. Li Gui died in battle.
Deng Yue, a native of Yangcheng, led his army in Tan County and was defeated by another army of Zhang Han. Deng Yue led his army and fled to Chen County.
Wu Feng, a native of Liao County, led his army and was stationed in Xu County. Zhang Han defeated him and Wu Feng fled to Chen County.
Chen Sheng killed Deng Shuo:
When Chen Sheng first became king, Qin Jia from Ling County, Dong Yan from Liao County, Zhu Jishi from Fuli, Zheng Bu from Qilu, and Ding Ji from Xu County all independently raised armies and led their troops to surround the governor of Shuhai County in Tan County.
When King Chen heard about it, he appointed Wu Ping Junpan as a general to oversee all the armies in Tancheng.
Qin Jia established himself as Grand Sima and did not want to be subordinate to Lord Wu Ping. He told the military officers: Lord Wu Ping is young and does not understand military affairs, so don't listen to him!
Therefore, it was falsely reported that King Chen ordered Wuping Junpan to be killed.
Zhang Han had defeated Wu Feng and attacked Chen County. Cai Ci, the king of Shangzhu State, died in the battle.
Zhang Han then advanced to attack Zhang He's army in the west of Chen County.
Chen Sheng personally went into battle to supervise the battle. The army was defeated and Zhang He died in the battle.
In December, Chen Sheng went to Ruyin and transferred to Xiachengfu. His coachman Zhuangmai killed him and then surrendered to the Qin army.
Chen Sheng was buried in Ci County, and Mi was named King Yin.
Lu Chen, Chen Sheng's old minister, later became a general in the factory. He established a "Cangtou Army" with heads wrapped in green scarves. They raised troops in Xinyang, conquered Chen County, killed Zhuang Mai, and made Chen County the capital of Chu.
At first, Chen Sheng ordered Song Liu, a native of Liao County, to lead his army to pacify Nanyang and enter Wuguan.
After Song Liu captured Nanyang, he heard the news of Chen Sheng's death, and Nanyang was captured by the Qin army again.
Song Liu could not enter Wuguan, so he went east to Xincai and met the Qin army. Song Liu led his army to surrender to Qin.
Qin took Song Liu to Xianyang, and his chariot was broken to show the public.
When Qin Jia and others heard that Chen Sheng was defeated, they appointed Jing Ju as King of Chu and led his army to Fangyu County, preparing to attack the Qin army in Jiyin.
He sent Gongsun Qing to the King of Qi to join forces and march together.
King Qi said: King Chen was defeated and his life and death are unknown to this day. How could Chu state establish a king without asking me for permission?
Gongsun Qing said: The king of Qi established a king without asking for instructions from the state of Chu. Why did the state of Chu have to ask the state of Qi for instructions to establish a king?
Moreover, Chu State was the first to cause trouble, so it should be the order of the world.
So Tian Dan killed Gongsun Qing.
Qin's left and right captains led their troops to attack Chen County again, and the county seat was captured.
Lu Chen's army was defeated, so he recruited troops and regrouped. They met the troops of Dangyang Lord Yingbu, who was a thief in Poyang, and attacked the Qin army's left and right captains, defeated them at Qingbo, and once again made Chen County the capital of Chu.
It happened that at this time Xiang Liang made Xin, the grandson of King Huai of Chu, the King of Chu.
Chen Sheng reigned as king for six months.
When he first became king, his old friends who had worked with him as farm servants heard about this and rushed to Chen County. They knocked on the palace door and said, "I want to see Chen She."
The palace chief wanted to tie him up.
After repeated explanations by him, he was granted pardon, but he was still not informed.
When King Chen went out, he blocked the road and shouted Chen She's name.
When Chen Sheng heard the shouting, he summoned him and drove back to the palace with him.
Entering the palace, he saw the halls, houses, curtains and curtains. The guest said: "There are so many! Chen She has become king, and the palace and mansion are so luxurious!"
The people of the Chu State called Duo Huo She the king, so it spread throughout the world that Chen She was the first person to create a sentence.
This guest came in and out more and more freely, talking about Chen Sheng's past events at will.
Someone advised Chen Sheng: "This guest of yours is ignorant and talks nonsense, which damages your dignity."
Chen Sheng then killed the guest.
As a result, all Chen Sheng's old acquaintances left voluntarily, and no one was close to Chen Sheng from now on.
Chen Sheng appointed Zhu Fang as the Zhongzheng official and Hu Wu as the Siguo official, in charge of the affairs of the ministers.
When the generals captured the city and returned to Chen County to answer their orders, those who did not comply with the orders were arrested and punished, and harshness and severity were regarded as loyalty.
Anyone who has a bad relationship with these two people will be punished arbitrarily by them themselves without being handed over to the relevant officials for interrogation.
Chen Sheng trusted these two people, so the generals did not attach themselves to Chen Sheng.
This is the reason why Chen Sheng failed.
Although Chen Sheng died, the princes and generals he appointed and sent finally destroyed the Qin Dynasty.
At that time, Emperor Gaozu arranged a family to guard Chen She's tomb in Ci, and they still slaughter animals on time to offer sacrifices to him.
After Wang Mang failed, he stopped offering sacrifices.
Xiang Ji, whose courtesy name is Yu, is a native of Xiaxiang.
When he first joined the army, he was twenty-four years old.
His uncle is Xiang Liang, and Xiang Liang's father is Xiang Yan, a famous general of Chu State.
The Xiang family had been generals of Chu for generations and were granted the title of Xiang, hence their surname.
When Xiang Ji was young, he learned to read and write but had no success, so he gave up. He also learned swordsmanship, but had no success, so he gave up again.
Xiang Liang was very angry with him.
Xiang Ji said: Knowing characters is enough to remember a name.
Sword fighting against one person is not worth learning. I want to learn how to resist tens of thousands of people.
Therefore, Xiang Liang was surprised by his ambition and taught Xiang Ji the art of war. Xiang Ji was overjoyed and refused to finish the lesson even after knowing a little about it.
Xiang Liang was once hunted by officials in Liangyang, so he asked Cao Qian, the clerk of Qixian Prison, to write to Sima Xin, the clerk of Liyang Prison, and the matter was settled.
Xiang Liang once killed someone, and he and Xiang Ji went to Wuzhong to avoid revenge.
The talents of the wise officials in Wuzhong are all inferior to Xiang Liang.
Whenever there was a big corvee or funeral in Wuzhong, Xiang Liang often took charge of it and secretly used military skills to organize guests and disciples to understand their talents.
Qin Shihuang traveled eastward to Kuaiji and crossed Zhejiang. Xiang Liang and Xiang Ji watched together.
Xiang Ji said: We can replace that guy!
Xiang Liang covered his mouth and said, "Don't talk nonsense, it will destroy the entire clan!"
Xiang Liang therefore thought that Xiang Ji had extraordinary ambitions.
Xiang Ji was eight feet two inches tall, could lift a cauldron, and was extremely talented and courageous. All the children in Wuzhong were afraid of Xiang Ji.
In the first year of Qin II, Chen She and others revolted in Daze Township.
In September of this year, Yin Tong, the acting governor of Kuaiji, always believed that Xiang Liang was a virtuous person, so he summoned him to discuss matters.
Xiang Liang said: The places west of the river have rebelled. This is the time when God is going to destroy the Qin Dynasty.
If you strike first you can subdue someone, if you act later you will be subdued.
Yin Tong sighed and said: I heard that Mr. Xiang comes from a family of Chu generals, so great things can only be done with your feet!
Xiang Liang said: There was a strange scholar Huan Chu in the land of Wu. He fled among the lakes. No one knew where he lived. Only Xiang Ji knew.
Xiang Liang went out and asked Xiang Yu to wait outside with his sword.
Xiang Liang went in again and said to the county guard: "Please summon Xiang Yu and let him accept the mission to summon Huan Chu."
Xiang Ji came in. Xiang Liang winked at Xiang Ji and said, "It's time to take action!"
So Xiang Ji drew his sword and beheaded the governor.
Xiang Liang held the head of the county magistrate and wore the seal of the magistrate.
The governor's entourage on the left and right became panicked and rioted, and Xiang Yu hacked and killed more than a hundred people.
Everyone in the yamen was so scared that no one dared to stand up.
Xiang Liang summoned the capable officials he was familiar with before and explained that this was going to cause a big event, so he mobilized the soldiers of Wuzhong.
He sent people to recruit strong men from the subordinate counties, and got eight thousand elite soldiers. Xiang Liang appointed the heroes of Wuzhong as school captains, military marquises, and Sima.
There was a man who was not appointed and went to argue with Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang said: Some time ago, someone died and I asked you to take charge of something, but you failed to do it, so you were not appointed.
Everyone admired him.
So Xiang Liang served as the general of Kuaiji, and Xiang Ji served as the deputy general, patrolling the subordinate counties.
In the second year of Qin II, Zhaoping from Guangling attacked Guangling for Chen Sheng, but failed to capture it.
He heard that Chen Sheng was defeated and fled, and Qin general Zhang Han arrived immediately. He crossed the river and pretended to ask King Chen to order him to grant Xiang Liang the title of Chu Shangzhu.
Xiang Liang then led eight thousand people across the Yangtze River and marched westward.
At this time, he heard that Chen Ying had occupied Shuyang, and Xiang Liang sent an envoy to ask to join him and march westward together.
Chen Ying was originally a meritorious official in Dongyang County. He lived in the county town. He was always honest and prudent, and people respected him as an elder.
The young people in Dongyang killed the county magistrate and gathered thousands of people to elect a leader. However, there was no suitable person, so they invited Chen Ying.
Chen Ying excused himself because he had no talent, so everyone made Chen Ying the leader, and 20,000 people in the county followed him in the uprising.
Everyone wanted to support Chen Ying as king and wrapped their heads in green cloth to mark that they were a new army.
Chen Ying's mother said to him: Since I became the daughter-in-law of the Chen family, I have never heard that your ancestors met any prominent figures.
It's not a good sign to suddenly become famous now. It is better to belong to others. If things succeed, you can still be granted a title. If things fail, it is easy to avoid because you are not a famous person in society.
Chen Ying did not dare to claim the throne and said to his officers: "The surname Xiang has been a general for generations and is very famous in the Chu Kingdom." If you want to do big things now, the coach must be this kind of person.
We rely on famous families and the destruction of the Qin Dynasty is certain.
So everyone obeyed his words and put the troops under Xiang Liang's command.
Xiang Liang crossed the Huaihe River, and generals Yingbu and Pu also brought their troops to join him.
A total of 60,000 to 70,000 people were stationed at the craft.
At this time, Qin Jia had already elected Jing Ju as the king of Chu, and stationed troops in Pengcheng with their faces restrained, hoping to resist Xiang Liang.
Xiang Liang told the officers: King Chen started the rebellion first, and the battle was unfavorable. His whereabouts are unknown.
Now Qin Jia betrayed King Chen and supported Jing Ju, which was a treasonous act, so he marched to attack Qin Jia. Qin Jia's army was defeated and fled, and Xiang Liang pursued him to Hu Ling.
Qin Jia returned to the army and fought for one day. Qin Jia died in the battle and the army surrendered.
Jingju fled and died in Liangdi.
Xiang Liang annexed Qin Jia's army and garrisoned Huling. Will he lead his troops to the west?
Zhang Han's army arrived in Li County, and Xiang Liang sent Zhujishi and Yu Fanjun, generals from another army, to fight.
Yu Fanjun died in battle, Zhujishi's army was defeated and fled to Huling.
Xiang Liang led his army into Xue County and killed Zhujishi.
Xiang Liang had previously sent Xiang Yu to attack Xiangcheng separately. The officers and soldiers of Xiangcheng held on and could not be captured for a while.
After conquering them, Xiang Yu buried them all alive and then came back to report to Xiang Liang. When Xiang Liang heard that King Chen was indeed dead, he summoned all the generals to Xue County to discuss military affairs.
At this time, Pei Gong also raised troops in Peixian County and came to attend the meeting.
Fan Zeng, a seventy-year-old native of Juhu, who was always good at coming up with unexpected plans, went to persuade Xiang Liang and said: "Chen Sheng's failure is inevitable."
The Qin Dynasty destroyed six kingdoms, and Chu was the most innocent. Since King Huai went to Qin and never returned, the people of Chu missed him to this day. Therefore, Duke Nan of Chu said: Even if there are only three families left in Chu, Chu will definitely be the one who destroys Qin. Now Chen Sheng is the first to rise up and proclaim himself king without supporting the descendants of King Chu. His power cannot last long.
Now you have raised troops in Jiangshu, and the reason why the generals in Chu are swarming to follow you is because your family has been the generals of Chu for generations and can support the descendants of the King of Chu again.
So Xiang Liang found the grandson of King Huai of Chu from the people, who was tending sheep for others, and supported him as King Huai of Chu to comply with the people's wishes.
Chen Ying served as the Shangzhu State of Chu State, granted five counties, and established Xutai as the capital with King Huai.
Xiang Liang called himself Lord Wu Xin and led his army to attack Kang's father.
At the beginning, Zhang Han killed Qi King Tian Dan in Linpu, and Tian Jia established himself as Qi King.
Tian Dan's brother Tian Rong retreated to Shu'a, and Zhang Han pursued and surrounded Tian Rong's army.
Xiang Liang led troops to rescue Shu'a and defeated the Qin army in Shu'a.
Tian Rong went back with his troops and expelled King Tianjia of Qi. Tianjia fled to Chu State. Tian Jiao, the prime minister of Tianjia, fled to Zhao.
Tian Jiao's younger brother Tian Xian was originally a general of Qi State, but he lived in Zhao State and did not dare to go back.
Tian Rong supported Tian Dan's son Tian Shi as King of Qi.
Xiang Liang defeated the Qin army in the Dong'a area and pursued it.
Several envoys were sent to urge the Qi army to march west together: Tian Rong said that if Chu killed Tian Jia, Zhao would kill Tian Jiao and Tian Xian. We just sent troops.
Xiang Liang said: Tianjia is the king of the allied countries. He came to me in desperation and couldn't bear to kill him.
The State of Zhao also refused to kill Tian Jiao and Tian Xian to make a deal with the State of Qi.
Qi finally refused to send troops to help the Chu army.
Xiang Liang sent Xiang Yu and Pei Gong to attack Chengyang from another route and massacred the entire city.
Moving further west, the Qin army was defeated east of Puyang, and the Qin army withdrew its troops and retreated into Puyang City.
Pei Gong and Xiang Yu attacked Dingtao. Dingtao was not captured, so he withdrew, captured the territory to the west, and reached Yongqiu, where he defeated the Qin army and killed Li You.
He returned to attack Waihuang, but Waihuang was not captured.
Xiang Liang set out from Dong'a, and when he arrived at Dingtao, he defeated the Qin army again. Xiang Yu and others killed Li You again, showing contempt for the Qin army even more, showing a proud look.
Song Yi advised Xiang Liang: If you win a battle, if the generals are proud and the soldiers are lazy, they will fail.
