Han Xin was born in Huaiyin County.
The family is poor and has no good character. He cannot be elected to be an official, and he cannot do business to make a living. He often lives in other people's homes and eats nothing.
His mother passed away and was too poor to bury her, so he found a high, dry place with spacious surroundings as a cemetery so that tens of thousands of families could be placed next to the grave in the future.
Han Xin once went to the countryside to eat at the pavilion chief's house in Nanchang. The pavilion chief's wife hated him so much that she got up very early to prepare the meal and put it on the bed to eat.
When it was breakfast time, Han Xin went and no meal was prepared for him.
Han Xin understood her intention and left her, never to interact with her again.
Han Xin once went fishing in the city. An old woman was rinsing silk cotton wool. She took pity on him and gave him food. This continued for dozens of days until the rinsing was completed.
Han Xin said gratefully to his old mother: I will definitely repay you heavily in the future.
The old man was very angry after hearing this and said, "You are a man and can't support yourself. I gave you food out of pity for you, a young man. Do I want you to repay me?"
A young man in Huaiyin City bullied Han Xin and said: Although you are tall and like to wear swords, you are actually very timid.
He insulted Han Xin in public and said: If you are not afraid of death, stab me with a sword; if you are afraid of death, get under my crotch.
So Han Xin stared at the young man carefully, then bent down and crawled under his crotch.
People watching the excitement on the street laughed at Han Xin and thought he was cowardly.
When Xiang Liang led his army across the Huai River to the north, Han Xin took his sword and went to him, and became an unknown soldier under Xiang Liang.
After Xiang Liang failed, he returned to Xiang Yu, who made him a doctor.
Han Xin repeatedly offered advice to Xiang Yu, but Xiang Yu did not adopt it.
Liu Bang, the king of Han, entered Hanzhong, and Han Xin escaped from the Chu army and joined the king of Han. At the beginning, he was still unknown and worked as a granary management clerk.
Later, he was sentenced to death for breaking the law. Thirteen of his accomplices were beheaded. When it was Han Xin's turn, Han Xin looked up and happened to see Teng Gong Xia Houying, so he asked: Doesn't the King of Han want to unify the world?
Why kill the strong man?
Teng Gong felt that Han Xin's words were unusual and he looked very powerful, so he did not kill him.
After talking to Han Xin, he was very happy and reported his situation to the King of Han.
The King of Han appointed Han Xin as the Commander-in-Chief of Su Su, but did not reuse him.
Han Xin talked with Xiao He many times, and Xiao He appreciated his talent very much.
When the Han army arrived at Nanzheng, dozens of generals escaped halfway.
Han Xin considered that Xiao He and others had recommended him to the King of Han several times, but he still could not be reused, so he ran away.
Xiao He heard that Han Xin had escaped. He had no time to report to the king of Han, so he went to chase him himself.
Someone reported to the King of Han: Prime Minister Xiao He has escaped.
The king of Han was furious, as if he had lost his left and right hands.
Two days later, Xiao He came to see the King of Han.
The King of Han was both angry and happy, and scolded Xiao He: "Why did you run away?"
Xiao He replied: How dare I run away? I am chasing those who run away.
The king of Han asked: Who are you chasing?
Xiao He replied: It's Han Xin.
The King of Han scolded again: "There are dozens of generals who have escaped, but you have not pursued them; you only pursued Han Xin. This is a lie."
Xiao He said: Those generals are easy to get, and outstanding talents like Han Xin can be said to be unparalleled in the world.
Your Majesty, if you only want to be king in the desert, then there is nothing that requires Han Xin; if you want to fight for the world, there will be no one except Han Xin who can discuss major matters with you.
It depends on how the king makes decisions.
The King of Han said: I want to develop to the east, how can I stay limited to this place?
Xiao He said: If the king is determined to march eastward and can reuse Han Xin, Han Xin will come; if he cannot reuse Han Xin, Han Xin will eventually run away.
The king of Han said: For your sake, let him be a general.
Xiao He said: Even if he is made a general, Han Xin will not stay.
The king of Han said: Then appoint him as a general.
Xiao He said: Great!
So the King of Han wanted to summon Han Xin immediately to announce his appointment.
Xiao He said: Your Majesty, you have always been arrogant and disrespectful to others. Now appointing generals is like calling a child. This is why Han Xin wants to leave.
If the king is determined to appoint him, he should choose a good day, fast and bathe, set up an altar and square, and hold a formal ceremony to worship the general. This is all right.
The king of Han agreed to Xiao He's request.
The generals were very happy when they heard that the King of Han was going to set up an altar to worship the general. Everyone thought that he was going to be a general.
When the ceremony of consecration was held, they found out that the general was Han Xin. The whole army was surprised.
After Han Xin accepted the ceremony of conferring the title of general, he sat down.
The King of Han asked Han Xin: The Prime Minister has recommended generals to me many times. What strategies do you have for me?
Han Xin expressed his humility and said to the King of Han: Now in the East, who can compete with the king for the world, isn't it King Xiang?
The King of Han said: Of course it is. Xin said: Your Majesty, in your own estimation, who is stronger than King Xiang in terms of bravery, strength and military strength?
The King of Han was silent for a long time and said: "I am not as good as King Xiang."
Han Xin bowed twice and said appreciatively: "Han Xin also thinks that the king is inferior to him. I once served King Xiang. Let me talk about King Xiang's character."
The king shouted angrily, and hundreds or thousands of people would be too frightened to move: "But you cannot use capable generals, only brave ones, not just warriors."
King Xiang treated people with respect and humility, and spoke docilely. When someone was sick, he would sympathize with him and shed tears, and share his food and drink with him. When the person he appointed had made meritorious service and should be given a title, he would hold the engraved seal in his hand and be reluctant to give it to others even though the edges were almost worn away. This is what people call a woman's kindness.
Although King Xiang dominated the world and made the princes surrender, he did not occupy Guanzhong and Pengcheng. He also violated Emperor Yi's agreement with the princes and sealed all his relatives as kings of Guanzhong. The princes were all angry.
When the princes saw that King Xiang had expelled Emperor Yi to the south of the Yangtze River, they all went back and expelled their original monarchs, occupied the rich land, and established themselves as kings.
Wherever King Xiang's army passed, there was no place that was not destroyed and destroyed. The people in the world resented him and were not willing to join him. They were just afraid of his power and were forced to obey.
Although he is the overlord of the world in name, he has actually lost the hearts of the people in the world, so he seems to be strong but is actually weak.
Now that the king is really able to take the completely opposite approach to King Xiang and appoint the brave and capable talents in the world, there is no enemy that cannot be eliminated!
If the cities in the world are entrusted to meritorious ministers, who else will not be convinced!
He led the army of justice and obeyed the wishes of the soldiers to return home. What enemy can't be defeated!
Moreover, the three kings who were enfeoffed in Qin were the original generals of the Qin army. They led the children of the Qin people in the war, and countless of them were killed and fled. They also deceived their subordinates to surrender to Xiang Yu: when they arrived in Xin'an, King Xiang used cunning means to bury alive the surrendered soldiers of the Qin army, more than 200,000 of them. Only Zhang Han, Sima Xin and Dong Yi were able to escape.
The fathers and brothers of Qin hated these three people to their very core.
Now the overlord of Western Chu relies on his power to forcibly ennoble these three people as kings. The people of Qin will not love them.
After the king led his army into Wuguan, the discipline was strict and there was no violation of Qiu. He abolished the harsh laws of the Qin Dynasty and made a three-part agreement with the people of Guanzhong. The people of Qin all hope that the king will come to Qin and become the king.
According to the agreement between Emperor Yi and the princes, the king was supposed to be the king of Guanzhong. All the people in Guanzhong knew this. The king lost his rightful title of king of Guanzhong and was demoted to Hanzhong. The people of Guanzhong were all resentful.
Now that the king has sent troops to advance, the fiefdom of the Three Qin kings can be pacified as long as a document is passed down.
So the King of Han was very happy, thinking that it was too late to get Han Xin, so he arranged the targets for the generals to attack according to Han Xin's strategy.
The king of Han sent troops to march eastward through Chencang and pacified the Three Qin Dynasties.
In the second year of the Han Dynasty, he led his troops out of Hanguguan and conquered the king of Wei and the king of Henan. The king of Han and Yin also surrendered.
Then he united the troops of Qi and Tang to attack Pengcheng, the capital of Chu. The Han soldiers were defeated and returned in disarray.
Bi Xin then sent troops to join forces with Mu Yingchang, and attacked the Chu army between the fortress and the fortress, and defeated the Chu army. Therefore, the Chu army could not advance westward.
After the Han army was defeated in Pengcheng, Sima Xin, king of Sai, and Dong Yi, king of Zhai, escaped from the Han army and surrendered to the Chu army. Bianyou, Shengyu and Qu also rebelled against each other and made peace with each other.
He sent Tai Qi to lobby Wei King Bao, but Wei Bao refused to listen, so he appointed Locust Xin as Zuo Prime Minister to attack Qu.
Cross-examining Su: Can Qu not use Uncle Dan as a general?
Li Sheng replied: The general is Yuan Zhi.
The whole letter said: He is just a child.
Then he marched to attack the grasshopper.
The king of Wei deployed heavy troops in Zhayuan and blocked Linjin Pass.
Hanzhi then set up additional suspects, deployed his boats, and pretended to cross the river from Zhuozhi. He also sent a concealed ambush force to cross the river from Xia Yang with wooden urns and basins of floating water to sneak attack Anyi.
King Wei Bao of Wei was greatly frightened and hurriedly led his troops to attack Zhengzhi. He captured Wei Bao and put Mi down.
After that, Han Xin sent someone to see the King of Han and said: I hope to increase the number of 30,000 troops. I request to take advantage of the victory and march north to conquer the two countries Yan and Zhao, attack Qi to the east, cut off Chu's grain routes to the south, and finally go west to join forces with the king in Rongyang.
The King of Han agreed to give Han Xin 30,000 more troops, and sent Tan Dan and Han Zhi to attack Zhao Er and Ji Er to the north.
He defeated the attacking army and captured Xia Yue alive in the hammer.
After Kongcao captured Chongxiao and Zhuyou, the King of Han sent people to call back his elite troops and marched to Rongyang to resist the Chu army.
Han Xin and Zhang Er led tens of thousands of troops and wanted to march eastward to capture Jingxing and attack Zhao.
King Chu and Chen Yu, Lord of Cheng'an, heard that the Han army was about to attack Zhao, so they gathered a heavy army to guard Jingxingkou, claiming to have an army of 200,000.
Lord Guangwu Li Zuoche gave advice to Lord Chengan and said: I heard that the Han general Han Xin crossed the Xihe River, captured the king of Wei, and captured Xia Shuo alive. They had just fought a bloody battle to break up the alliance.
Now with Zhang Er as an assistant, he plans to attack Zhao. This is a battle far away from the country while taking advantage of the victory. The attack is unstoppable.
But I heard that when military rations are transported from thousands of miles away, the soldiers will look hungry; when firewood and grass are temporarily used for cooking, the army often cannot eat enough. Nowadays, the road in Jingxing is narrow and cannot pass two parallel chariots.
I hope you can lend me 30,000 elite troops for the time being to intercept their supplies of food and supplies from the small road. You must dig trenches deep, build forts high, and refuse to fight.

I hope you will seriously consider my strategy, and I guarantee that you will not be captured by these two people.
Cheng'anjun is a nerd, and often claims that a just army does not use deceit and trickery. He said: I heard that in the art of war, if the force is ten times more than the enemy, you can surround them, and if you have more than twice the force, you can fight. If we are unable to retreat from such an enemy now, how will we resist if we encounter a more powerful enemy in the future?
The princes will think that we are timid and attack us easily.
Therefore, he did not adopt Lord Guangwu's strategy.
Han Xin sent spies to find out that Chen Yu did not adopt Lord Guangwu's strategy and came back to report. Han Xin was overjoyed and dared to lead his army there.

He warned everyone: "When the army sees our army retreating and fleeing, they will definitely attack us in full force. Han Xin then said to the deacon officer: Zhao Jun has occupied a favorable terrain and set up camp, and they will not come out to attack our vanguard until they see the banner of our general. I am afraid that we will retreat when we reach the dangerous point of the pass.
Han Xin then dispatched 10,000 people to set off first. After leaving Jingxingkou, they formed a formation with their backs to the river.

After daybreak, Han Xin raised the general's flag, beat the war drum, and walked out of Jingxingkou with great fanfare. The Zhao army opened the camp and attacked the Han army. The battle lasted for a long time.
At this time, Han Xin and Zhang Er pretended that they could not hold on, abandoned their flags and drums and fled quickly into the army arrayed by the water, and then turned around and fought fiercely.

Seeing that they could not win and could not capture Han Xin, Zhang Er and others, the Zhao army wanted to retreat to the camp. They found that the camp was covered with red flags of the Han army. So the Han army attacked from front to back, defeated the Zhao army, captured a large number of troops, beheaded Chen Yu, the king of Cheng'an, and captured Wang Xie alive by the riverside.
Han Xin ordered his troops not to kill Lord Guangwu. Anyone who could capture him alive would be rewarded with a thousand gold coins.
After a while, someone tied up Mr. Guangwu and sent him to the military camp. Han Xin immediately untied the ropes from his body and asked him to sit facing east while he sat facing west, treating him like a teacher.
After all the generals presented their heads and prisoners, they all congratulated Han Xin and took the opportunity to ask Han Xin: The art of war says that the right side of the military formation should be backed by mountains, and the front and left sides should be backed by water. This time, the general ordered us to line up with our backs to the water, and even said that if we were defeated, we would go to the army dinner. We were not convinced at all.
However, they actually succeeded. What kind of tactics was this?
Han Xin said: This kind of formation exists in the art of war, but you just didn't pay attention to it.
Doesn’t it say in the art of war that if you are in a desperate situation, you can fight hard to survive, and if you are in a desperate situation, you can fight hard to survive?
Moreover, I, Han Xin, am not leading soldiers who have been trained by me for a long time and completely obey my command. This is what the military book calls "temporarily driving citizens to fight." Under this situation, the soldiers must be put to death and let each of them automatically fight bravely for survival; if the army is deployed in an open area where it is easy to escape, everyone will flee without fighting. How can we use them to defeat the enemy?
The generals all said with admiration: "The general's high-level strategy is beyond our ability to match."
So Han Xin asked Lord Guangwu: I want to attack Yan State in the north and Qi State in the east. How do you think I can succeed? Guangwu Jun Qianrang said: I heard that ministers who have lost their country are not qualified to plan the survival of the country, and generals who have lost battles are not qualified to talk about bravery.
How can a captive like me, who has been defeated and perished, be qualified to discuss important matters?
Han Xin said: I heard that when Baili Xi was in Yu State, Yu State perished, and when he arrived in Qin State, Qin State became hegemonic. It was not that he was stupid when he was in Yu State and became smart when he arrived in Qin State.
If Lord Cheng An had listened to your plan, I, Han Xin, would have been captured by you long ago.
I completely follow your plan and hope you will not refuse.
Lord Guangwu said: I heard that a wise man will make a mistake in every thought; a fool will gain something in a thousand thoughts. Therefore, even if it is a madman's words, a saint can selectively adopt them. However, I am afraid that my strategy may not be worth listening to, but I am willing to dedicate my sincerity to you.
Originally, Cheng'anjun had a plan to win every battle, but once he failed, his army was defeated under Haocheng and he himself died on the river.
Now the general captured the king of Wei and captured Xia Shuo alive. In less than a morning, he defeated the Zhao army of 200,000 men and killed Anjun.
He is so famous all over the world and so powerful that even the peasants of the enemy country have a premonition of the arrival of the army and they all give up farming. They are discouraged and want to eat well and wear well. They listen to you and wait for the news of your order to march.
However, your troops are so exhausted that it's actually difficult to continue fighting.
Now the general leads such tired soldiers and is trapped under the strong city of Yan State. The true situation is exposed to the enemy, and his momentum is weakened. He cannot attack the city if he wants to, and the wilderness lasts for a long time and the food is exhausted.
If Yan cannot be defeated, Qi will definitely refuse to defend its borders and become stronger.
If the Han army continues to stalemate with Yan and Tiao, the importance of Liu Bang and Xiang Yu will become indistinguishable.
I have little knowledge, but privately I think that attacking Yan and conquering Qi is also a mistake. Han Xin said: What should we do?
Lord Guangwu replied: The best way now is to stand still. Within a radius of a hundred miles, people would bring beef and wine every day, entertain the generals, and pretend to attack the Yan State in the north, and then send an envoy with a letter to the Yan State. The Yan State would not dare not listen.
After the Yan State was surrendered, the army moved eastward and approached Qi State. Although there were smart people, they did not know how to plan for Qi State.
In this way, the fight for the world can be realized.
When using troops, there is a tendency to bluff first and then take actual actions. This is what I am talking about.
Han Xin said: Very good, thank you for your advice.
So he adopted Lord Guangwu's strategy and sent an envoy to the State of Yan. The State of Yan surrendered immediately after hearing the news.
Han Xin sent someone to report to the King of Han, and asked Zhang Er to be appointed King of Zhao to pacify the State of Zhao.
The king of Han agreed to his request.
Chu State sent raiding troops across the Yellow River to attack Zhao State many times. King Zhang Er of Chu State and Han Xin exchanged rescues, and the cities of Chu State were stabilized during the army's passing, and then troops were dispatched to support the King of Han.
The Chu army was besieging the King of Han in Rongyang. The King of Han broke out and went south to Wan County and Ye County. He conquered Jiujiang King Yingbu and entered Chenggao. The Chu army hurriedly surrounded them again.
In the fourth year of the Han Dynasty, the king of Han escaped from Chenggao, crossed the Yellow River, and defected alone with Teng Gong to Xiuwu County, where Zhang Er's army was stationed.
When I arrived at Xiuwu, I stayed in a guest house.
The next morning, someone claiming to be the envoy of the King of Han rode straight into the Zhao camp.
Before Zhang Er and Han Xin got up, the king of Han seized their seals and military symbols from their bedrooms, summoned the generals with military flags, and changed their positions.
After Han Xin and Zhang Er got up, they were surprised to know that the King of Han came to the camp alone.
The king of Han seized the two armies, ordered Zhang Er to defend Zhao, appointed Han Xin as prime minister, and mobilized Zhao's troops that had not been transferred to Rongyang to attack Qi.
Han Xin led his troops to advance, but before they crossed Pingyuanjin, they heard that the king of Han had sent Li Shiqi to persuade the king of Qi to surrender.
Han Xin wanted to stop advancing, but Kuai Tong persuaded Han Xin to continue attacking Qi. This incident was recorded in "The Biography of Kuai Tong".
Han Xin thought his strategy was right, so he led his troops across the Yellow River, attacked Qi's Lixia army, and took advantage of the victory to reach Linmiao, the capital of Qi.
King Tian Guang of Qi fled to Gaomi and sent an envoy to Chu to ask for help.
Han Xin pacified Linmiao and pursued King Qi eastward to the west of Gaomi.
The King of Chu also sent Long Qie to lead an army of 200,000 troops to rescue Qi.
